Welcome to Genevieve’s Playhouse where we create all kinds of educational videos for kids and toddlers using toy based learning. Come along as Genevieve plays with characters from Paw Patrol and Peppa Pig, while learning counting numbers, basic words, and storytelling skills. Our video formats span from vlogs, skits, animations, and experiments. Videos are offered in English, Spanish, Hindi, and Vietnamese.

Genevieve's Playhouse is a safe, and kid-friendly channel that parents can trust to provide educational content for their little ones.

At BabyBus, our goal is to make learning a fun and imaginative experience for kids aged 2 - 6 by creating classic nursery rhymes, kid songs, and stories with 2D & 3D animations. 

In the BabyBus world, KiKi, Miumiu, and their friends inspire kids to experience true friendship, care, creativity, and imagination in a fun and smart way. Through our songs and animations, kids around the world can learn about colors, letters, life skills, good habits, safety tips, and more in a fun and educational way.

In the eyes of Kiki and Miumiu, all things are alive: you can talk to animals, you can make friends with vehicles... All the activities can be enjoyed, you can experience different occupations, you can go everywhere... All the unknowns are interesting: what will be in space? Are there aliens on earth?... Join Kiki and Miumiu for the exploration of this world together!

Yes! Neo Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/yesneoofficial

Wilderness TV is a channel about rescuing and caring for animals, and building safe, beautiful homes for them by hand using mud, clay, and natural materials.

On this channel, I rescue puppies, dogs, cats, rabbits, and other animals from unsafe places, then create peaceful environments where they can live comfortably. Every house, shelter, and playground is built with simple tools and traditional techniques, inspired by ancient and natural building skills.

My purpose is to show people around the world that animals deserve protection, care, and love. Through these projects, I also share my creativity and ideas for pet house building, animal shelters, and outdoor animal spaces.

All animals in my videos are cared for responsibly and live in a safe countryside environment near me, not in the wild jungle.

Thank you for supporting animal rescue and handmade building projects.

row: The History Guy: History Deserves to Be Remembered

History that deserves to be remembered. If you love history, this is the channel for you! Stories of forgotten history, all between five and fifteen minutes long.

Episodes are posted Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings. 

I have always loved history and believe that history does not have to be boring.

At its heart, history is story telling, and I believe that it should be told with passion and genuine love for the material.  History might be tragic, it might be comic, but it is the story of who we are, and we should not be afraid to enjoy that story, and be moved by it.

I live in the American Midwest, talk too fast but am working on that, and tie my own bow ties.  Yes, the hats in the background are mine.

Topic suggestions are always welcome. Send them to Suggestions@thehistoryguy.net
Fan mail is welcome at:  PO Box 1473, O'Fallon, IL 62269
Join our community at https://thehistoryguyguild.locals.com/

row: PETA (People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals)

You are watching Animal Rights Television®.

People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) is the largest animal rights organization in the world, and PETA entities have more than 10 million members and supporters globally.

PETA opposes speciesism, a human-supremacist worldview, and focuses its attention on the four areas in which the largest numbers of animals suffer the most intensely for the longest periods of time: in laboratories, in the food industry, in the clothing trade, and in the entertainment business. We also work on a variety of other issues, including the cruel killing of rodents, birds, and other animals who are often considered “pests” as well as cruelty to domesticated animals.

PETA works through public education, investigative news gathering and reporting, research, animal rescue, legislation, special events, celebrity involvement, and protest campaigns.

Get ready to embark on a journey of discovery, compassion, and action. Together, let's strive for a world where all wild cats live freely and in harmony with nature. Subscribe, share, and be part of this incredible journey. #bigcatrescue #bigcattv #conservation

Gentle Storm Horse Sanctuary exists to rescue horses trapped in auction pipelines and facing slaughter in Mexico.
These horses often come from lives of neglect, overwork, abuse, and abandonment — sold through auctions and pushed toward slaughterhouses with no voice and no time left.

We are the gentle storm that steps in.
When chaos, fear, and cruelty surround them, we intervene with urgency, compassion, and unwavering commitment.

At our sanctuary, rescued horses receive:
• Emergency rescue from auctions and slaughter routes
• Medical care, rehabilitation, and trauma recovery
• Safety, patience, and respect
• A chance to heal after the storm has passed

They have survived the storm.
Now they deserve gentleness.

I'm the one who receives the funds which are being spent on the many costs involved in continuing our work, including:

• Animal Care
• Medical Equipment and Treatment
• Rescue Operations and Transports
• Shelter Infrastructure
• Operational Costs
• Volunteer & Staff Support

For over 70 years, Humane World for Animals—formerly called the Humane Society of the United States and Humane Society International—has worked to tackle the root causes of animal cruelty and suffering and create permanent change. With millions of supporters and work happening in over 50 countries, we address the most deeply entrenched forms of animal cruelty and suffering by working on the biggest problems and creating long-term solutions. We tackle the root causes of cruelty by shifting human behavior and advocating for policy change, making change at scale. We work across borders, bringing diverse expertise to the most complex issues, and doing it all with a compassionate and welcoming approach. We work to end the cruelest practices, care for animals in crisis and build a stronger animal protection movement. Join us in building a better world for all animals!  

#HumaneWorld #EndAnimalCruelty

Dr. Antonio Webb is a board certified and fellowship trained Orthopedic Spine Surgeon located in San Antonio, Texas who specializes in degenerative, artificial disc replacement, and minimally invasive spine surgery.

Dr. Webb is a highly decorated combat veteran who spent 8 years in the US Air Force as a medic/LVN including a deployment north of Baghdad, Iraq in 2005. His medical training also afforded him the opportunity to perform surgery in Liberia, West Africa, Bangkok, Thailand, and Port Au Prince Haiti.

Dr. Webb completed a combined Neurosurgery/Orthopedic Spine Surgery fellowship at Texas Back Institute. TBI was the first practice in America to implant an artificial disc replacement. He took the best practices from all his mentors to formulate his own unique approach to spine care believing that conservative treatment is the ultimate goal, using surgery only as a final and last resort.

https://antoniowebbmd.com/
https://www.texasdiscreplacementcenter.com/

We rescue critically injured animals who have run out of options.

I’m Viktor Larkhill, founder of Let’s Adopt International. We specialize in Extreme Rescue: complex cases requiring advanced veterinary medicine, surgery, rehabilitation and long-term care.

On this channel, you will see the entire journey, from rescue and diagnosis to recovery at the Great House and, whenever possible, the extraordinary home waiting at the end.

These are real animals, real medical decisions and real second chances. We document the truth because rescue does not end when the camera stops.

Subscribe and become part of the international community making these rescues possible.

For deeper updates and to help us keep saving lives, join Let’s Adopt on Patreon through the link below.
https://www.patreon.com/LetsAdopt

If you're looking for safe pelvic floor exercises and want to know how to do Kegel exercises correctly, you're in the right place!

Hi, I’m Michelle, a Pelvic Health Physio, here to help guide and support you with evidence-based pelvic floor exercises and pelvic floor safe strength and fitness exercises that you can relate to and trust.

Whether you’re:
- Looking to strengthen your pelvic floor and core muscles 
- Dealing with bladder or bowel problems
- Living with prolapse problems
- Suffering from erectile dysfunction
- Recovering after prostate surgery
- Exercising after hysterectomy

This channel is here with reliable Pelvic Floor Physio information — no matter who you are, where you live, or your life circumstances.

Access to quality pelvic health information is your right — and everyone’s birthright.

Let's exercise together to help you feel better — inside and out.

I’m Alyssa, a doctor of physical therapy and osteoarthritis specialist. I’m here to show you that adventure is possible with arthritis and joint pain.

Movement isn’t the enemy. The right movement can reduce pain, stiffness, and instability and it can also help you avoid surgery, endless medications, and injections.

After years helping people recover from knee and hip replacements, I saw too many slip through the cracks of traditional healthcare. Not here. On this channel, you’ll get research-backed tips and real-world strategies to regain mobility, rebuild strength, and keep you moving toward the life you want.

No more playing small, let’s make your arthritis adventures happen.

Dog Rescue Shelter established in 2007, is one of few Serbia’s largest non-profit, no-kill animal shelters.  We have placed over 300 dogs and cats, since we opened our doors. We are located in Mladenovac city, just one hour south of Belgrade and easily accessible to all of Serbia. Being open 7 days a week makes the adoption of a pet convenient for the general public and enables us to place all homeless dogs and cats who urgently need help.
Life on the streets is very hard and risky. Some of stray dogs have a luck to live a long life because they have people who take care of them, but some dogs are poisoned or trampled by a car and die.
In our shelter 350 adult dogs, 20 puppies and 20 cats currently residing, rescued from the streets. So many dogs from the streets needed help and safe place in the shelter.
We need YOUR continued dedication and financial support. We are not funded locally or federally, we rely solely on private donations to keep our shelter doors open.

row: The world-famous Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden is committed to inspiring visitors to care about wildlife and wild places. It was voted the #1 Best Zoo and the #1 Best Botanical Garden by USA TODAY and has also received rave reviews from Child Magazine, Parents Magazine, Newsweek, and TripAdvisor. Nearly 2 million people visit the Zoo’s award-winning habitats and gardens annually. The Zoo, an accredited member of the Association of Zoos & Aquariums since 1978, is internationally known for its success in the protection and propagation of endangered animals and plants and engages in research and conservation projects worldwide. Known as the #GreenestZooInAmerica, the Zoo is doing its part to conserve natural resources that are critical to saving wildlife and habitats and is committed to greening its daily operations and reducing its impact on the environment with rain gardens, recycled building materials, solar panels and more. The Cincinnati Zoo is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

The San Diego Zoo is located near downtown San Diego in Balboa Park. The 100-acre Zoo is home to more than 12,000 rare and endangered animals representing more than 650 species and subspecies, and a prominent botanical collection with more than 700,000 exotic plants.

The San Diego Zoo Safari Park is an expansive conservation park that is home to more than 3,600 animals representing more than 300 species. Its renowned botanical collection represents 3,700 species and 1.3 million plant specimens. Over half of the Park’s 1,800 acres have been set aside as protected native species habitat. It is located 30 miles north of downtown San Diego in the San Pasqual Valley near Escondido, California.

The San Diego Zoo and San Diego Zoo Safari Park are operated by the international non-profit San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance. San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance (SDZWA) empowers people from around the globe to support their mission to conserve wildlife through innovation and partnerships.

This channel focuses on various treatments and education for the management of the side effects. We also share tools to help reduce and manage lymphedema, along with lymphatic health & wellness.

We are an animal rescue organization and shelter based in Ukraine.

Our journey began in 2018 with one animal-loving soul. Today, our mission is to rescue stray animals, provide medical care, and help them find loving forever homes.

row: Monty Roberts (born May 14, 1935) is the American horse trainer who promotes his techniques of natural horsemanship through Join-Up® International, founded in 1997 and named after the core concept of his training method. Roberts believes that horses use a non-verbal language, which he terms "Equus," and that humans can use this gestural language to communicate with horses. In order to share his knowledge of horsemanship, Roberts has authored a number of books including an original best-seller, The Man Who Listens to Horses. Roberts also founded the Monty Roberts International Learning Center to teach his methods in Solvang, California, and an "online university" since 2009 to teach the concepts. See more of Monty's online videos at www.montyroberts.com

Takis Shelter is a no-cage, no-kill shelter in Ierapetra, Greece. In its everyday life, Takis Shelter rescues dogs and cats from the streets. These animals are either strays, have been abused, or have been in accidents and are in urgent need of help. The channel documents the rescue efforts, the daily life in the shelter, and the rehabilitation and adoption stories of these dogs and cats.

Legal information:
Legal name of NPO: STEGI PROSTASIAS ADESPOTON ZOON (Takis Shelter)

The channel is operated and managed by Takis Shelter NPO, based in Ierapetra, Greece.

Contact: contact@takisshelter.org

We receive revenue from YouTube advertising (YouTube Partner Program).

We do not receive public funding or advertising revenue from state authorities or third countries.

Since 1991, IJ has come to the aid of individuals who want to do the simple things every American has the right to do—including own property, start and grow a business, speak freely about commerce or politics, and provide their children with a good education—but can’t because they find the government in their way.

IJ combines litigation, media relations, strategic research, boots-on-the-ground advocacy and much more to fight on behalf of those individuals who are denied their constitutional rights. IJ is successful in winning over 70 percent of its cases in the court of law, in the court of public opinion or through legislative reforms.  IJ has litigated over 446 cases, including twelve before the U.S. Supreme Court.

IJ has earned Charity Navigator’s top 4-star rating every year since 2001.

Cats of San Bernardino was started by Jaina and Ivy Spagis when they moved to San Bernardino in 2016
from Los Angeles. They were shocked that San Bernardino did not offer free spay and neuter
services like LA and realized that the feral situation in their new neighborhood was out of
control. They began trapping and spaying/neutering feral cats at their own expense, but soon
realized the problem was too big to tackle on their own.

They have converted their home into an animal sanctuary, providing space for kittens and their
mommas waiting for adoption, rehabilitation areas for recovering injured cats, play areas for
healthy cats. With the help of foster families in the city of San
Bernardino they have as many as 50 cats in their care at one time.Their dream is to one day
have a large property/facility which will help save thousands of more lives. This new property
would have catios, feral enclosures, a medical room, nursery, rehabilitation area, and adoption
center.

Welcome to the official YouTube channel of John Gibbons, known worldwide as the BODYMASTER®.

John is a UK-qualified Osteopath, international lecturer, and author. Through his videos, John shares his clinical experience to help therapists and anyone interested in the human body better understand anatomy, injury assessment and treatment techniques.
Explore practical demonstrations and educational content covering joint biomechanics, muscle function, sports injuries, kinesiology taping, mobilisation, manipulation, and exercise therapy.
John is the creator of the Bodymaster Method®, an advanced training programme for therapists including Osteopaths, Chiropractors, Physiotherapists, Sports Therapists, Athletic Trainers, and other healthcare professionals. 
Thank you for subscribing and supporting the channel. Your continued interest inspires me to keep producing educational content and sharing my passion for helping people understand the amazing complexity of the human body.
Cheers,
JG

We are the Wildlife Aid Foundation, a charity rescuing and rehabilitating wildlife across the UK for more than 40 years.
For over 16 years we were featured on the TV show Wildlife SOS. We now share even more behind-the-scenes moments on YouTube from one of the UK’s largest wildlife rescue centres.

Have you ever wondered how a fox ends up stuck in a gate, or how rescuers retrieve a swan from a 50-foot tree? This channel gives you a closer look at the work involved in rescuing and caring for British wildlife.

Our founder, Simon Cowell, dedicated his life to wildlife rescue and his legacy continues through our team as they respond to wildlife emergencies every day. 

Subscribe to stay up to date with our latest rescues and wildlife care.

Website: http://www.wildlifeaid.org.uk/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WildlifeAid
Twitter: https://twitter.com/wildlifeaid
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/wildlifeaid

Jeffrey Peng MD is a nonoperative orthopedist and sports medicine specialist. He created a YouTube channel to translate cutting edge medical knowledge and clinical research to benefit all those looking to live an active and healthy lifestyle. He focuses on maximizing non-surgical treatments for sports injuries and orthopedic conditions. He specializes in using orthobiologics and ultrasound guided minimally invasive techniques to treat osteoarthritis, tendinopathies, and musculoskeletal disorders.

Dr. Peng is board certified in sports medicine and family medicine. He completed residency with the Stanford family medicine residency program and completed his sports medicine training with the Stanford-O'Connor sports medicine fellowship in San Jose. He is a faculty member for both programs and is excited about training the next generation of physicians. 

Dr. Peng currently practices in the San Francisco bay area.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/JeffreyPengMD
Website: www.JeffreyPengMD.com

Hey, fellow animal lovers!🐾

Cuddle Buddies TV is a project of our main channel Cuddle Buddies. 

Here, we share animal stories in a longer format — slow down and enjoy the full journeys of your fav animals! Easy to watch on TV,  on your phone, or to share with friends.
If you want to watch our shorter 3-minute stories, please check out our main channel 👉 https://www.youtube.com/@CuddleBuddiesChannel

All stories published on Cuddle Buddies TV are created together with animal owners, with their permission and involvement.

Cuddle Buddies was created in 2022 by Iegor Bakhariev, and we’re proud to see how the project has grown from a small YouTube channel into one of the biggest animal media. Every day, our team works to bring unique animal stories to the public. Please support us if you can.

We’re always looking for new stories and partnerships. If you’re an animal organization, a media outlet, or you have a story to tell, feel free to reach out using the links below👇

DOG LOVERS...  This is the page for you!

Whether you are a casual dog lover, a seasoned trainer or somewhere in between, my YouTube channel has something for you! This is the best place to find my newest dog training videos, podcasts and more.    

I’ve worked with, trained and evaluated 1000's of dogs.  I have titled and trained obedience & protection dogs as well as pet dogs through my private dog training practice.

Through Bound Angels I instruct animal shelters, SPCA's and humane societies nationwide on canine behavior theory, behavior assessment, dog playgroups and more.   This instruction and knowledge of canine behavior and my rehabilitation techniques have saved countless thousands of dogs from shelters nationwide often giving them their only chance at adoption. 

I want you to have a happy and balanced relationship with your dog.   Let me help you!

My videos are  for all dogs, breeds;  puppies and adults.  

New content constantly added!

NEW VIDEOS EVERY TUESDAY! Self-care is the ultimate healthcare. I’m here to give you knowledge and guided workouts that will help strengthen key parts of your body, lessen pain, restore optimum function, rehab and have fun along the way.  

You can find benefits here for your anatomy from better breathing, more fluid joint mechanics, enhanced balance and, of course, strength.  New topics are always being explored and, if you don’t see a video that matches what you are going through, just let me know in a comment and I’ll do my best to answer your question or create a video for your need, 

If you would like to team up by following along with me and giving yourself the care it needs, this is the channel for you.  I attempt to make the training as safe as possible but please listen to your body and do not push through pain unless I tell you to do so. 

I’m here to serve you.
Be here and be strong!

Dr Adam Fields
Chiropractor
Northern California

Sheldrick Wildlife Trust (SWT) is a global leader in elephant conservation and one of Africa’s most respected wildlife charities. SWT works across Kenya to protect wildlife and preserve habitats through field-based operations and broad community support. At the heart of its work is its pioneering Orphans’ Project — a first-of-its-kind programme to rescue, raise, and rewild orphaned elephants and rhinos.

Backed by 50 years of field experience, SWT delivers practical solutions and long-term impact across Kenya’s most critical landscapes. This channel brings you the latest from the frontlines of conservation: orphan rescues, field operations, and more.

During my career, I’ve given more than 25,000 massages, gaining invaluable experience along the way. While I’ve scaled back my private practice, my passion for massage remains strong, and I’m now focused on teaching and sharing my knowledge.

Massage therapy has given me the honor of helping people heal and thrive. Now, it’s my turn to give back. Through these videos, I hope to inspire and empower anyone interested in massage—whether you’re a student, therapist, or simply curious.

Thank you for watching, learning, and joining me on this journey. Now go out and create a great day!

Core Elements Training was founded by Dawn Morse who has a Masters Degree in Sports and Health Sciences, is a qualified teacher and Sports Therapist. 
Dawn has extensive teaching experience with teaching roles include being the programme leader for the University of Bath Sports Therapy Degree and a Associate Lecturer for the Open University in Sports Science. 

Dawn has had many articles published and has assisted with several research projects. 
Dawn and other qualified tutors at Core Elements Training offer a range of independently accredited Sports Massage and Sports Therapy qualifications and CPD  short courses including: Dry Cupping, Dy Needling, Electrotherapy, Joint Mobilisations and more.  
All courses are available as face to face delivery at the #Swindon Training Centre and wider venues in the #U.K. and abroad.
A selection of courses are also available via Live Online delivery  or fully Online.
To find out more please visit our website.

Ima Survivor Sanctuary was created after the devastating floods from  Hurricane Harvey.  Along with our lone surviving donkey, Ima Jean, our farm now offers a forever home to other surviving farm-animals of the worst natural disaster in US history.  We have opened our doors as a rescue and have become a home to abandoned, abused, and neglected farm animals.  Although we may be a forever home to farm animals in need, we realize that 'we're all survivors of something' and we welcome you to join us as together we heal from life's ups and downs.  

imasurvivorsanctuary@thestation.io

Science-backed, real (not AI) Tai Chi, Yoga Therapy, Qi Gong, breathwork, & meditation to RELIEVE PAIN & RESTORE BALANCE naturally.

Hi, I'm Ann Swanson, MS. My personal struggles with chronic pain and anxiety led me to India to study Yoga, to China to study Tai Chi/Qi Gong, and to earn a Master of Science Graduate Degree in Yoga Therapy. My books, Science of Yoga and Meditation for the Real World, have sold nearly a million copies worldwide in 15+ languages. 

Subscribe for science-backed somatic healing from a real person who cares (not AI). Videos are often less than 15 minutes/day and set in breathtaking nature as my family travels all 63 US National Parks.
Welcome to the calm corner of the internet.

Pakistan’s first YouTube-verified wildlife education channel.
I am Abdul Rahman, also known as “Venom Boy,” from Mandi Yazman, Bahawalpur, near the Cholistan Desert. My wildlife journey started in 2013, I am a professional Survivalist, Self-defence Instructor, Reptile Handler, and Wildlife Documentarian, dedicated to protecting wildlife and promoting animal welfare. Trained by Discovery Channel Instructor Chad Keel.
I have rescued and safely released over 16,000 animals, including snakes, reptiles, and birds. I travel across Pakistan, sometimes barefoot or by bicycle, to explore wildlife, document their behavior, and raise awareness.Wild Rush Mission is to break myths about wildlife passed down through generations, promotes conservation, and encourages safe coexistence between humans and animals.

Subscribe my channel and Join me on this journey, be part of our mission, and help protect wildlife, our ecosystem, and the environment.


✉️: WildRushorg@gmail.com

Every week, Cowboy Jack leads a new virtual field trip to somewhere new and exciting that is fun for the entire family to enjoy.  Experience behind the scenes looks at everything from police cars, fire trucks, and ambulances to things like learning how a bowling alley works or what a dentist does to keep our teeth clean.

Cowboy Jack is a father to Cowboy Kaden and Cowgirl Addison, and genuinely started the show in hopes of providing his own children with quality educational entertainment similar to the great shows he grew up on.  Thank you for trusting Cowboy Jack to entertain your family, and we hope that you find the wholesome content brings everyone together in fun ways!

Our DogsThat YouTube Channel is brought to you by Susan Garrett and her Team. Leading educators of owners of family pet dogs, dog sport competitors and dog trainers. Susan was one of the very first dog trainers to share knowledge online. Susan has helped hundreds of thousands of people enjoy a great relationship with their dogs through her workshops and keynote speaking around the world, award winning books, DVDs, magazine articles, blog posts, podcasts, free dog training and dog agility video series, and online dog training programs. 

Susan is world-renowned for her innovative game-based positive reinforcement training that is grounded in the science of animal behaviour. A life long learner, Susan has been at the cutting edge of online education development since 2008 with her popular classroom Recallers. We are planning even more sharing, education and fun here on our Dogs That YouTube page!

I am a Physical Therapist with 40 years of experience helping people improve their health, reduce pain, & live full, active lives. Over 200,000 people use my books, video workouts, and online courses to improve their bone health, posture, balance, and strength. 

I am the creator of MelioGuide™, the leading online provider of safe and effective osteoporosis exercise programs.

I am the author of three books on exercise and fitness including Amazon bestseller Exercise for Better Bones , Yoga for Better Bones, and Strengthen Your Core. I  trained over 12,000 health professionals how to treat people with osteoporosis.

Subscribe to my channel and hit the notification bell so that you will notified when I publish a new video every Tuesday!

Sign up for my free course on Exercise and Osteoporosis at https://melioguide.com/free-course/

row: Southern California University of Health Sciences

Welcome to SCU!

Southern California University of Health Sciences (SCU) is one of the world’s only integrative, whole health universities—teaching students to blend the best of conventional medicine with proven complementary approaches and to treat the whole person (body, mind, and spirit). Founded in 1911, SCU has been challenging convention and pushing healthcare forward for more than 100 years. Today, the institution offers graduate, undergraduate, and certificate programs in a wide range of disciplines, including Chiropractic, Sports Medicine, Physical & Occupational Therapy, Genetic Counseling, Genetics & Genomics, Medical Science, Physician Assistant, Ayurveda, Acupuncture & Chinese Herbal Medicine, Whole Health Leadership, and beyond. 

Learn more at scuhs.edu.

If you walk, run, lift, ride, hike, swim, or just refuse to sit still, and something’s started to hurt, you’re in the right place.

Active people don’t want to be told to rest. You want to know what’s actually wrong, what fixes it, and how to get back to doing what you love without making it worse.

That’s what this channel is for.

After years working in elite sport and years of running my own physio clinics, I’ve helped thousands of people get out of pain and back to full strength. 

The advice here is the same advice I give my patients and the athletes I’ve worked with, just without the appointment.

Subscribe if you plan on staying active for life. I’ll show you how.

Advanced manual therapy techniques for massage therapists and other allied health professionals. Learn through hands-on demonstrations featuring Erik Dalton and other certified Master Myoskeletal Therapists in action. 

Erik Dalton, Ph.D, was a recognized pioneer in the massage therapy and bodywork community. He was the founder of Freedom from Pain Institute and creator of the Dalton Myoskeletal Alignment Techniques® (MAT), a system of innovative manual therapy techniques borne out of Rolfing, osteopathy, and brain-based approaches to therapy.

Erik Dalton had 30 years of experience teaching MAT and was a faculty member in the Department of Applied Medicine and Rehabilitation at Indiana State University. His legacy continues on through his daughter Dr Adrienne Kesinger and his senior educators. 

For more information visit http://erikdalton.com

Facebook Myoskeletal Alignment Techniques Group https://www.facebook.com/groups/erikdalton/
Instagram https://instagram.com/daltonmyoskeletal

Want to stay on the trail — or the beach, campsite, or wherever the outdoors takes you — without your body pushing back? This channel is for outdoor lovers of all kinds: trail runners, backpackers, and hikers logging serious miles, plus families and weekend warriors who just want beach trips, camping, and playing outside without pain in the way.
Hosted by the sports rehab and sports chiropractic specialists at Performance Place Sports Care in Costa Mesa, CA, we skip generic advice and tackle real training load and biomechanics head-on.
We break down evidence-based rehab for the conditions that sideline active people: lower back pain, hip impingement (FAI), labral tears, sports hernias, plantar fasciitis, and patellofemoral knee pain.
Manage your conditions, move better, and protect your time outside. Visit our Costa Mesa clinic or work with us virtually through multi-state telehealth. Subscribe for practical tips and clinical strategies.

row: Baba Blast! Animal & Dinosaur Videos for Kids

What do we say when things get tough? That’s right: I can do this! I can do this! And, you can do it!

Baba Blast models resilience for young viewers and inspires them to explore their natural world. Baba Blast helps move screen time to playtime and outdoor time! 

Through educational videos for preschoolers, toddlers, and kids who love dinosaurs, animals, music, and adventure. Explore dinosaur videos for kids, animal videos for kids, scavenger hunts, songs, movement, pretend play, and preschool learning designed for early childhood. Baba Blast and his trusty wand, the Blaster, lead fun, story-driven adventures with King Bobo and his mischievous gobos. Along the way, kids build confidence, empathy, curiosity, problem-solving skills, and perseverance. If your child loves dinos, animals, interactive learning, and family-friendly educational entertainment, Baba Blast is here to help them learn, grow, and bounce back strong.

Created by mental health advocate, Kyle Kittleson.

row: Dr. Judy Morgan’s Naturally Healthy Pets

Dr. Judy Morgan has over 39 years experience as an integrative veterinarian, acupuncturist, chiropractor, food therapist, author, and speaker. Dr. Morgan owned and operated two veterinary hospitals that offer an integrative approach combining holistic medicine with traditional western techniques. Her goal is to change the lives of over 10 million pets by educating and empowering pet owners worldwide in the use of natural healing therapies, and minimizing the use of chemicals, vaccinations, and poor quality processed food.

Your Pet's Advocate,
JUDY MORGAN DVM, CVA, CVCP, CVFT

Enoch Wildlife Rescue

The Southwest Wildlife Foundation of Utah DBA Enoch Wildlife Rescue & Gowildlife, was founded in 1997 in Cedar City Utah, we are a 501c3 non-profit organization dedicated to wildlife rescue, rehabilitation and education.

Enoch Wildlife Rescue provides approximately 100 educational outreach programs, reaching over 30,000 people annually, and is based in the Cedar City area.

Enoch Wildlife Rescue cares for approximately 100 sick, injured and orphaned native wildlife each year. Restoring these animals to health and returning them to the wild is our primary goal.

Boston University videos capturing student life, research, campus community and alumni. BU is home to 34,000+ students, 10,000+ faculty and staff members, and one tiny Boston terrier.
 
BU is an international, private research university, committed to educating students to be reflective, resourceful individuals ready to live, adapt, and lead in an interconnected world. We welcome comments on our videos. Just a few guidelines to help us identify and minimize spam:

By all means, share your participation in community events, but please don't use the page to ask for money, even if it's on behalf of a worthy cause. By the same token, it's fine to share if you're running for public office, just don't use the page to campaign. We welcome constructive criticism of BU and its efforts. Please do not, however, use abusive, antagonizing, inappropriate language or spread misinformation. Page administrators reserve the right to remove any content or user that violates these guidelines.

row: At International Animal Rescue we not only save animals from suffering, we also rehabilitate and release them back into the wild and work to protect their precious natural habitats. Our work includes cutting free and caring for captive bears in India and Armenia, rescuing and rehabilitating orangutans and other primates in Indonesia and treating injured and orphaned howler monkeys in Costa Rica. Our aim is to return animals to their natural environment wherever possible, but we also provide a permanent home for those that can no longer fend for themselves.

Struggling with pain, posture issues, or symptoms that haven’t improved with traditional care?
These real, unedited chiropractic visits show how precise neck adjustments can help restore balance and improve how your body functions. Patients travel from around the world to experience this focused, results-driven approach.

Dr. Ace Thayer is a chiropractor based in Costa Mesa, California with over 30 years of clinical experience.

This channel focuses on helping people understand how targeted chiropractic care—especially precise neck adjustments—can improve mobility, reduce discomfort, and support overall body function.

Through real patient cases, Dr. Thayer demonstrates his top-down approach—often referred to as the Thayer Method—which emphasizes the connection between the brain and body.

📍 Costa Mesa, California
🎥 New videos weekly
👉 Subscribe to follow real cases, chiropractic adjustments, and education on improving movement and function

I'm Dr. Dave Candy, a board-certified specialist in orthopedic physical therapy and fellowship-trained orthopedic manual physical therapist, and my goal is to help people over 50 around the world stay active, mobile, and healthy without being held back by pain. 

Having been a physical therapist for 17 years, I've heard too many stories of people being told "You're just getting older. You're going to have to deal with the pain, take pills, or wait until it gets bad enough to have surgery."  But you've got a lot More Life to live after 50, and that's what this channel is all about! 

Check out my playlists to help back pain & sciatica, hip pain, knee pain, neck pain, and shoulder pain, plus tips to improve strength, balance, and mobility.

If you happen to live in the St. Louis, MO area I also have a physical therapy office in St. Louis. Visit online at https://m4lpt.com or call 314-941-3970 to request an appointment. If you live outside of St. Louis, visit https://overfiftycoach.com

Dr Scott Miller, formerly the Vet on the Hill, is now the Rescue Vet. If you love heartfelt stories of rescue pets, need a quick how to guide and top tips to care for your pet, or simply enjoy a laugh, cry and warm virtual hug while watching amazing animal stories, then Rescue Vet is your new happy place.

Dr Scott has over 25 years experience as a Veterinary Surgeon. Originally from Australia, he has worked all over the world including at his practices in the UK, providing dedicated care to all creatures great and small. Now he wants to offer his Veterinary services to those less fortunate, travelling far and wide to help rescue animals and the welfare warriors that care for them.

Rescue Vet is the only channel with fresh and new Dr Scott content, so if you enjoy his warm and caring approach (as seen on Bondi Vet), love cute, cheeky or cuddly animal stories or taking a sneek peek inside a Veterinary practice especially set up with rescue animals in mind, then why not subscribe today!

Hi there! I'm Maija, the founder of Freely Forward Bodywork. As an equine massage therapist, my focus is on enabling your horses’ comfort and performance through the use of massage therapy and stretching techniques. I aim to work with you and enable your horse to perform to its full potential, by analysing and assessing posture, movement, and skeletal function.

From providing a range of services to forming a treatment plan that is an integral part of my approach to treating the whole body, to offering online courses where you can learn effective techniques on how to treat your horse yourself, Freely Forward Bodywork is your go-to hub for equine wellness and performance.

Check out our brand new podcast, NO BUCKS GIVEN, where we have honest conversations about the horse industry with industry professionals about the hard truths around what matters most, how to best advocate for our horses. Subscribe here or anywhere you get podcasts!

My name is Dr. Stacie, I’m a physical therapist and the owner of The Physio Fix, and I’m so happy you’re here! As a former collegiate gymnast-turned-weightlifter, my passion lies in treating barbell athletes and gymnasts. I have also been a strength and conditioning coach for 15 years and a mobility specialist for 7 years and this experience allows me to effectively combine physical therapy with mobility and strength training principles to get you out of pain faster and become stronger and more resilient than ever before! 

This page serves as an educational database and a free resource to the public. You will find many custom Physical Therapy exercises that I use with my patients as well as longer duration videos that go into more detail on various topics related to health, fitness, physical therapy, entrepreneurship, weightlifting, etc.

If you are wanting to work with me, I offer both in-person PT in Phoenix, AZ and remote programming and I would love to see how I can help you!

row: Out on the Ranch (with Dr. Lee)

"Out on the Ranch" is a laid-back, low-stress video visit into the daily life of a Veterinarian/Rancher in South Texas.  These videos are not limited to just vet and ranch happenings, but also include slices of daily life as well.   I'm very dedicated to wildlife on the ranch, and all animals in general at my vet hospital.  So please "relax and enjoy," and consider me your host as we travel and work this old 1890 ranch and a modern veterinary hospital together!  Also, every "now 'n then" I'll throw in a few video snippets of my blues band in action and ask your musical opinions of songs and arrangements we're working on (if you wouldn't mind)!  So THANKS very much for watching; I'd really like to turn this channel into something fun, but I cannot know what works, and what doesn't work unless you respond (by SUBSCRIBING and LEAVING FEEDBACK on each video).  So Please do so;  I'll do my best to not let you down!  Thanks again, and have a great day!    Dr. Lee

row: Dr. Amy Konvalin I Women's Health Specialist

Welcome! I'm Dr. Amy Konvalin, a Women's Health Specialist and physical therapist dedicated to helping women understand what their bodies are trying to tell them.

If you've been told your pain is "normal," leaking is "just part of aging," or you simply have to live with the changes in your body, you're in the right place.

Here you'll learn how your body is connected—from your pelvic floor and core to your jaw, feet, and everything in between. My goal is to help you find the root cause of pain, not just manage symptoms.

You'll find videos on pelvic floor dysfunction, menopause, neuropathy, joint pain, running, healthy aging, and whole-body movement.

My mission is simple: Help women understand their changing bodies so they can move with confidence, live without unnecessary pain, and get back to doing what they love.

Find It. Fix It. Keep It That Way.

Hello brothers and sisters, I'm Agelina Animals RescueAnd Sanctuary.
We are in a very difficult situation. Right now, we are caring for 99 dogs and 36 cats, and we continue rescuing animals from the streets whenever we can. Some of them are sick, and all of them depend on us for food, clean water, medical treatment, and love.
The expenses have become overwhelming. Rent, daily food, and constant vet bills are more than I can manage alone, and I am struggling to keep up.
That is why I am reaching out for help. We are trying to raise $21,000 to give these dogs and cats a chance at life—to keep them fed, treated, and safe.
If you can spare even a small donation, it would mean so much. If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing our GoFundMe with your friends and family. Every share helps.
Together, we can make a difference and give these innocent lives a second chance 🐾

The Society seeks both to promote an awareness of these principles and to further their application through its activities.

Learn more at https://fedsoc.org.

row: The Masterson Method - Integrated Equine Performance Bodywork, is a unique, interactive method of equine massage and bodywork in which you learn to recognize and use the responses of the horse to your touch to find and release accumulated tension in key junctions of the body that most affect performance. In contrast to most traditional modalities, it enables the horse to actively participate in the process of releasing tension. It is something you do with the horse, rather than to the horse. This participation and interaction is what makes the method fascinating for those who use it. In fact, if you do not allow the horse to participate, it does not work!

We are dedicated to helping other fitness professionals become more confident, knowledgeable and excited about their careers, and to help you to becoming better overall in your profession.

We hope that you find our content helpful wherever you are in fitness professional journey!

Galgos del Sol was founded by Tina Solera & is a registered charity (G30856736) based in Murcia, Spain. 

Recently we have been accepted as a registered USA 501c charity & a UK non profit!

We rescue and rehabilitate abandoned and injured Galgos for placement in forever homes in the UK, Europe, and US. Bred solely for hunting, thousands of Galgos are abandoned or killed annually at the end of each short hunting season. 

Galgos are not typically considered as pets in Spain and their lives end in less than humane ways either in perreras (kill stations) or abandoned to a life of persecution on the streets. 

GDS is passionately committed to the welfare of galgos and works tirelessly to educate the public about their plight & are currently raising funds to build an education & rescue centre. You can find out more about the Centre on our webpage www.galgosdelsol.org

Welcome to Veterinary Anatomy, a dedicated educational channel created to bring the fascinating world of animal anatomy to life!

Here, you’ll explore clear, high-quality dissection videos and systematic overviews of the major body systems — skeletal, muscular, nervous, and internal organs — presented with precision and clarity. Each video is designed to help you see, understand, and remember anatomical structures as they appear in real dissections.

We highlight the similarities and differences among the most important domestic animals, including the horse, ox, camel, sheep, goat, dog, and cat. You’ll also find insights from rare and exotic species as we expand our content.

Whether you’re a veterinary or animal science student, a researcher, or simply an animal enthusiast, this channel offers valuable resources to deepen your understanding of the animal body and its incredible adaptations.

Dr. Aiyan, BVM, MSc, PhD
Associate Professor of Veterinary Anatomy

Hello brothers and sisters, I'm Patricia FROM GOOD LUCK Animal shelter And Sanctuary.

We are in a very difficult situation. Right now, we are caring for 25 dogs and 20 cats, and we continue rescuing animals from the streets whenever we can.

Some of them are sick, and all of them depend on us for food, clean water, medical treatment, and love.

The expenses have become overwhelming. Rent, daily food, and constant vet bills are more than I can manage alone, and I am struggling to keep up. That is why I am reaching out for help. We are trying to raise  ( $25,000 ) to give these dogs and cats a chance at life-to keep them fed, treated, and safe.

If you can spare even a small donation, it would mean so much. If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing our GoFundMe with your friends and family. Every share helps.

Together, we can make a difference and give these innocent lives a second chance🙏

CONTACT ME VIA EMAIL 👇👇👇

👉📧 promotelove300@gmail.com

Looking after your pet can be tough! Let me help you understand your dog and cat, allowing you to optimize their health so they can live the long and happy life you want for them.

Hi, I'm veterinarian Dr. Alex Avery. And I want to share my experience and knowledge with you so that you can be confident you are making the best choices for your furry family member. Veterinary care can really add up but it doesn't have to be complicated:

- Find out when and how you can safely treat your pet at home (and when you really do need to see your vet).
- Learn how to avoid the most common diseases and injuries that I see every day in my consult room.
- Discover just how simple preventive healthcare can be!
- And if your furry family member does become unwell or hurt, find out exactly what you need to know to make the right decisions that mean they are soon on the road to recovery.

New videos are released every week so be sure to subscribe + click the bell notification so you never miss out.

We are an amazing sanctuary for feral cats! We are located in Faribault, Minnesota. 

The cats that live here are cats that had to be live trapped as they were completely un-socialized to humans.  

Regular rescues and shelters cannot take in these cats as it can take years for them to be come adoptable.  We have a full time Veterinarian on site for these lucky formerly homeless cats.

Over time, some of these cats gradually learn to trust and love humans and we can adopt them out!  If they don't ever learn to like humans, that is where the word "sanctuary" is important.  They can live out their lives with us.  No threat for euthanasia for lack of space or for being with us too long.  

Please watch our videos and you will see how this truly is a heaven on earth for these cats who lived a life of struggles before coming to us.  Thank you! 😻😻

Jacobs Ridge is a private animal sanctuary in Murcia, Spain offering a forever home to 140+ animals. This includes: horses, pigs, donkeys, goats, sheep, cats and dogs, many of which have been neglected, abused or abandoned. 
We offer all-inclusive volunteer experience breaks, making us not just a sanctuary for animals, but a sanctuary for people too. 

Our mission is to be completely self-sustainable and not rely on hand-outs or donations. However, the pandemic had a massive impact on our funding model and so we have had to turn to other fundraising methods.

We promote a vegan lifestyle because we believe that every being has a right to life and a Life Without Fear.

Donate to our current fundraiser: https://www.gofundme.com/f/jacobs-ridge-infirmary

Sidewalk Specials are a mass sterilisation unit & dog rescue based in the township of De Doorns, South Africa. 

We are PBO approved & can issue Section 18A certificates for donations received. 

NPC 2017/316326/08, NPO 230-918, PBO 930059565, UK CIC 9957429

Sidewalk Specials work through a culture of respect, education & upliftment, helping township families care for their pets.

We provide free vet care with the understanding that sterilisation is mandatory.

We run regular, free mass sterilisation drives in order to control overpopulation.

We provide free kennels for sterilised dogs to ensure they are safe from the elements.

We conduct weekly outreaches & check-ups to integrate with the community, earn their trust and educate the youth on pet ownership & care.

We provide free & effective chemotherapy treatment for dogs with TVT (Transmissible Venereal Tumors).

We safely rehome dogs from cases of abuse and/or severe neglect where education & upliftment are not possible.

Good pet advice should make things clearer, not scarier.

I’m Dr Carra — a veterinarian, practice owner and final-year MSc Animal Nutrition student. This channel helps pet owners make sense of the health, nutrition and behaviour questions that become confusing online, with practical, evidence-led answers and honest context.

You’ll find focused videos on the questions that matter at home: what to notice, what to ask, and what may help. You’ll also find The Paws & Effect Podcast — longer conversations with veterinarians, researchers, behaviourists, welfare experts and others working to improve animal care.

Pet care is rarely black and white. The aim is not to offer easy answers or unnecessary fear, but to help you understand the context, ask better questions and make informed decisions for the animals you love.

Subscribe for useful answers, real conversations and a clearer way through pet health information.

Welcome to Restoration Massage Center. I’m Tim Turnbow, a licensed massage therapist since 2008, Texas Licensed Massage Instructor, and continuing education provider.

This channel helps massage therapists improve their clinical reasoning, treatment techniques, body mechanics, and understanding of common pain and compensation patterns.

You’ll learn practical massage therapy techniques for:

• Shoulder impingement, rotator-cuff issues and neck pain
• Sciatica, lower-back pain and hip compensation
• Prenatal massage and safe client positioning
• TMJ, headaches and upper-body tension
• Trigger point therapy, deep-tissue techniques and cupping
• Corrective exercise, mobility and therapist body mechanics

Massage Therapists check out my online CEUS below

🎓 Online massage therapy CEU courses:
https://restorationmassagecenter.thinkific.com

Subscribe for clinical massage demonstrations, anatomy education, treatment planning and corrective-exercise strategies.

**VetDrLife** सिर्फ एक YouTube चैनल नहीं है —
यह एक **सोच**, एक **जिम्मेदारी**, और एक **वास्तविक जीवन की लड़ाई** है।

यह चैनल उन पलों की कहानी कहता है जहाँ
**जीवन (Life)** और **मृत्यु (Death)** के बीच
एक **Veterinary Doctor** खड़ा होता है —
शांत, दृढ़ और पूरी निष्ठा के साथ।

🕉️ **गीता** हमें कर्तव्य सिखाती है
💉 **Science** हमें लड़ने की शक्ति देता है
🎖️ **अनुशासन** हमें झुकने नहीं देता

VetDrLife पर आप देखेंगे:

* 🐄 गाय, भैंस, बछड़े और पशुओं का **वास्तविक field treatment**
* 🚑 **Emergency cases** – जहाँ हर सेकंड मायने रखता है
* 📚 Veterinary science को **सरल भाषा** में समझाना
* 🌾 Dairy farmers के लिए **practical guidance**
* ⚖️ Life–death की सच्चाई, बिना डर और बिना दिखावे

यहाँ कोई झूठा hero नहीं है।
हर जान नहीं बचती —
लेकिन **कोशिश आख़िरी साँस तक होती है**।

👉 अगर आप एक Vet हैं,
👉 अगर आप एक Dairy Farmer हैं,
👉 या अगर आप जानना चाहते हैं कि असल मैदान में doctor क्या झेलता है —

तो **VetDrLife** आपका ही चैनल है।

**VetDrLife – Duty before fear.
Life before surrender.**
🙏

row: Hi!  I'm Hina Sheth, I have been treating complex orthopedics, sports and pelvic floor physical problems for over 25 years with amazing results.  Now I want to bring my knowledge to the global community so I can spread my knowledge to you. Our bodies are complex systems of 600 muscles and organs intertwined in a fascial system that all work together. Imbalances in this system such as trigger points, visceral and myofascial restrictions can lead to joint, pelvic, and organ issues. Factors like nutrition, exercise, sleep, and stress play a crucial role.  Unfortunately, our current health care model does not look at our bodies as a whole and often times compartmentalize musculoskeletal injuries and dysfunctions.  At Rebalance, our goal is to holistically treat this complex system to restore harmony in the body.  By addressing these imbalances, we help clients improve their overall health and well-being.  Our vision is to empower individuals to create a healthier lifestyle for themselves.

🩶 Subscribe to follow their journeys and help us continue our mission of rescue, rehabilitation, and love.

Boston's Brigham and Women's Hospital, a leading academic medical center, is home to pioneering breakthroughs that have changed lives worldwide. U.S. News and World Report consistently ranks Brigham and Women's Hospital among the nation's top hospitals. A teaching hospital of Harvard Medical School, Brigham and Women's Hospital offers advanced medical care in the following areas:  

Heart and Vascular (heart valve repair, vascular surgery, catheter ablation)
Cancer (radiation therapy, reconstructive breast surgery, prostatectomy)
Neurology (multiple sclerosis therapy, stroke treatment)
Neurosurgery (brain cancer treatment, skull base surgery, deep brain stimulation)
Orthopaedics and Arthritis (joint replacement surgery, arthritis treatment) 
Women's Health (comprehensive obstetric and gynecologic care, in vitro fertilization, gynecological surgery)

Visit https://www.brighamandwomens.org to learn more or call 1-800-294-9999 to speak with one of our patient care coordinators.

Dr. Sue Ettinger is a practicing veterinary cancer specialist, international speaker, book author, & vlogger. She is one of approximately 450 board-certified specialists in medical oncology in North America and currently practices at Guardian Veterinary  Specialists in Brewster, NY. She received her veterinary training at Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine and completed her residency at the Animal Medical Center in NYC in 2003. 

Also known as Dr Sue Cancer Vet®, Dr Sue is the co-author of the Second Edition of The Dog Cancer Survival Guide, a best-selling book in small animal health for the last several years. Dr. Sue is most passionate about raising cancer awareness & has developed “See Something, Do Something, Why Wait? Aspirate.®” to promote early cancer detection and diagnosis. Dr Sue’s popular Facebook page has over 44,000 fans. She can also be found on Instagram, Twitter, and YouTube helping clients and veterinary professionals deal with cancer.

This channel gives viewers a sense of campus life at University College Dublin, Ireland's global university.

UCD first opened its doors in 1854. Today, over 24,000 students from 120 countries study at the university. 
 
James Joyce, the author of Ulysses, completed his BA at the university in 1902.

Other well-known graduates include the author Flann O'Brien, the actors Gabriel Byrne and Brendan Gleeson, film directors Neil Jordan and Jim Sheridan, and former Irish rugby captain Brian O'Driscoll. Numerous Irish Presidents and Taoisigh (Prime Ministers) also studied at UCD including: John Bruton (Prime Minister), John A Costello (Prime Minister), Dr Garret Fitzgerald (Prime Minister), and Cearbhall Ó Dálaigh (President).

Utah State University Extension provides research-based programs and resources with the goal of improving the lives of individuals, families and communities throughout Utah. USU Extension operates through a cooperative agreement between the United States Department of Agriculture, Utah State University, and county governments. Program areas include:

1) Agriculture and Natural Resources
2) Gardening
3) Home, Family, and Food
4) Utah 4-H and Youth

Founded in 1914 as part of the Smith-Lever Act, USU Extension plays a primary role in helping Utah State University fulfill its land-grant mission. Though more than 100 years old, USU Extension is as vital as ever, and perhaps even more so, due to the increased diversity and complexity of the issues people encounter today. The integration of teaching, research, and public service enables USU Extension to respond to critical and emerging issues with research-based, unbiased information.

The goal of this channel is to supply information wrapped in humor in the subject of small animal health. The videos are written, edited and narrated by a veterinarian who has at least a vague understanding of what he's talking about. The coverage of each topic is fact checked by a veterinary expert of the given field.
Stunning special effects... are not the main trait of this channel but their abscence will hopefully not lessen the value of the material too much.
Please keep in mind that the site intends to educate and not provide veterinary consultation on specific cases. You may, of course, ask questions relevant to the topic but diagnosing and curing your pet is the job of your veterinary practitioner! No amount of internet chat can replace a thorough examination and proper treatment based on its results!
I hope you'll find the videos entertaining and useful!

P.S.: Sorry for the occasional hunglish.

I’m Dr. Carl Baird — chiropractor and strength coach — and I help adults 40+ overcome joint pain and arthritis so they can stay active and enjoy life. For the past 12 years, I’ve guided adults in building strength and improving movement — the most powerful way to reduce pain and maintain your lifestyle as you age.

Stay Strong,
Dr. Carl Baird

Wildlife Trust of India (WTI) is a wildlife conservation action institution, established in 1998 in response to the growing challenges facing India’s wildlife and natural habitats. Its mission is to conserve wildlife and its habitats, and to work for the welfare of individual wild animals, in partnership with communities and government agencies.

WTI's central mandate is wildlife crisis management—delivering timely, effective, and science-based interventions to safeguard animals, species, and habitats in distress. The organisation is committed to preventing and mitigating threats through practical, on-ground solutions that drive meaningful and lasting conservation impact.

row: On March 29, 1953, KVTV Channel 9 (the forerunner of KCAU-TV) began broadcasting from an improvised studio at Seventh and Pierce Streets. It was the beginnings of the first television station in Sioux City, Iowa. Later in 1956, Channel 9 moved into a historic building at Seventh and Douglas that previously housed the old Sioux City Auditorium and the Tomba Ballroom. KVTV was then a CBS basic station, that also took delayed programs, via kinescope, from NBC, ABC and the Dumont Network. Videotape wasn't a reality until years later, so everything was live or on film. At this time, an invitation was sent to leaders of all fields throughout the country inviting them to participate in a 21st Century Guesstimate. Whether you are seeking treatment for major/minor ailments or would like to simply sustain your current level of wellness, we are driven to help you comfortably and effectively manage almost any musculoskeletal complaints or ailments.

Peak Performance International | Equine Chiropractic & Performance

This channel explores equine biomechanics, chiropractic care, and performance optimization for horses and riders.

Led by Dr. Arianna Aaron, DC, IVCA, we share educational videos on horse movement, spinal health, rehabilitation strategies, and hands-on treatment techniques used to help performance horses move comfortably and perform at their highest level.

You will learn about:

• Equine chiropractic adjustments
• Horse biomechanics and movement analysis
• Common causes of poor performance in horses
• Rehabilitation and strengthening exercises
• Evidence-based strategies to support soundness and longevity

Whether you are a rider, trainer, veterinarian, or horse owner, this channel helps you understand how the equine body functions and how to keep horses performing comfortably.

The National University Hospital (NUH) is the leading university hospital in Singapore, and a major tertiary and referral institution. While NUH opened its doors on 24 June 1985, its legacy goes back to the founding of what is today the NUS Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine in 1905.  It is the principal teaching hospital of the medical school and the NUS Faculty of Dentistry.

An Academic Medical Centre under Singapore’s National University Health System, NUH provides affordable specialist care for patients, training for healthcare professionals, and undertakes translational bench-to-bedside research to improve care.

It is the only public and not-for-profit hospital in Singapore to offer a comprehensive suite of specialist care for adults, women and children, as well as paediatric kidney and liver transplant programme.

Visit our website at www.nuh.com.sg

Farm Sanctuary was founded in 1986 to combat the abuses of factory farming and to encourage a new awareness and understanding about "farm animals." At Farm Sanctuary, these animals are our friends, not our food.

Over the years, we have rescued thousands of animals, and educated millions of people about their plight. People are shocked to learn about the intolerable conditions that are commonplace on today's industrialized farms.

Our rescue and education work continues, as we advocate for laws and policies to prevent suffering and promote compassion. We are reaching out to legislators and businesses, and working to bring about institutional reforms.

Please visit www.farmsanctuary.org for more information.

Today, it is the third-largest public health care system in the nation and highly regarded for its exceptional patient- and family-centered care. Memorial's patient, physician and employee satisfaction rates are some of the most admired in the country, and the system is recognized as a national leader in quality health care.

Memorial Regional Hospital is the flagship facility of the health care system and is one of the largest hospitals in Florida. Memorial Regional Hospital offers extensive and diverse health care services that include Memorial Cardiac and Vascular Institute featuring renowned surgeons, Memorial Cancer Institute treating more inpatients than any other in Broward County, and Memorial Neuroscience Center providing innovative technology and world-class physicians.

Skydog Sanctuary is a 501c3 non-profit that rescues at-risk mustangs and burros across the United States from neglect, abuse and mistreatment as well as reunites families of mustangs separated during roundups where possible.  Our equally important mission is to educate, inform and raise awareness of wild horse and burro issues to inspire others to get involved also.   Wildness matters.  Mustangs matter.

Right now America’s wild horses are being threatened with being killed or sterilized by the Government and this is unacceptable and wrong. There are over 44,000 wild horses currently locked up in BLM holding pens across the American West and they need our help NOW. There are better humane ways to manage wild horses on the range without roundups and holding pens.

row: The Royal College of Pathologists is a charity with over 13,000 members worldwide. The majority of members are doctors and scientists working in hospitals and universities in the UK. The College oversees the training of pathologists and scientists working in 17 different specialties, which include cellular pathology, haematology, clinical biochemistry and medical microbiology. Although some pathologists work in laboratories, many work directly with patients in hospitals and the community. Together, they are involved in the majority of all diagnoses and play an important role in disease prevention, treatment, and monitoring. If you have ever had a blood test, cervical smear or tissue biopsy, a pathologist will have been involved in your care.

We support them with state-of-the-art equipment and technology and provide their families with the compassion and information needed to make recovery a reality. Patients from around the country are drawn to our beautiful 105-acre campus with magnificent Hudson River views, located 35 minutes north of New York City.

Welcome to AMR Physiotherapy!

We’re here to guide you on your journey to a healthier, stronger, and more balanced body.

Our focus spans three key areas:
- Rehab to recover from pain and injuries
- Gym training to reduce future injury risks
- Longevity to keep you moving and feeling great for years to come.

If you’ve been hitting the gym or playing sports but are now dealing with more niggles or injuries, this channel is for you. We’ll help you stay fit, look good, and adopt a health-first, well-rounded training approach.

At AMR Physiotherapy, we believe that strengthening often-overlooked areas—like the neck and lower back—should be just as common as training biceps or chest. By addressing these neglected muscles and movements, we aim to help you stay resilient, reduce pain, and enjoy long-term health.

Join us to explore practical rehab tips, targeted exercises, and training techniques that keep your body balanced, strong, and ready for whatever life throws your way.

I'm Dr. Ryan Gleeson — chiropractor, founder of Gorilla Chiropractic in Perth, Australia, and builder of chiropractors who refuse to stay stuck.

My chiro journey started as a lean solo operation. Then, in 2017, I went bankrupt. I rebuilt into a multimillion-dollar clinic and now I'm off the tools, scaling Gorilla Chiro and developing leaders.

I know how little guidance chiropractors have and how they want more impact, volume, income, and life.

So, I built a methodology that helps chiros not just clinically, but through systems, mindset, self-awareness, and belief structures.

My mission is to develop the profession — to build chiropractors who aren't your typical conventional doctor, who serve with impact, make great money, and live great lives.

Some things to know:
- Combined 400k following across platforms
- Brazilian jiu-jitsu brown belt
- Worked with world champions
- Trained with some of the best coaches

New videos weekly on what no one else in chiropractic is teaching.

Our articles are written, developed, and reviewed by leading veterinarians, professional journalists, and animal health experts, so you get the most current advice and thinking on everything from finding the right puppy or kitten to dealing with serious medical conditions.

We also cover fun events (dock diving, pet parades), track trends (pets in pop culture), review great products (sleek cat toys and cushy dog beds), and explore all the things that make having a pet so amazing.

row: Dr. Lera @ Heron Lakes Animal Hospital

Dr. Abel Lera DMV is the owner of Heron Lakes Animal Hospital.

We are a full-service animal hospital specializing in dogs & cats since 2005. Dr. Lera acquired HLAH in 2013. He is a graduate of Mississippi State University and the University of Florida. Our team, lead by him, performs veterinary medicine and compassionate animal care in the Coral Springs/Parkland area in South Florida. 

This channel's purpose is to educate, inform & help. We cover a wide variety of topics regarding dogs and cats' medical issues, common concerns, treatments and more. We are always willing to take any suggestions from our viewers, so please feel free to contact us with any of them.

DISCLAIMER: The content provided in this channel is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your veterinarian or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition.

Don’t forget to SUBSCRIBE!

row: The Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) aims to create a vibrant care community for people to live well and age gracefully. AIC coordinates and supports efforts in integrating care to achieve the best care outcomes for our clients. We reach out to caregivers and seniors with information on staying active and ageing well, and connect people to services they need. We support stakeholders in their efforts to raise the quality of care, and also work with health and social care partners to provide services for the ageing population. Our work in the community brings care services and information closer to those in need. For more about us, please visit https://www.aic.sg.

UW Health is proud to be the Official Health Care Partner of the Green Bay Packers.

Welcome to the YouTube Channel for Pressure Point Sports Massage Training.
I specialise in Sports Massage, deep tissue techniques for the whole body with a particular interest in back massage and anatomy.  I teach VTCT sports massage from Level 3 to Level 5 which includes gait analysis, neuro-spinal assessment, palpation techniques, advanced anatomy, orthopaedic techniques, postural assessment and joint range of movement at my clinic in Arnold, Nottingham (UK).  

I have just released my first book "Your Journey to Massage Confidence: From First Client to Established Practice" available on Amazon:  https://amzn.eu/d/01mBEqe6 

Pressure Point Training also delivers a range of accredited Sports Massage, acupuncture, rehab, anatomy and holistic courses. All courses are available as face to face delivery at our training centre such as reflexology, pregnancy massage, , hot stone #massage , taping, #anatomy , manual lymphatic drainage, fire cupping and rehabilitation.

I have completed my MSc in Physiotherapy from University College London and am working as a Band 6 Physiotherapist in NHS. Through this channel, I hope to help international graduates understand the many ways they can get their registration and work as Healthcare Professionals in the UK.

If you would like to contact me, find me at https://www.physiotherapyinuk.com/

Welcome to my channel! If you're passionate about holistic animal care, animal rescue, and all things animals, you're in the right place! My videos focus on animal massage, kinesiology taping, and various holistic therapies, along with behind-the-scenes glimpses of the animals at my sanctuary. You’ll also find videos about my travel adventures, interviews with animal health professionals, and plenty of cute and fun moments with the sanctuary animals.

Whether you’re a dog or horse owner looking for ways to support your animal’s health or a professional seeking new techniques to add to your practice, you’ll find valuable content here.

Discover more at www.HolisticAnimalStudies.org, and follow us on Instagram @holistic_animal_studies and TikTok @DrAngel811 for more updates and animal fun!

To help global physiotherapists, optometrists and nurses establish extensive careers, Academically has come up with this new interactive platform. This page is a one-stop solution for physiotherapists, optometrists and nurses who wish to migrate abroad and make the most of their careers. 

We will discuss the career options for physiotherapists, especially the Australian Physiotherapy Council (APC Exam), which permits physiotherapists to migrate to Australia. 

Another exam for which we’ll create and share informative videos is the OCANZ Competence in Optometry Examination (COE), which helps global optometrists register in Australia. 

Here, we will also talk about the NCLEX exam that allows you to practice as a registered nurse in Australia, New Zealand, USA, Canada and a few other countries. 

So, if you are an optometrist, a nurse or a physiotherapist, subscribe to this channel for latest industry updates.

Please fill up this form:
https://academically.com/contact-us/

As one of the nation's leading animal welfare organizations, AHS is transforming the way shelters care for animals and engage their communities. From innovative medical and behavior programs to investments in outreach and advocacy, we’re advancing animal welfare and creating a more humane world for animals everywhere.

Mission
To engage the hearts, hands, and minds of the community to help animals.

Vision
To compassionately and responsibly create a more humane world for animals.

Values
- Be good to animals. Act kindly and think progressively to improve the lives of animals.
- Partner with people. Harness the creativity and passion of people through collaboration and teamwork.
- Lead responsibly with compassion. Inspire trust through leadership that balances the head and heart.

Bronx Chiropractor - Dr. Ralph Napolitano has come to be known for his entertaining and informative chiropractic adjusting videos on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.

He currently sees patients as The Bronx Chiropractor in The Bronx, NY. 

People have traveled hours to see him from New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania and from states all over the United States.

He specializes in Y-Strap Adjustments in NYC that help reduce the pressure, tension and stress that has built up in your spine and nervous system due to repetitive stress motion in poor posture.

Dr. Ralph says, “How you sit, stand, lift, bend and sleep has a direct affect on your spine and nervous system and slowly breaks it down over time causing you pain, discomfort and poor health.”

His unique adjusting techniques put him in the top 1% of chiropractors in the world and help relieve the tension, stress and pressure on your spine and nervous system so you can move better, feel better and live better.

Namaste Everyone,
Our journey started in 2020 with a simple goal—to share real experiences as internationally educated physiotherapists navigating life, licensing exams (NPTE & PCE), and careers in Canada and the USA.
What began as a small initiative has grown into MM Physio, now with three active clinics in Cambridge, Guelph, and Kitchener (2026), helping hundreds of patients every month with pain relief, rehabilitation, and better mobility.
On this channel, we share:
• Physio career guidance & licensing journey
• Student & work-life experiences
• Clinical insights & treatment approaches
• Business growth & clinic-building journey
We’re a passionate team committed to helping patients live pain-free while supporting physiotherapists in building successful careers.
All content is based on real experiences—always do your own research.
Join us on this journey 🚀

My name is Greg Schaible and as a Sports Rehab Physical Therapist I work with a lot of athletes and active individuals to overcome injuries like shoulder pain, knee pain or lower back stiffness. This physiotherapy channel aims to help athletes and regular people prevent injuries as well as speed up and increase the recovery rates! 

If you like working out at the gym, playing sports, and living an active lifestyle. Then this channel will help you increase muscle strength, tendon resiliency, improve mobility and reduce aches and pains. 

My Clinic is On Track Physiotherapy where we help people in Ann Arbor, Michigan as well as ANYONE at a distance through our online training programs.

https://www.annarbor.physio

Additionally, I own a Sports Rehab Education company called Sports Rehab Expert which helps rehab clinicians and strength coaches improve results with their clients!

https://www.sportsrehabexpert.com

You can be your dog's hero!  We share tips, training, and fun stuff to make life better for you and your dog!

I am a dog trainer and border collie (and many other breed) lover who continually learns and practices new skills. I believe that the dog in front of you has a lot to teach you. 

My dogs have had health issues (epilepsy is one) and behavior challenges (including severe separation anxiety), so I've learned about effective, science based forms of dog training. Your dog, whether sweet, excitable, mischievous or extra smart,  has something to teach you. A challenging dog challenges us to learn more! I hope this dog vlog inspires you to understand and interact more with your amazing dog!

Macquarie University is a major Australian public teaching and research university located in Sydney. Founded in 1964 by the New South Wales Government, it enjoys a beautiful 126 hectare, park-like campus close to the high-technology corridor running from Sydney's north-west to the city.

The University enrols about 35,000 students across four faculties - Business and Economics, Arts, Science, and Human Sciences -- and employs more than 2000 staff. Macquarie is an international university, with 12,000 of its current students coming from more than 117 countries, and alumni found worldwide.

Macquarie has been consistently ranked in the top 10 universities in Australia and among the top 200-300 universities in the world by various sources.
