One of the largest and busiest acute hospital trusts in the country, our vision is to provide the highest quality specialist and integrated care. 

We are incredibly proud of the work we do across our seven hospitals in Leeds. Our state-of-the-art facilities enable us to deliver high-quality hospital services for the people of Leeds, Yorkshire and the Humber and beyond.

We play an important role in the training and education of medical, nursing and dental students, and are a centre for world-class research, innovation and pioneering new treatments.  

Our workforce of 20,000 staff are central to everything we do here at Leeds Teaching Hospitals and our reputation for specialist care, research and academic training is down to their hard work and dedication.

Our seen hospitals are: 
Leeds General Infirmary
St James's University Hospital
Chapel Allerton Hospital
Leeds Children's Hospital
Seacroft Hospital
Wharfedale Hospital
Leeds Dental Institute

row: Veterinary Channel delivers expert guidance on veterinary medicine and pet health. Run by a practicing veterinarian, we demystify dog health, cat health, equine medicine and exotic animal care through clear tutorials and case studies. Our playlists cover everything from veterinary neurology, dermatology, cardiology, oncology and nutrition to endocrinology, pharmacology, toxicology and gastroenterology. You’ll also find vet school lectures, NAVLE and ECFVG review sessions, zoonotic disease discussions, public health topics and inspiring pet rescue stories. Short “veterinary capsules” offer quick tips, while longer lectures dive into internal medicine, surgery and behavioral issues. Whether you’re a veterinarian, student or pet owner, subscribe to learn, stay updated and join a community dedicated to better animal care

The University of Queensland's Faculty of Science is recognised as a powerhouse for some of the world’s leading scientists, teachers, science programs and commercial outcomes.

The Faculty of Science unites the disciplines of agriculture and animals, biomedical and biological sciences, chemistry, earth sciences, food sciences, geography, marine science, maths and physics, planning, the environment and veterinary science.

With strong links between the enabling and applied sciences, UQ researchers and graduates are working on a wide range of groundbreaking projects from the molecular characterisation of drug resistant bacteria that affect piglets through to finding better treatments for illness and rehabilitation of the environment.

Ranked in the top 1% of universities in the world, UQ offers one of the widest choices of science disciplines in Australia.

Social Media Terms of Use: https://uq.edu.au/legal/social-media-terms-use/

Health4theworld Academy aims to build the largest online free of cost educational channel in medicine to provide reliable education from the leading close to 100 medical professors from top institutions worldwide. This multiple speciality channel includes content for doctors, medical students, residents, fellows, community health care workers, nurses and allied medical staff. We believe every health care professional should have free of cost access to life saving knowledge from the best to save lives of their patients. 
Join the movement to spread this knowledge by subscribing to this channel and sharing it with your friends.
Please see the disclaimer page https://health4theworld.org/academy/medical-content-disclaimer/

TSAOG Orthopaedics & Spine, formerly The San Antonio Orthopaedic Group, was established by John J. Hinchey, MD, and has been a long-time provider of quality orthopaedic care since 1947. With a commitment to providing the highest standards of medical and surgical care, TSAOG has become the largest orthopaedic practice in San Antonio and South Texas. 

The physicians at TSAOG specialize in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries of the musculoskeletal system, including:

Joint replacement
Sports medicine injuries
Arthroscopic surgery
Spine treatment
Care and surgery of the shoulder, elbow, hand, wrist, knee, foot and ankle 

We also offer additional services, including:

Hand therapy and physical therapy
Industrial rehabilitation
Worker’s comp
Digital imaging
Outpatient surgery
Orthopaedic urgent care

Our goal is to improve the lives of everyday folks by helping them spend less time worrying about their finances and more time enjoying their lives.

Subscribe and be part of the journey—every wild, muddy, beautiful step.

Hello everyone,
I am, Dr. Akshay Kumar PT and I welcome you to my YouTube channel, where I'll be sharing my expertise on various topics related to physiotherapy!

As a physiotherapist, I'm passionate about helping people recover from injuries, manage pain, and improve their overall physical function. On this channel, you'll find lectures covering a wide range of subjects, including exercise therapy, electrotherapy, PT Ortho, PT neuro, PT cardio, and PT gyne.

My goal is to provide you with accurate information that's easy to understand and apply. If you are a medical student & interested in learning more about these subjects, my hope is that you'll find my videos informative, engaging, and helpful.

So, if you're ready to deepen your knowledge of physiotherapy and improve your clinical skills, be sure to subscribe to my channel and hit the notification bell so you never miss an update. Thanks for tuning in!

Contact with us:
Mail : sedativedoctor@gmail.com
Instagram: @sedative_physio

row: Gohl Clinic Of Chiropractic- Gonstead Chiropractor

Gohl Clinic of Chiropractic – your trusted source for Gonstead chiropractic care in North County San Diego, proudly serving Carlsbad, Encinitas, Oceanside, Vista, San Marcos, Escondido, Rancho Santa Fe, La Costa, Camp Pendleton.

We specialize in the Gonstead System, a precise, science-based approach to chiropractic that targets the root cause of spinal issues. Using detailed analysis and specific adjustments, we help restore alignment and function without unnecessary rotational force.

We care for patients with:

Back and neck pain

Migraines and headaches

Disc injuries and sciatica

Poor posture and nerve issues

Sports and accident-related injuries

All organic conditions

Whether you're in pain or seeking peak function, we’re here to help.

🌐 Learn more at www.gohlclinic.com
🔔 Subscribe for real patient stories, Gonstead education, and wellness tips.

All videos are for educational purposes only.  Please refer to disclaimer http://gohlclinic.com/disclaimer/.

row: Dr. Muhammad Awais Sidhu (DVM) | Veterinary Doctor

Welcome to the official channel of Dr. Muhammad Awais Taib Sidhu (DVM, RVMP). I run Sidhu Vet Clinic in Bahawalnagar, Pakistan. I work as a veterinary doctor, surgeon, and dairy consultant with 8 years of experience in dairy farm management and fieldwork across Pakistan. I am a veterinary doctor and dairy consultant with hands-on experience managing commercial dairy farms. I created this channel to share my work and knowledge with the veterinary community, dairy vets, and veterinary students.

I have managed new startup dairy projects at Ibrahim Poultry Traders and Montgomery Protein Pvt. Ltd. I also worked at Interloop Pvt. Ltd. Dairy, Sheikhupura, and Al Noor Dairy Farm, Multan.

row: Arctic Fox Daily Wildlife Rescue, Inc.

I'm Kim, President and Founder of Arctic Fox Daily. At our unique, home-based sanctuary, we provide a forever home to unwanted, neglected, abandoned, or confiscated captive-bred and non-releasable wildlife, specializing in foxes and wolfdogs.

I also volunteer my time raising orphaned and/or injured New York-native wildlife, with the ultimate goal being release back into nature - where they belong.

I rescued wildlife as a licensed individual for over a decade, and then officially founded Arctic Fox Daily Wildlife Rescue, Inc. in 2020, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. We rely fully on contributions from our amazing supporters. The more support we receive, the more animals we can help. Follow @arcticfoxdaily on our other platforms, and visit www.arcticfoxdaily.org to learn more or to see the different ways you can show support.

I'm making my childhood dreams of rescue come true, while raising two babies of my own, Ella and Clay. Thanks for tagging along on our rescue journey!

She now focuses on empowering proactive parents through her books, blog, and her YouTube channel. Follow along on her travels and get behind the scenes content - https://www.instagram.com/drlaurenbaker

Order the newest learning to crawl book here: https://drlaurenbaker.com/learning-to-crawl-book

Audio podcast uploads are varied & comments are responded to monthly. Video uploads coming back 2028.

Welcome to the Pet World Insider!

Pet World Insider is a program filled with inside information about the pet world.  The pet world is an incredibly large and diverse world filled with many hidden treasures amongst the obvious delights.  We want to shine a bright light on all the things that pet lovers need to know and want to know about.

The host of Pet World Insider is Robert Semrow.  Robert is well-known and respected throughout the pet world.  He is a author, lecturer and actively involved in the pet world. Robert can be heard weekly on more than 130 radio stations across country, plus XM.   Robert and his team will bring the creativity and expertise that he is known for to share wonderful stories and news about the animals, their people, the products and everything that makes the pet world an interesting and rewarding experience.

Our goal is to share the information with all pet lovers throughout the world.

Hello and welcome to my channel!

My name is Johanna Janatuinen, I´m a physiotherapist, animal physiotherapist and riding instructor. A big passion of mine has always been training horses and also rehabilitation. This channel is all about horse and rider wellbeing, and horse and rider training and development. You will find tips to improve your riding in and out of the saddle, and especially on how to develop a better seat in the saddle, which I think all good riding eventually comes down to.

I have worked with horses and riders for more than 20 years, first training horses and teaching riding in Finland where I live and also abroad. Later I studied to become a physiotherapist and after that also specialized in animal physiotherapy. I treat and train horses and riders, my biggest focus being to develop the connection and understanding between rider and the horse.

row: Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research

Sri Ramachandra Medical College and Research Institute (Deemed to be University), ranked among the top health sciences universities in India, had its origin as Sri Ramachandra Medical College and Research Institute which was established by Sri Ramachandra Educational and Health Trust in the year 1985 as a private not-for-profit self-financing institution and dedicated to serve the society as a centre of excellence with emphasis on medical education, research and health care. The Trust achieved the task of establishing the Institution as a “Centre of Excellence” under the leadership of Late Shri. N.P.V.Ramasamy Udayar who was the Founder & Managing Trustee of the Trust and also the first Chancellor of the Deemed to be University. Shri. V.R. Venkataachalam is currently the Chancellor of the Deemed to be University and is also the Managing Trustee of the Trust.

My name is Kate and I am a physiotherapist. I graduated from the medical university and I work as a physiotherapist with children and adults. 

YouTube is just a hobby. I thought that it can be nice to share my knowledge with you. So on this channel you will find videos related to health, rehabilitation and physiotherapy. I am a practitioner, so I will share with you my insights and professional experiences. But besides, I’m a huge fan of Evidence Based Medicine, so in every post and movie I make you’ll find references to scientific research.

There are no product ads on this channel (and never will). At most, I will occasionally criticize products that I (and scientists) believe are useless.

Hope you enjoy the content,

Kate

row: Jenn Chew | Vancouver Physiotherapist for Runners

Hi, I'm Jennifer Chew, a Registered Physiotherapist and co-owner of Form Physiotherapy in Vancouver, BC.

I specialize in helping runners, athletes, lifters, and active individuals recover from injuries, improve performance, and move stronger.

On this channel, you'll find evidence-based physiotherapy advice on:
• Running injuries & rehabilitation
• Achilles tendinopathy, plantar fasciitis & knee pain
• Running biomechanics & gait analysis
• Strength training & injury prevention

With years of experience treating recreational runners to competitive marathoners, my goal is to simplify movement science and help you train smarter.

I practice at Form Physiotherapy in Vancouver, providing evidence-based care for runners and active individuals.

📍 Form Physiotherapy Vancouver
🌐 www.formphysiotherapy.com

Maria Teresa Ferrer, a Doctor in Physical Therapy, is dedicated to transcending geographical barriers, empowering families and practitioners worldwide to optimize care for their children. With an unwavering commitment to advancing knowledge, she actively involves therapists in exploring innovative approaches such as Dynamic Flex Cast, Brachial Plexus Injury Treatment, Movement Inhibition Therapy, Neuro-Connection therapy, and more through comprehensive continuing education courses.

Her expertise, refined over 25 years, extends to a diverse range of conditions, including Brachial Plexus Injuries, Cerebral Palsy, Cortical Vision Impairments, Spina Bifida, Stroke, and various neurological disorders. Maria Teresa's mission goes beyond clinical practice; she generously imparts valuable insights to therapists and parents through weekly tips on social media, fostering a community dedicated to integrating effective strategies into children's treatment and home care plans.

row: Established in 1980, The Wild Animal Sanctuary is a state and federally licensed zoological facility and a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. We currently operate three accredited facilities within the United States and travel the world to rescue captive exotic and endangered large carnivores that have been abused, abandoned, exploited or illegally kept. Once the rescued animals arrive at our state of the art facility, they are rehabilitated and provided with veterinary care. Thereafter, we provide our rescued animals with a forever home and place them in large natural habitats. We operate two facilities within Colorado, and one in Texas, totaling more than 40,000-acres, and currently care for more than 950 Lions, Tigers, Bears, Wolves and other rescued animals! We are the largest and oldest network of sanctuary facilities in the World.

Project Street Vet is a 501 (c)(3) non-profit public charity that provides free veterinary care, treatment, and support to the pets of individuals experiencing homelessness and/or housing vulnerability. 

Project Street Vet was founded by Dr. Kwane Stewart, who for the past decade has provided free veterinary care to pets of people experiencing homelessness – walking areas of high homelessness to seek pets and pet parents in need. You can read his full bio here.

We are committed to protecting the human-animal bond that is so vital to the livelihood of pets and the people who love them. Leading with compassion, kindness, and no judgements, will we seek out and assist the pets and people who need it most.

row: Clark County is a dynamic and innovative organization dedicated to providing top-quality service with integrity, respect and accountability.  With jurisdiction over the world-famous Las Vegas Strip and covering an area the size of New Jersey, Clark is the nation’s 11th-largest county and provides extensive regional services to 2.4 million citizens and 43 million visitors a year. Included are the nation’s 7th-busiest airport, air quality compliance, social services and the state’s largest public hospital, University Medical Center. The County also provides municipal services that are traditionally provided by cities to 1 million residents in the unincorporated area. Those include fire protection, roads and other public works, parks and recreation, and planning and development.

The Royal Wolverhampton NHS Trust is one of the largest acute and community providers in the West Midlands having more than 800 beds on the New Cross site including intensive care beds and neonatal intensive care cots. 
It also has 80 rehabilitation beds at West Park Hospital and 54 beds at Cannock Chase Hospital.As the second largest employer in Wolverhampton the Trust employs more than 8,000 staff. 
The Trust provides its services from the following locations:
New Cross Hospital - secondary and tertiary services, maternity, Accident & Emergency, critical care and outpatients. 
West Park Hospital - rehabilitation inpatient and day care services, therapy services and outpatients.
More than 20 Community sites - community services for children and adults, Walk in Centres and therapy and rehabilitation services
Cannock Chase Hospital – general surgery, orthopaedics, breast surgery, urology, dermatology, and medical day case

The mission and philosophy of NTVS is to provide pet owners options in the treatment of their animals. We are dedicated to providing these options through the combination of alternative and complementary medicine with conventional medicine.

We believe that incorporating all reasonable therapies or systems of medicine together provides the veterinarian with the most ability to treat and prevent disease. This type of veterinary care focuses on the whole animal and disease prevention - not just on the treatment and suppression of symptoms.

NTVS is located at 6614 Hwy 100 Nashville, TN 37205. You can call us at 615.750.2248, email us at nashville@ntvs.vet, or chat with us at www.franklintnvet.com. We also offer telemedicine consults and second opinions to clients in all 50 states and even outside the USA.

Being “double-jointed” isn’t harmless!

Welcome! I’m Dr. Linda Bluestein, an EDS patient & physician specializing in Ehlers-Danlos Syndromes & related disorders. I founded Hypermobility MD & Bendy Bodies to challenge outdated narratives & give people real answers, not dismissal.

Connective tissue disorders often mean chronic pain, repeated injuries, fatigue, autonomic symptoms, & bodies that don’t behave the way medicine expects them to. This channel exists to make sense of that complexity.

Each week, I share myth-busters, expert interviews, & practical strategies for managing pain, joint instability, fatigue, POTS, MCAS, & more. These conversations bridge science & lived experience—& remind us that being hard to diagnose is not the same as being difficult.

Subscribe & turn on notifications so you don’t miss anything.

Instagram: @hypermobilitymd

Disclaimer: Content is educational & not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your own healthcare professional.

Welcome to the official YouTube Channel of St. George's University, a globally focused higher education institution with its main campus located in Grenada, West Indies. 

Founded as an independent School of Medicine in 1977, SGU has evolved into a top center of international education, drawing students and faculty from 140 countries. Students enjoy the benefits of a thriving multicultural environment, offering amenities and technologically-advanced facilities.

SGU's nearly 31,000 graduates include physicians, veterinarians, scientists, and public health and business professionals across the world. We offer advanced, pre-med, and pre-vet degrees, and independent and dual graduate degrees in the sciences, public health, and business. Undergraduate degree programs are also available. Programs are accredited and approved by many governing authorities and repeatedly recognized as the best in the region. SGU is also affiliated with educational institutions worldwide.

The University of Minnesota College of Veterinary Medicine affects the lives of animals and people every day through educational, research, service, and outreach programs. We are dedicated to the education of future and current veterinarians and biomedical scientists and the discovery of new knowledge and skills.

Established in 1947, the University of Minnesota College of Veterinary Medicine is Minnesota’s only veterinary college. Fully accredited, the college has graduated nearly 4,000 veterinarians and hundreds of scientists. The college is also home to the Veterinary Medical Center, the Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory, the Leatherdale Equine Center and The Raptor Center.

row: This channel is built for veterinarians, technicians, horse owners, and veterinary students who know equine dentistry is more than smoothing a few points — it’s one of the most impactful ways to improve a horse’s health. Dr. Nick Moore has dedicated his career to equine dentistry, training and teaching across the U.S. and internationally while shaping a thoughtful, horse-centered approach grounded in anatomy, precision, and clinical reasoning. His work includes standing oral extractions, minimally invasive oral surgery, oral–nasal sinus procedures, and advanced diagnostic techniques — all performed on the sedated, standing horse. No shortcuts. No theatrics. Just evidence-guided dentistry that puts the horse first. Here, he shares what actually matters: real cases, practical techniques, diagnostic thinking, and the subtle details that elevate outcomes. If you want to see equine dentistry differently and raise the standard of care for the horses in your life — you’re in the right place.

Subscribe to follow our journey, meet our amazing residents, and be part of a movement that values every life. Together, we can change the world—one rescue at a time! ❤️

There's a battle between manmade massage gadgets & the human touch. Technology will forever improve, will we? Feel for more, don’t just pet.

Zion Massage College is located in the beautiful Green Valley area of St. George Utah. The college offers an accredited 900 hour professional massage therapy program, which is focused on Eastern Bodywork and Deep/Structural based massage. The mission of ZMC is to educate well-trained, compassionate and knowledgeable massage therapy professionals with a commitment to the health and well-being of the community and to their clients. Visit www.zmc.edu for more info

In addition to the professional massage therapy program, ZMC offers continuing education opportunities for licensed massage therapy professionals such as, advanced courses in Thai Massage, Ashiatsu, Gua-Sha and Chinese Cupping Massage. ZMC encourages and supports life-long learning for its students, staff members and for the St. George community.

ZMC also offers free and low-cost Community Classes in Meditation, Qi-Gong, Yoga, Couples Thai Massage and Reflexology.

Saving Animal Centers is a channel about animal rescue, rehabilitation, and the people who give animals a second chance.

On this channel, you will find videos about different animal rehabilitation centers, wildlife hospitals, sanctuaries, rescue shelters, and organizations that help injured, abandoned, or endangered animals.

We share real stories inspired by volunteers, rescuers, animal care workers, and rehabilitation centers from around the world. Some events may be recreated with the help of AI to better show the rescue journey, but the goal is always the same - to raise awareness, support kindness, and show how important animal rescue work really is.

Every animal deserves care, safety, and hope.

Have a rescue video or animal story to share? Contact us: admin@savinganimalcenters.help

The new animal web series Exotic Pet Vet brings you through the exam room door and into the colorful and chaotic world of Dr. Dan and his colleagues Dr. Leo and Dr. E. Our cameras are there to capture the revolving door of unusual animals with strange ailments that visit this specialized veterinarian practice on a daily basis.

Each episode features real life scenarios that are followed from diagnosis through treatment with actual care tips and specific medical information vital to exotic pet owners. Some of these medical procedures are shown for the first time ever on television.  Also presented are interesting facts about each animal, footage of the pets in their home habitats and interviews with the owners.

Whether you have an exotic pet, or you're just fascinated by rare animal species, the Exotic Pet Vet Series illustrates the joys (and challenges) of owning some of the cutest and most interesting creatures on earth.

About 90 percent of people with a cervical herniated disc (slipped disc) diagnosis get better without needing surgery. The more you know about your condition, the easier it will be for you to improve. To help, Board-Certified MD spine specialists treating herniated discs for over 20 years present videos on everything you need to know about a slipped disc, from diagnosis to non-surgical and surgical treatment options. 

Learn what a cervical disc herniation is and what the symptoms are. Find out how to avoid surgery, how to control the pain and when the condition is an emergency. Explore Non-Surgical Treatments in a playlist of videos covering every type available, from medications to physical therapy to Chinese Medicine. In the Surgical Treatments playlist, watch a surgical walk-through video – a must see for anyone planning surgery for a cervical herniated disc. 

If you like the videos, tell us! Leave a comment. Subscribe to our channel. To see a video on a topic not covered, ask.

row: SURE FOOT Equine & Webinars With Wendy

SURE FOOT Equine Stability Program® | Horse Balance, Relaxation & Performance

The SURE FOOT Equine Stability Program® helps horses improve balance, relaxation, proprioception, and performance using SURE FOOT Pads.

On this channel, you’ll learn how to support your horse’s posture, movement, confidence, and long-term soundness—whether for training, rehabilitation, or everyday handling.

SURE FOOT Pads give horses the opportunity to explore their own balance. As they become more aware of how they are organized over their feet, many horses show reduced tension, improved movement, and greater comfort.

Wendy Murdoch, creator of SURE FOOT, shares how to:

Introduce pads safely
Choose the right pad types
Read your horse’s responses
Improve balance and body awareness
Support rehab, performance, and behavior

Used by horse owners, trainers, veterinarians, bodyworkers, and farriers, SURE FOOT helps horses become more relaxed, balanced, and confident.

3. Provide products and services which improve the quality of life for our members.

FIGHTING APATHY, BUILDING EMPATHY:  In Defense of Animals works to educate the public to fight apathy, build empathy and take concrete action to end all forms of animal exploitation worldwide. We work to ensure that decisions made involving animals, from the legislative level to the dinner table, are made with consideration of their needs and interests.

We seek to redefine the role of animals in society on local, national and international levels by elevating human perception of animals from that of mere property, objects and things, to that where animals are recognized to be individuals, with feelings, needs and interests of their own. WHSQ assists businesses to comply with the work health and safety laws, investigates workplace fatalities and serious injuries, prosecutes breaches of legislation, and educates employees and employers on their legal obligations. WHSQ also provides policy advice on workers' compensation matters.

This account is monitored Monday to Friday between 9am and 5pm AEST, excluding public holidays.

Welcome to Dumaguete Animal Sanctuary (DAS), a nonprofit no-kill animal shelter in the Philippines.

We rescue, rehabilitate, and care for animals in vulnerable situations while working toward long-term solutions to animal welfare. Alongside caring for hundreds of rescued animals, we run an ongoing sterilisation, vaccination, and microchipping programme for both owned and stray dogs and cats, helping reduce suffering at its source.

Alongside our community programmes, we care for hundreds of rescued animals and are building a new 2.8-hectare sanctuary that will provide veterinary services, rehabilitation facilities, and lifelong care for animals with nowhere else to go.

On this channel you’ll find new content daily:
🐾 Rescue stories
🐾 Weekly updates
🐾 Meet our dogs
🐾 Shelter life
🐾 Adoption journeys
🐾 Behind-the-scenes animal welfare work in the Philippines

Subscribe to follow the stories of the animals, staff, and volunteers creating a better future for animals in the Philippines.

Organic Gardening, Wildlife Conservation, and Environmental Education. 
I am Ame Vanorio, master gardener, wildlife rehabilitator, author, licensed science teacher, & environmental educator.
1. I help beginner gardeners go from growing a few vegetables to having a productive garden to provide nutritious organic food for their family/friends. I share things that have worked (and some that didn't) for me. 

2. I help wildlife lovers and rehabilitators learn more about wildlife rescue, building backyard wildlife habitat, and humane ways to protect your garden. 

3. I teach ways to connect with nature, explore wild areas, and support local eco-systems. Teacher support & lesson plans. 

We are a Safe Community. Rudeness/Trolls not tolerated. Proudly science-backed and science-positive.
Fox Run EEC is a 501c3 non-profit. A portion of the proceeds from our books, YouTube content, and affiliates is put back into our programs and used to purchase supplies for licensed wildlife rehabilitators.

Join us on a journey to optimal health and wellness, where patient care is our top priority.

Welcome to Meridian Idaho Gonstead Spine & Wellness—your home for precise, patient-centered chiropractic care led by Dr. Todd Pickman. Our clinic is the only healthcare facility in Idaho offering Digital Motion X-ray, giving us the ability to identify hidden spinal issues that traditional imaging often misses. We specialize in the Gonstead Chiropractic Technique, Chiropractic BioPhysics CBP, Chiropractic Spinal Decompression, weight-bearing digital X-rays, corrective care, & advanced spinal rehabilitation. Whether you’re dealing with neck pain, low back pain, sciatica, disc injuries, posture problems, or injuries from sports or car accidents, our goal is to locate the exact source of your problem and create a customized plan to help you heal. From detailed structural analysis to corrective exercises and ongoing wellness strategies, we help patients move better, feel stronger, and return to the activities they love. Discover a higher standard of chiropractic care right here in Meridian.

row: UC Davis Weill School of Veterinary Medicine

UC Davis Weill School of Veterinary Medicine is a nationally top-ranked academic medical center based in Davis, California with a school, hospital, specialty clinics, research centers and institutes, and other operations throughout the state and the world.

We serve California through premier educational, research, clinical, and public service programs to advance the health of animals and people, and the environment we share. We also safeguard the health of livestock, dairy, and poultry—critical to California's robust agricultural economy.

Our One Health approach encompasses captive and free-ranging wildlife, companion animals, exotic animals, birds, aquatic mammals, and fish. Our researchers are at the forefront of discoveries that translate to improved care for humans as well as animals.

Gentle Giants Draft Horse Rescue is a 501c(3) Equine Welfare Organization committed to saving draft and draft cross horses from slaughter, abuse, and neglect. We’ve rescued over 2,000 horses since we were founded in 2005. 

For those less likely to be adopted, we offer lifetime sanctuary at our 300+ acre facility in Maryland. We house over 200 horses at a time and bring over 350 horses to safety each year. Gentle Giants continues to be one of the loudest national voices fighting to permanently end the slaughter of U.S. horses for human consumption. 

We are located in Mount Airy, Maryland, USA and are open for tours by appointment. Please email tours@gentlegiants.org to visit the farm and meet your favorite gentle giant(s)!

Furkids, headquartered in Atlanta, GA, is a 501c3 nonprofit charitable organization that operates the largest cage-free, no-kill shelter in the Southeast for rescued cats and Sadie’s Place, a no-kill shelter for dogs. Furkids also operates one of the only facilities in the Southeast dedicated to the care of FIV positive cats. The Furkids mission is to rescue homeless animals, provide them with the best medical care and nurturing environment while working to find them a forever home. Furkids heals the whole animal, physically and emotionally, restoring its health and its spirit.

Visit Furkids.org to learn more!

We also serve seniors with conditions such as arthritis, diabetes, heart and lung disease, and other age-related problems.

row: When you want to revolutionize the clothing industry, you can’t just slap some extra fabric on a vest and call it a day. You may think, “It’s just pockets, it’s not like it’s rocket science.” But you would be wrong! When you’re adding as many as 42 pockets onto a piece of clothing, each with its own engineered purpose, there is a laundry list of considerations and challenges. What will be going in these pockets? How heavy will it be? Should the pockets be hidden? Should we add a zipper? Velcro? Magnets! So yeah… not rocket science, but definitely Pocket Science! And while they’re not sending monkeys into space, we think our Scientists are pretty darn special.

Arthrex Vet Systems (AVS) is a division of Arthrex Inc., a leading global orthopedic medical device manufacturer. For more than a decade, we have applied our expertise in orthopedics and orthobiologics to develop hundreds of products for the treatment of large and small animals like horses, dogs and cats.

With a mission of Helping Veterinarians Treat Their Patients Better™, our goal is to improve the overall care offered to animals. We develop our innovative veterinary surgical solutions and products with this in mind, working in collaboration with leading veterinary surgeons. In addition to manufacturing products for cartilage repair, ligament stabilization and orthobiologic treatments, we provide ongoing continuing education opportunities around the globe for vets to learn the latest techniques.

Using the latest technologies, we are helping veterinary professionals to raise the standards of veterinary care.

Our secure and user-friendly digital platform makes it possible to have real-time live interactions with Veterinary Specialists, enabling you to access specialist knowledge and advice for your patients wherever and whenever you need it.

Improve your knowledge and skills through working up your own cases under the real-time live guidance of our Specialists - from interactive case discussions to real-time live consultations and guided case work-ups.

Pilots To The Rescue is a nonprofit, volunteer-driven organization dedicated to saving animals by air. We transport at-risk dogs, cats, wildlife, and farm animals from overcrowded or under-resourced shelters to rescue partners and adoption centers where they have a real chance at life.

On this channel, you’ll go behind the scenes of real rescue missions... inside the cockpit, on the tarmac, and at shelters across the country. You’ll meet the animals whose lives are changed forever, the pilots and volunteers who make these missions possible, and the rescue partners working tirelessly on the ground.

Whether it’s a last-minute emergency transport, disaster response, or a freedom flight years in the making, our goal is always the same: move animals to safety and give them the futures they deserve.

Subscribe to follow our life-saving missions and be part of a community that believes love, and hope can fly.

💛 Learn more, support our work, or get involved:
👉 pilotstotherescue.org

Dr. Mohd Waseem is an internationally trained Chiropractor and Sports Rehabilitation Specialist, with advanced expertise in Neuro Kinetics, Chiropractic Care, Acupuncture, and Hijama (Cupping Therapy). With a refined understanding of the skeletal and nervous systems, he focuses on precise diagnosis and holistic, root-cause–based treatment.

Trained internationally in Malaysia, with clinical exposure aligned to London and European standards, Dr. Waseem has been practicing in Delhi since 2015. He has served as Physiotherapist for the Nepal Cricket Team (2011–2014) and as Physiotherapist on Duty at the ITF Tennis Tournament.

He is the Founder of ROOTs – Holistic Healing, delivering precision-driven, evidence-based, and elite-level care.

Contact: +91 8700748563

HOPE is a unique interdisciplinary pediatric neurological rehabilitation center in the middle east starting in Dubai, United Arab emirates.

Hope is not just a Rehabilitation Center it is an Abilitation one. Abilitation is the concept of empowering young individuals with disabilities to reach their best possible unexplored potential along the spectrum of their physical, occupational, speech, and cognitive needs.

Hope caters for all the various state of the art rehabilitation techniques invented worldwide under one roof. Also catering for both therapy models of intensive therapy camps and long term continuous therapy serving children in various age groups differently.

Most important core competency will be integrating various techniques with the understanding that individualized programs work best, tailoring a comprehensive and individualized custom made plan that will suit each individual specifically.

This channel is dedicated to providing high-quality, informative & engaging content related to physiotherapy.

Through my expertise, I offer viewers an opportunity to learn about various aspects of physiotherapy. 
The channel covers a wide range of topics related to physiotherapy, such as rehabilitation after injuries, managing chronic pain & maintaining a healthy lifestyle.

With a focus on providing evidence-based information, "I am Physiotherapist" aims to be a reliable source, for anyone interested in learning more about physiotherapy. Whether you are a healthcare professional, student, or simply someone looking to improve your physical health, this channel provides valuable insights & practical advice to help you achieve your goals.

In case of any queries, suggestions or complains, you can contact me here
iamphysiotherapist.official@gmail.com

Volhard Dog Nutrition uses dehydration as a method of food preserving which removes the moisture from raw, whole food ingredients. It inhibits the growth of microorganisms. Simply re-hydrate our foods with warm water and add your dog’s favorite meat.

Do you have a puppy or an older dog? Is your dog active? Or, does your dog prefer relaxing on a pillow? Volhard Dog Nutrition covers all of life’s stages.

Little Buckets Farm Sanctuary is a nonprofit registered 501(c)(3) animal rescue, striving to give as many animals a safe and loving home they all so deserve. We offer a forever sanctuary to horses, goats, cows, donkeys, pigs, dogs, and cats who all need a place to call home. 
In 2017, I created a bucket list to save a life at a livestock auction and that life was a little baby calf who I named Bucket. He is now 8 years old, best friends with my dog, Colton and his pal, Bailey who was also saved in 2017. Saving Bucket's life inspired me to move to a new state to start this sanctuary. We hope you decide to follow Little Buckets gang. I promise you will laugh, smile, and love a lot, and sometimes cry.  
All donations are tax-deductible and help with the daily care, hay, and feed of all the animals as well as allow us to save more lives. We want as many precious souls to have a happy, long life here at Little Buckets. We hope you see our gang is no different than your dog or cat.

Welcome to the Parr PT channel.

We provide specialized physical therapy treatments in Austin & Houston for: EDS (Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome), hypermobility, Dysautonomia, POTS, chronic pain & chronic fatigue (e.g. Fibromyalgia), neurological disorders & brain injuries such as strokes and MS, sports rehab & injury prevention for athletes, scar tissue release, bowel disorders (constipation, IBS, gastroparesis), and Matrix gait training.

Our expert physical therapists have years of experience in helping people with complex conditions to lead healthier and happier lives (https://parrpt.com/patient-testimonials/). At our clinic, you can expect personalized, one-on-one treatments tailored exactly to your needs:

The Parr PT Method = Specific myokinesethics techniques + Hands-on manual therapy + A holistic exercise approach to PT = Optimal Results!

Contact us directly today: https://parrpt.com/contact-and-scheduling/

Jonathan Parr PT, CSCS EP MCMT CBIS

row: Atendendo exclusivamente a pequenos animais desde 1990, o Hospital Veterinário PetCare se destaca pela visão empreendedora, oferecendo a mais completa estrutura de atendimento clínico, cirúrgico e diagnóstico, e liderado por uma equipe de inquestionável formação técnica e movida pela paixão aos animais de estimação. Nossas instalações contam com equipamentos e serviços únicos no Brasil. Trabalhando 24 horas, esse diferencial humano e tecnológico resulta em uma expertise única no mercado nacional e fez do PetCare o Melhor Hospital Veterinário de São Paulo 2009/2010 pela Revista Época.

The North American Veterinary Community (NAVC) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting and advancing veterinary professionals worldwide. As the leading provider of veterinary continuing education, the NAVC delivers essential training, tools and resources for animal health professionals to stay abreast of advances in veterinary medicine.

Through our commitment to innovation and excellence, we have developed a diverse portfolio of products and services, including educational events, virtual learning opportunities, publications, an advocacy arm and more.

Our goal is to empower veterinarians, veterinary technicians, practice managers, students and others with the skills they need throughout their careers. Our videos have been created to support this effort. 

To learn more about the NAVC’s products and brands, visit navc.com. To see our schedule of upcoming events, visit navc.com/calendar.

This channel brings you a range of helpful videos covering everything that an inquisitive and proactive Physiotherapy student might need including tips and advice from my experiences as a physio student. I regularly invite expert clinicians and practice educators to bring you current and relevant advice from those that really know. The channel is for you so if you have a subject you want covered, let me know. 
I graduated in 2020 with a 1st class BSc Hons in Physiotherapy from the University of Plymouth. Throughout my degree and beyond I have remained passionate about our profession! 
At university, I was a CSP rep, Chair of the South West and Wales CSP Student Group and a member of the CSP Student Representative Group. 
I have since become a core member of the CSP South West Regional Network. 
In my spare time, I love running and I'm the Head Coach at Tavistock Athletic Club.
I also run a small private physio clinic in the evenings and weekends. 
Make sure you've subscribed :)

Hello Everyone,

I am Dr. Vikas Sharma (B.V.Sc & A.H., MVC - TANUVAS, Chennai), a practicing veterinarian dedicated to educating pet parents and animal lovers.

This channel provides reliable information on:

• Dog & Cat Health Care
• Vaccination & Deworming
• Pet Nutrition & Feeding
• Disease Diagnosis & Treatment
• Pet Behavior & Training
• Puppy Care & Growth
• Pregnancy & Breeding Management

Our goal is to promote responsible pet ownership and improve animal welfare through practical veterinary knowledge.

This channel is for educational purposes only. Always consult a qualified veterinarian before giving any medication or treatment to your pet.

Subscribe for pet care tips, dog health advice, veterinary education, disease management, and clinical veterinary demonstrations.

A.A.R.F. (All About Rescue and Fixin’ Inc.) is small group of volunteers with a passion for animals. Check out some of our adoptable pets and alumni videos here! It is our goal to save as many lives as we can from needless death.  We are a foster based animal rescue organization based in the beautiful Upper Cumberland region of Tennessee.  We pull animals from high risk situations, such as local animal shelters and local strays from counties who do not have the luxury of having an animal shelter. 

A.A.R.F. is operated out of our volunteers’ homes. We are ALWAYS in need of foster parents to help save more lives.  To become an A.A.R.F. foster parent, the only true requirement is that you love animals as much as we do, and that you would treat your foster animals as if they were your own.

We are dedicated to helping educate horse owners and enthusiasts and we hope you find these videos interesting and helpful!
Since the founding of our original practice over 40 years ago, it has been our goal to bring not only high quality veterinary care to our community but also care with a personal connection. Compassion and expertise is what we look for in every doctor, technician, and staff member!
We are continually listening and watching for areas that are in need of equine veterinary care and as a result we currently have offices/coverage in the regions surrounding these areas of California:
Penryn, Sutter Creek, Penn Valley, Wilton, Napa Valley, Fortuna, Arcata, Brentwood, Gilroy, and Lake Forest just outside of Los Angeles! There are ~35 equine veterinarians within the group comprised of generalists & specialists in surgery, internal medicine, sports medicine, & critical care. All of our practices combined provide ambulatory veterinary care to a large portion of California.

Bloomington Wellness & Rehab is Minnesota’s #1-rated chiropractic and wellness clinic on Google, serving Bloomington, Minneapolis, St. Paul, and the Twin Cities for more than 25 years. 

Our 6,000-square-foot rehab and wellness center brings together chiropractic care, spinal rehab, MedX spinal strengthening, scoliosis care through Scoliosis Solutions of MN, neuropathy care through our Neurogenesis Neurovascular Rehabilitation Program, acupuncture, massage therapy, Aescape robotic massage, decompression, red light therapy, shockwave, Class IV laser, custom orthotics, functional wellness, telemedicine access, GLP-1 and peptide support, and remote functional medicine resources.

Led by Dr. Cory Emberland, our team helps patients reduce pain, restore function, improve mobility, build strength, and support long-term health naturally whenever possible. We create educational videos on back pain, neck pain, sciatica, scoliosis, neuropathy, rehab, wellness, and modern conservative care.

TRR receives and cares for confiscated, sick, and injured animals from government agencies. The Toucan Rescue Ranch works closely with the Ministry of Environment and Energy of Costa Rica (MINAE), bringing injured and displaced wildlife to the center. TRR provides sanctuary while giving treatment, rehabilitation, and eventual release to their natural environment.

row: The Animal Rescue League of Boston

Pets are family. This belief is at the heart of everything we do at the Animal Rescue League of Boston.

We are the first female-founded animal welfare organization in Massachusetts and are proud to carry on a legacy of kindness and compassion, helping more than 20,000 animals annually since 1899.

Recognized for our innovative, award-winning programs that go beyond sheltering, we address the root causes of the issues facing animals and the people who love them.

By partnering with communities, we help animals heal and thrive, keep pets and people together, and protect animals from harm.

Because there is no government funding for this important work, animals must rely on people like you to get the care they need, when they need it most, 365 days a year.

Sign up for ARL’s e-newsletter for the most current animal stories, advocacy and program updates, events, and more at https://arl.boston/e-news-sign-up

Welcome to my YouTube channel, a treasure trove of snippets of knowledge and handy hints in the field of veterinary neurology. 

Who am I? 
I bring expertise from specialist referral practice and academia to offer valuable insights and guidance. The aim is to breakdown down complex veterinary neurology concepts into digestible and practical tips.

What do I do? 
My research is dedicated to understanding cerebrospinal fluid disorders, particularly focusing on Canine Chiari malformation and syringomyelia. I am particularly passionate about raising awareness of diseases caused by selective breeding for poor head and body shape. I promote responsible breeding practices to minimize the suffering of animals affected by hereditary conditions.

Who is this channel for?
My content is accessible to both professionals and lay audiences. Join the community as you delve into the world of veterinary neurology. 

The views expressed are my own

row: Named after its founder, Marita Baquiran Yasuda, this homegrown sanctuary first started in earnest back in 2007, right in Yasuda’s own backyard in Antipolo, Rizal, Philippines. What started out as an effort to rehabilitate one injured stray soon grew into a full-blown sanctuary; one that rarely (if ever) turns away the many abandoned, abused, and neglected stray cats and dogs that turn up on their doorstep. Having since relocated to a more sizeable lot in Morong, Rizal, the shelter now counts over 1400 feline and canine residents under its care. Of course, along with the ever increasing number of animals is a seemingly endless stream of veterinary and utility bills—one day’s worth of food alone can cost upwards of P25,000 (approximately USD500).

row: Dr. Joe Tatta is a leader in integrative pain care. He serves as the CEO of the Integrative Pain Science Institute. He is also an adjunct professor in the Arcadia University DPT program. He has published peer-reviewed articles and 3 books on pain management. His professional accomplishments extend to the creation of scalable practice models grounded in health behavior change and innovative approaches empowering physical therapists to assume the role of primary healthcare providers. He is passionate about implementation science and strategies that facilitate the uptake of evidence-based practice into regular use by practitioners. The culmination of his work is PRISM: Pain Recovery and Integrative Systems Model – a cognitive behavioral approach for physical therapy. Learn more at: integrativepainscienceinstitute.com.

Located at the westernmost tip of Texas, where three states and two countries converge along the Rio Grande, 94% of our nearly 25,000 students are minorities, and half are the first in their families to go to college. UTEP offers 168 bachelor’s, master’s and doctoral degree programs at the only open-access, top tier research university in America.

Hi, I'm Dr. Ask – a cat-only veterinarian since 2004. Welcome to my Cat Channel, where we explore everything feline: nutrition, health, behavior, and all the delightful quirks that make cats so unique.

My journey with cats began early with Flicka, my family’s Siamese, who claimed my crib as her sleeping spot. That bond sparked a lifelong passion that led me to veterinary school at Cornell University, where I graduated in 2004. Since then, I've worked in multiple feline-exclusive hospitals and proudly started my cat-only hospital in 2008.

With decades of experience treating cats and guiding their humans, I’m excited to share what I’ve learned. Whether you’re a devoted cat parent or simply cat-curious, join me as we celebrate, demystify, and enjoy the weird and wonderful world of cats.

The MBLEx Prep with Michele channel is all about helping aspiring Massage Therapists and Bodyworkers prepare for the Massage and Bodyworkers licensing exam and achieve their dream of providing excellent care through the healing power of touch.

I'm Michele Bullock, a licensed massage therapist in Washington state. After I passed the MBLEx, I worked in an injury clinic while starting my own practice.  I love bodywork as a fulfilling and lucrative career and every day I see the need for more massage therapist and body workers in the field, helping people heal and find a new connection with their bodies.  After completing an accredited massage program, the massage and bodywork licensing exam is the final hurdle to receiving a license and getting your hands out into the world. My goal is to help get you there through thoroughly understanding the content of the test so that you can pass it easily.

YCP brings industry professionals directly into the most underserved classrooms across the state, partnering with school districts to integrate our curriculum into public schools from 5th to 12th grade. Each class is conducted twice a week in ninety-minute sessions throughout the school year. Unlike any other program in the country, our approach is not an after-school program; it is an in-class, push-in model. What sets our program apart is our belief in the students’ potential to meet high expectations. We guide them through the entire filmmaking process – from story development and production to post production – and culminate with industry screenings at the end of the year.

Learn more at: youthcinemaproject.org

As well as teaching, Susan still runs her own practice from North London, believing that 'keeping up with the real world helps to keep me inspired, and that helps to make me a better teacher'.

This channel aims to help you become the best therapist you can be. It brings expert videos detailing unique tips, techniques and advice, all from Susan herself. For videos straight to your inbox, you can ign up to Susan's #massagemondays here: https://bit.ly/3oYBMFP 

Feel free to get in touch at info@susanfindlay.co.uk with any questions or even just for a chat!

On his 'Ask Dr. Steve DVM®' Facebook page, where he provides free advice, he's been a trusted source of guidance for pet owners. Our goal is simple yet profound: to empower pet owners with the knowledge they need to give their beloved pets the best life possible.

Join us for informative and engaging content, from pet care tips and insights into holistic wellness to expert advice on common pet health issues like allergies, anxiety, cancer, hip dysplasia, ear infections, diet, disc disease, kidney and liver disease, and gut health.

Subscribe today and embark on a journey of love, care, and learning, all dedicated to your beloved pets.

Helping students study & build careers in Europe! 

Hi, I am Dr Anannya Misra, a Veterinarian from India. I am currently pursuing my PhD in Belgium after completing my Master’s in Italy. Through this channel, I aspire to help students planning for higher studies and building a career in Europe. From Master’s courses, PhD opportunities to scholarships, internships, visa applications, and international student life, this channel will help you navigate your journey abroad with clarity.

Having studied across multiple European countries with full scholarships, I will also share practical advice, academic experiences, career pathways, and the realities of life as an international student and researcher in Europe. 

But that's not all! In this channel you’ll also find travel experiences, cultural explorations, and glimpses of my everyday life.

If you’re passionate about studying abroad, research,  or building an international career, subscribe and join the journey at Vet in Europe!

Uganda's National parks, managed by the Uganda Wildlife Authority (UWA) offers the best of East Africa and surpasses the competition in terms of sheer variety of the flora and fauna within its borders.

Uganda's parks offer 'traditional' savannah safari game parks along with unique species, leading edge conservation strategies and wildlife research activities. Uganda, the "Pearl of Africa" is unrivalled in the continent as a bird watching destination with over 1,000 species. It offers an unbelievable selection of 13 types of primates including many of the world's 800 or so endangered mountain gorillas.

Explore the range of geographic settings: the wild Kidepo Valley; Queen Elizabeth's tree-climbing lions;  Virunga Volcanic range and rainforest; up the Rwenzori Mountains - 3rd highest peak in Africa and the source of the Nile River; plus much more.

Explore Uganda -- on the tip of discovery with the safest and most hospitable parks in Africa!
http://ugandawildlife.org

I’m Dan the Dog Man — a combat veteran and professional dog trainer with a background in canine psychology and animal behavior. Based on experience, not just theory. On this channel, I break down real-world dog training, focusing on behavior, obedience, and the root causes behind aggression, reactivity, and lack of control.

I don’t just teach commands — I teach structure, communication, and how to build a clear relationship between dog and owner. You’ll see real training sessions, behavior modification, and step-by-step breakdowns in challenging situations like vet visits, leash reactivity, and high-drive dogs.

My approach is built on trust, respect, and clarity — creating calm, reliable dogs through consistent, real-world training. If you’re looking for dog training tips, behavior correction, and real case studies, this channel is for you. 

Subscribe for real, lasting results.

Steward Health Care System is a community-based accountable care organization that offers a full range of health care services to patients in Massachusetts. Steward includes 3,000 physicians, 10 hospital campuses, 30 affiliated urgent care providers, 6 ambulatory surgery centers, home care, hospice and other services. The system earns nearly $2.4 billion in net patient service revenues and serves more than one million patients annually in more than 150 communities.

Hospitals in the system include Carney Hospital in Dorchester, Good Samaritan Medical Center in Brockton, Holy Family Hospital in Methuen, Holy Family Hospital at Merrimack Valley, Morton Hospital in Taunton, Nashoba Valley Medical Center in Ayer, New England Sinai Hospital in Stoughton, Norwood Hospital, Saint Anne's Hospital in Fall River and St. Elizabeth's Medical Center in Brighton.  

Our videos demonstrate how we provide world class health care, close to home, where you need it most.

We rescue cats from the streets in Romania, Carei and surrounding towns. We spay/neuter them and try to find them a forever home with responsible and loving owners.
A bit about us, we are a brother and sister that have had cats since we were little, and 3 years ago we started to rescue  abandoned cats from our city and from neighboring villages. We spay/neuter all our cats and many more too, over +200 cats and +30 dogs in the last 3 years, all from our own money but right now we've reached a point where it's impossible for us to help these animals from what we earn, that's why we've started this non-profit organization. We mostly need help with cat food as right now we have 188 cats, some very sick, some with dietary restrictions. We also cook for them but the food that we buy we try to get the best quality as medicine and treatments for the sick cost much more then good food that would prevent them from getting ill. Any help with cat food or small donations would be very welcome.

row: Dr. Randy Aronson - The Pet Vet

Dr. Randy Aronson is a holistic, integrative veterinarian specializing in advanced natural pet health and wellness. As the owner of PAWS Veterinary Center in Tucson, AZ, Dr. Randy shares his 40+ years of experience on how to care for pets using an integrative approach—combining traditional Western medicine with science-based holistic modalities like pet acupuncture, Chinese herbal medicine, and advanced nutrition. The goals—and any treatment & rehabilitation plans—for his patients are built around longevity and healthspan.  

Dr. Randy is certified by the Canine Rehabilitation Institute and utilizes cutting-edge therapies—food therapy, ozone, shock wave, acupuncture, therapeutic laser, and underwater treadmill—to treat chronic pain, arthritis, and mobility issues in dogs and cats. Subscribe to Paws, Reflect, and Heal for expert advice, Q&As, and proactive solutions for your pet's long-term health and wellness.

About Plasticity® Brain Centers
Innovative Treatment for Traumatic Brain Injuries

Plasticity® Brain Centers offers non-invasive neuro rehabilitation based on a single scientific principle: the brain is capable of learning and changing throughout a patient’s entire life. This is made possible through engagement with targeted neuro-receptors in a concept known as “neuroplasticity,” an approach widely accepted by the scientific community, only available in leading-edge treatment centers.

Our board-certified doctors and neurology specialists, supported by a hand-selected staff of patient care coordinators and therapists, provide you an innovative and comprehensive diagnostic and treatment model delivering exceptional outcomes to exceptional patients, unleashing your brain’s potential now.

If you want to improve your neurological function using a research-based approach, contact Plasticity® Centers today at (855) 955-9727.

row: Costa Rica School of Massage Therapy

Costa Rica School of Massage Therapy (CRSMT) is a leading massage therapy school in Costa Rica and the premier study abroad program for aspiring massage therapists. CRSMT offers immersive massage therapy certification and continuing education opportunities for students and professionals. It is also home to the world’s first COMTA-accredited massage therapy study abroad training programs.

On this channel, viewers can explore what it’s like to study massage therapy abroad, hear student stories, watch our Quest for Excellence series, and get answers to common questions about the program, campus life, and admissions. The channel also highlights CRSMT’s retreat-style CEU opportunities for massage therapists looking to continue their education in Costa Rica.

My name is Kayla Duncan. I am an Ohio licensed massage therapist and the owner and operator of Northeast Ohio Clinical Massage. I am a peer provider meaning that I myself have medical diagnoses and chronic pain just like my clients do. I know how hard being a pain body is. I also know ways to help manage chronic pain and dysfunction with gentle and advanced neuromuscular treatment techniques. Join me on YouTube, facebook, or in my massage studio located in Warren, Ohio. 

My journey began in 2020 when I first discovered the benefits of self massage. I went to massage school in 2021 and became an LMT in 2022. I recently celebrated one year in the field as a remedial/medical/clinical therapist. Please visit my website for more information about me and my work. I offer both in person and virtual massage therapy sessions. 

https://neoclinicalmassage.amtamembers.com

Dr. Victor Dean, BS, MS, DC, CPT

Dr. Dean had over 25 years of experience in the sports performance and rehab world before becoming a chiropractor. He holds a Bachelor's Degree in Exercise Science, a Master's Degree in Nutrition, and a Doctorate in Chiropractic, along with countless specialty certifications. He is also a multi-sport athlete and has overcome many injuries on his way to earning world and national titles, which enables him to offer a unique perspective when working with sports injuries. In addition to treating back and neck pain, we deal with things like sprained ankles, tennis elbow, whiplash, vertigo, headaches, plantar fasciitis, weight loss, nutritional supplements, sports nutrition, and more. Treatments often include corrective exercises, PNF stretching, and soft tissue work, such as trigger point therapy, pin and stretch, and instrument assisted soft tissue mobilization (IASTM).

🐾 Welcome to Soper Creek Wildlife Rescue’s YouTube Channel! 🌿

Get ready to meet the incredible animals of Soper Creek Wildlife Rescue, where every critter is a native Canadian species! From heartwarming rescues to fascinating wildlife facts, we’re here to connect you with Ontario’s amazing wildlife.

Located in Clarington, just an hour outside of Toronto, SCWR is proud to be Durham Region's ONLY Wildlife Rehabilitation Hospital. Our mission is to RESCUE, REHABILITATE, and RELEASE Ontario’s wildlife while educating communities about their importance

✨ What You’ll Find on Our Channel:

Weekly videos every #WildlifeWednesday featuring animal ambassadors and rescue stories.
Behind-the-scenes looks at wildlife rehabilitation in action.
Subscribe today to join us on our journey to protect and celebrate Canada’s wildlife!

🌐 Learn more about us:

Formations continues

- Massage suédois cinétique®

We believe every tiny cry deserves to be heard.
Every shivering body deserves warmth.
Every scared animal deserves a second chance.
Every rescue story deserves to be told.

That's why we're here.
That's FawnRescue.

One cry. One rescue. One life changed forever. 🐾

Our rescue stories are crafted using AI video generation to spread awareness about animal rescue and adoption. No real animals were involved or harmed in any video. Every story is

—

If our videos inspire even one person to adopt,

Adopt don't shop ❤️🐾

For 17 years PhysioFunction have been helping people maximise their independence following life changing events such as stroke, acquired brain or spinal cord injury and other neurological conditions. When other healthcare services have reached the limit of their time and resources we can often pick up the baton and help our clients continue their rehabilitation journey to reach their potential. 

Our team of highly trained specialist Physiotherapists, Sports Therapists, Lifestyle and Nutrition Coaches and Occupational Therapists aim to maximise our client's independence with individually tailored treatment sessions in one of our clinics, in the client's home, in nursing/residential homes or via our TeleRehab service.

Voted one of the TOP 10 places to visit with your family in NJ, we are located in Mays Landing, NJ. Admission and parking are FREE. We are open year round on Sundays and Tuesdays only from 8-4pm. 

We are a Family-Friendly Animal Rescue & Sanctuary with over 500 rescued animals, most roam free. We have 3 of a planned 10 anti-bullying children’s books that we take to schools with some of the friendly animals at the Funny Farm. We teach kids that despite our differences, we can all get along like the animals of the Funny Farm. 

Please check us out on Facebook for true and inspirational stories of the Funny Farm animals under...

“Funny Farm Rescue”

We are also on Instagram. 

No appointment is necessary. Anyone can volunteer at any age. If you are under 15, just bring an adult with you. You can volunteer any Sunday or Tuesday any time between 8-4pm. 

We have hayrides!!!

We hope you will come see us very soon!

Studying for the Veterinary Technician National Examination (VTNE) is incredibly challenging—but you don't have to navigate it alone. Whether you are looking to review anesthetic drugs, memorize equine parasites, or get a better understanding of how x-rays work, this channel is designed to help you study smarter, not harder. 

As an educator in a Vet Tech program, I use these lessons to support students both in the classroom and online. This channel brings those lessons to you so you can listen or watch at your own pace at home. I truly hope you pass your VTNE and find a fulfilling career, the industry needs amazing people like you!

row: Chiropractic is changing. Research, patient management, objective clinical results, treatment techniques, philosophies, and principles all advance over time. The mission of Chiropractic BioPhysics (CBP) Technique is to provide a research based response to these changing times that is clinically, technically, and philosophically sound. By joining together, we can participate in the redefinition and updating of the chiropractic profession. This journey, all of us must take as a profession to become the best Chiropractors we can be. CBP’s efforts focus on chiropractic corrective care through structural rehabilitation of the spine and posture using mirror image® adjusting, exercise, and spinal remodeling procedure.

The One80 System is a patented thought process, evaluation tool and treatment technique used by elite medical professionals. With the focus on function and MoStreBility (Motion + Strength + Stability) rather than symptoms, our patented system gives patients immediate and lasting results, and professionals clarity and clinical success. Unlike conventional PT, we use critical thinking to target and treat neuromuscular inhibition to restore MoStreBility throughout the kinetic matrix.
Want more info on how and why we do what we do? Watch our videos here and follow us on Instagram (TheOne80System)

Mel is recognised as one of the pioneers of massage over the last 25 years and has published several international textbooks on the subject. He has gained the most extensive clinical experience having worked with World class athletes and dancers (including the Royal Ballet in London and the Tokyo Ballet in Japan) as well as people with serious medical conditions. 

He is a passionate and inspiring teacher who has also presented workshops Internationally. He used to compete at a high amateur level in Marathons and Triathlons. He has written a number of books including Sport & Remedial Massage Therapy and Advanced Remedial Massage and Soft Tissue Therapy and is regarded as one of the world’s leading authorities on the subject.

Mel Cash (Principal Tutor at LSSM) Therapist since 1985 Tutor since 1989

This channel showcases some of our dogs, who are looking for forever homes, by showing them as we at the rescue see them. We also have videos showing some of the training and behavioural work we do with our dogs as we help them through any issues they might have. Through this work we can guide and teach these dogs thus increasing their chances of being adopted into a forever home!
We also put a lot of work into socialising the dogs to increase their social skills, plus it's great fun for them (and us!).

North Clwyd Animal Rescue (NCAR) is a registered charity (No: 515195) founded in 1978 by Anne Owen and is largest animal welfare charity in the North Wales. From one thin little Lurcher, we now care for over 1500 domestic pets a year. 
We have grown to meet these new demands and with the current economic situation these services are vital for the wider community.

supported by;
www.K999.com & @6csocial

We recreate authentic rescue scenarios inspired by real life events — from puppies left alone in freezing rain, injured strays struggling to survive, to loyal dogs abandoned in their old age.

The heartbreaking reality faced by abandoned dogs.
Life changing encounters that rebuild trust between dogs and humans.
Moments where compassion, patience, and care bring a broken dog back to life.

Our mission is to raise awareness about responsible dog ownership and promote the message adopt, don’t abandon. We believe that even a small act of kindness can completely change the destiny of a helpless dog.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team transforms real rescue stories into deeply emotional and visually immersive experiences. Let Dog Rescue Station take you to the moments where love, compassion, and action save a life.

Welcome to the BEVA YouTube Channel.

BEVA is a world-leading equine veterinary association committed to championing high standards of equine health and welfare. We advance the veterinary and allied sciences, promote scientific excellence, and educate equine veterinary professionals throughout the world. 

Run by a passionate group of equine vets, BEVA promotes and leads the equine veterinary community by providing a platform for discussion and an exchange of ideas on the management, health, and welfare of the horse. 
We do this by:
1. representing the industry, advising on domestic and European issues and tackling a wide range of topical veterinary and welfare subjects
2. delivering some of the best equine CPD via our practical courses and online learning
3. producing two world-leading equine veterinary journals, and
4. providing guidance to those working in the equine industry.

Welcome to Zoo Ost - the channel for all things osteopathic. Created by multi award winning osteopath Tony Nevin. Join us as we use osteopathy to treat some of the planets most iconic creatures, including humans! With more than 300 species already treated there will be plenty of variety. Zoo Ost are true pioneers.
People and animals evolved from the same star dust. They share the same conditions and ailments, and are subject to the same laws of physics. Where possible we will use technology to help you see more of what we do.
Our videos aim to be useful, educational and information packed. They are also entertaining, especially when something doesn't go to plan!
We film during real clinics and treatments. We don't stage events. Editing is used just to tidy things up and make for a more pleasant viewing experience.
Please check out our blog page - listed in the links, and join us on this exciting journey of discovery.

Rescate Wildlife Rescue Center es una organización sin fines de lucro que busca liberar a las especies que ingresan a su centro de Rescate. Cada año ingresan más de 3000 animales, con el objeto principal de rehabilitar y regresarlos a su habitat natural. Tenemos el único hospital para vida silvestre en Costa Rica, y somos el centro de rescate más grande en Centro America. 
El Santuario está ubicado en La Garita de Alajuela (anteriormente conocido como ZooAve), cuenta con más de 14 hectáreas que están dividas entre el Santuario de Vida Silvestre abierto al publico, el Centro de Rescate de vida Silvestre Tropical, el Centro de Reproducción de Animales en peligro de Extinción. En 2km de senderos puede encontrar mas de 120 diferente especias de animales.
Contamos con numerosas especies animales que han sido rescatadas y que por diversos motivos no pueden ser liberados. Su entrada al santuario apoya la vida silvestre de Costa Rica!

Vafa is the first animal shelter in Iran that was founded in 2003 by Fatemeh Motamedi to take care of dogs who were sick or needed care. Before that, there was sadly no such institution in Iran. 
Vafa is a charitable NGO, run by grassroots donations. It runs two animal shelters in Hashtgerd and Qazvin, housing more than 1800 dogs.
As a non-for-profit charity, Vafa has no links to any political or religious organization.
We aim to build a better world where humans and animals co-exist.
Cultural and awareness work, aimed at gathering support for animals, is our main method.

Our mission is to enhance the lives of children who need neurosurgery to treat their seizures. We do this through our impactful programs, services, and research before, during, and after surgery.

💡 Actionable strategies
🎙 Candid conversations
🔥 Bold takes (and a few cold beers)

Topics include:

• Physical therapy careers
• PT clinic ownership and business
• Healthcare technology and AI
• Burnout and retention in rehab
• Leadership for physical therapists

row: Inside the Wellspace: Women, Wellbeing, Wisdom

Inside the Wellspace is a podcast redefining women’s wellness—through a female lens. For too long, our health has been studied, diagnosed, and treated from a male perspective. Hosted by wellness advocate Cathy O’Brien, who brings 25+ years in global beauty, a masters in social work focusing on women’s issues, and her own deeply personal health journey, this show features real, honest conversations about the overlooked and critical aspects of women’s short and long term health and well-being.
From hormones and mental resilience to sleep and bone health, Cathy sits down with top doctors and experts to break down the science and share practical, evidence-based tools. The goal? To help you feel informed, empowered, and in control of your health.
Subscribe for a smart, doable approach to wellness that actually speaks to you.

Welcome to the YouTube channel of the Royal College of Veterinary Surgeons (RCVS). 

Our role
We aim to enhance society through improved animal health and welfare. We do this by setting, upholding and advancing the educational, ethical and clinical standards of veterinary surgeons and veterinary nurses.

What we do 
As a statutory regulator, we are responsible under the Veterinary Surgeons Act 1966 for maintaining the UK Register of Veterinary Surgeons eligible to practise, setting standards for veterinary education and regulating the professional conduct of vets.

We also regulate vet nurses through our Royal Charter, including maintaining the Register of Veterinary Nurses and overseeing professional standards. The charter also enables us to award fellowships, diplomas and certificates.

Our videos
On this channel we share short films about our latest news and activities. We also run another channel dedicated to vet careers: http://www.youtube.com/vetcareers

Many Tears Animal Rescue is a small Not For Profit rescue based in Wales. We primarily take ex-breeding dogs but also take in a number of dogs from the pounds, public hand-ins and some from rescues abroad too. We are always busy and have around 250 fosterers who look after dogs in their homes, as well as our kennels in Carmarthenshire. We rely on donations and kindness to keep going

We rehome approximately 3,000 dogs per year and many of the dogs come to us having never lived in a home before. They often arrive needing veterinary care and our on site vet and volunteer vets spay and neuter all the adult dogs as well as carrying out other procedures such as treating ear/eye infections along with much bigger problems like orthopaedic surgeries, heart operations and cataract surgery. The costs of these can be vast but can transform the lives of the dogs

Please help us to keep going, things are particularly difficult at the moment and we are very worried but together we can save them all

Welcome to Skooldoggery, where we cut through the noise and bring a common-sense approach to dogs and puppies
We mainly focus on Dog-U-Tainment and puppy advice, but you never know what we might cover next!

Our channel is dedicated to providing expert puppy training advice to help you raise a well-behaved dog who is a joy to live with. Training tricks is only part of the fun of owning a dog, your new best friend needs to be fun to live with too! You don't have to live with a dog who barks at the front door, barges past you when you open it or be bossed around at meal times. Follow our dog training advice to embrace a calmer home life with your pet. 

If you're thinking of getting a dog, we can help you with that too. We produce videos about our favourite breeds of dog so you can learn more about a breed's individual needs to make sure you find the right dog for your lifestyle. 

Hit the subscribe button and watch through our playlists and don't forget to share your story with us.
