row: Faculty of Veterinary Medicine - University of Calgary

The University of Calgary Faculty of Veterinary Medicine (UCVM) was established in 2005 to meet Alberta’s need for highly-skilled veterinary graduates supporting rural Alberta, production animal and equine industries, animal and human health research, and public health.  

UCVM is dedicated to meeting the animal and public health needs of Alberta through its education, research and outreach programs.

UCVM offers the Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) program, supervision leading to graduate degrees (MSc, PhD) in Veterinary Medical Sciences, and advanced clinical training programs (internships, fellowships, and residencies). UCVM is also committed to professional development programs for the veterinary community.

This channel is dedicated to Teaching and Celebrating Chiropractic, by explaining chiropractic theory and showing the interactions between colleagues and patients. Videos here are mostly educational discussing chiropractic, chiropractic adjustments, chiropractic theory, manual muscle testing, primitive reflexes, and patient outcomes. A few videos will be personal or contain a comic flare. 

Mark Algee D.C.,  a chiropractor and continuing educational instructor, wishes to explore the relationships between chiropractic, neurology, massage, exercise, nutrition, comedy, kindness, community and The Human Experience. His desire is to have a simple life, that's rich in experience and contributes to humanity by way of healing, teaching, coaching, learning, loving, listening, contributing to others and making people laugh.  If he can accomplish these goals then he's played his part, in this journey called life, well.

This channel brings interviews with the world's most experienced pediatric physical therapists talking about new developments and their own original research published in Pediatric Physical Therapy Journal.

Because when both horse and rider move better… everything changes.

Welcome to Julie Donnelly’s Pain-Free Living channel.

With a BS in Interdisciplinary Health Education and a licensed massage therapist, Julie brings 35 years of experience and credibility in transforming pain management. 

She’s been at the forefront of the field, collaborating with experts like Dr. Peter Lin of Baylor College of Medicine. She is widely recognized for developing the Julstro Method of Osteopathic Muscular Therapy and specialized treatments.

Accredited by organizations like NCBTMB/AMTA, Julie is well known for training massage therapists in the Julstro method. 

Whether you’re navigating the aging process, embracing fitness, tackling repetitive job tasks, working at a desk job, or advocating health and wellness,  you'll find transformative techniques, success stories, and educational insights to help you target pain at its source.

Subscribe now and join a community of people who are overcoming pain and improving their quality of life.

#KSAR is a licensed veterinary clinic and animal shelter in Kabul helping animals in need in Afghanistan, putting compassion into action. 501c3 EIN: 86-1456626

We provide routine & emergency medical services for pets, street animals, and working animals. Our staff, on site  24/7 intake can provide animal retrieval in Kabul City if needed, security allowing. Our facilities include quarantine areas to safely treat contagious diseases commonly found in Afghanistan, surgical suite, and long-term boarding, animal sanctuary spaces. 

On June 2, 2024 we pulled off the unimaginable- we airlifted 195 dogs and 100 cats on a charter plane bound for the USA. Almost all of these cats and dogs are in their forever homes in the US while a few are waiting to be adopted. Please reach out if you are interested in adopting a KSAR cutie.

Despite the airlift, today we have over 450 animals (including 250 dogs) residing at KSARl No animal is ever turned away and so our population is growing again.

The Western PA Humane Society and the Animal Rescue League each had rich histories of helping animals in our community. In 2017, our two organizations merged to form one of the largest animal welfare associations in Pennsylvania, tasked with providing enhanced services to domestic and wild animals alike. Humane Animal Rescue continues the legacies of the Animal Rescue League & Western Pennsylvania Humane Society, bringing greater efficiency in animal care processes, staff training, and cutting-edge practices to one cohesive organization.

We operate two domestic animal shelters across the City of Pittsburgh along with our Certified Wildlife Rehabilitation Center in Verona, Pennsylvania. Join us in celebrating our combined two-century legacy of giving our region's animals the care they need and the love they deserve. Visit us online at humaneanimalrescue.org or call us at 412-345-7300 to learn more about our programs and adoptable pets.

row: University of St. Augustine for Health Sciences

USAHS is an accredited graduate-level institution with an innovative approach to health science education. At USAHS, our expert faculty practitioners equip you for career success. Using hands-on and cutting-edge technologies, you‘ll be prepared to excel as a clinician. We have five campuses located in San Marcos, California; St. Augustine and Miami in Florida; Austin and Dallas in Texas.

Our entry-level, first-professional degrees include: Doctor of Physical Therapy Degree (DPT), Doctor of Occupational Therapy (OTD), Master of Occupational Therapy Degree (MOT), and Master of Science in Speech-Language Pathology (MS-SLP).

The University also offers graduate post-professional education including the Master of Science in Nursing (MSN), Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP), Post-Professional Doctor of Occupational Therapy Degree (PPOTD), Doctor of Education (EdD), Master of Health Administration (MHA), and Continuing Education Seminars and Certifications.

Welcome to Yorkshire Vet Official!

This channel features episodes and highlights from The Yorkshire Vet, a factual documentary series following the work of experienced veterinarians across the British countryside. 

The series stars Julian Norton, Peter Wright, Matt Smith, and Jeanette Appleton, as they care for farm animals and pets while supporting traditional farming communities.

From routine visits to challenging medical cases, the channel offers an honest and human look at veterinary medicine, countryside living, and the bond between animals and the people who look after them.

Perfect for viewers who enjoy real-life documentaries, animal-focused stories, rural lifestyles, and unscripted factual television.

row:
On this channel you will find video tutorials demonstrating dog massage techniques to keep your best friend feeling great.

All Paws Massage offers animal massage services for dogs, cats and horses. We focus on mobility and comfort for senior animals, plus prevention and performance for sport and working dogs.
In addition to traditional animal massage techniques we incorporate myofascial release, acupressure, craniosacral, Reiki, and red light therapy. We work closely with your veterinarian to provide complementary care for animals experiencing muscular, neurological or behavioural challenges; assisting with a variety of conditions ranging from injuries, post-operative, to chronic or degenerative.
Massage is an important part of a holistic approach to pet care. It serves as a preventative measure and a way to bring relief to your companion. Massage facilitates the connection between body, mind and spirit supporting an overall state of well-being.

Hi! I’m Dr. Cassie — a physical therapist, founder of Children’s Therapy Network Inc., wife, and mom. This channel supports families raising children with special needs through fun, educational, and practical videos.

With nearly 30 years of experience and a deep love for this community, I’m here to help make life a little easier and a lot more joyful. From activities to expert insights, you'll find resources to empower families and professionals alike.

For a deeper dive, visit drcassie.org for certification and CEU classes for therapists, plus practical, informative content for parents.

My husband, Tom, a recreation therapist, and I are passionate about making a positive impact. Subscribe to join our community as we learn, grow, and make a difference together!

Animal Rescue and Care (ARC) is a Kolkata based NGO registered under trust act in 2016 that has been working for the welfare of stray animals and their rights. The main objective of this organization is to create a better world for the voiceless friends by spreading awareness among people so that people live in harmony with the less privileged ones and defend their rights. 

ARC has two different shelters, the old one located in Kolkata District and a bigger rehabilitation shelter in Burdwan District.

ARC’ rescues animals those are ill or injured or animals those are subject to torture and abuse. ARC provides them relief, treatment, adequate care and a safe Refuge. ARC also provides shelter to senior and differently abled street dogs.
ARC conducts regular and organized ABC programs, proper Vaccination, De-worming and feeding drives with an aim that one day there will be no animal going to sleep with a hungry tummy or without a roof above his/her head.

Happy's Place
Old Dogs Make Our Hearts Whole
In home based senior dog rescue for dogs who are at a higher risk of euthanasia due to age or other reason. Building relationships between people & old dogs to promote wellness, happiness, and living your best life.

Our Mission:
We rescue senior dogs by request who are still able to lead a quality life but who are also at a higher risk of euthanasia or unable to find forever adopted homes due to old age, medical needs such as chronic illness or special need, or other factors, including cases where dog guardians can no longer care for their senior dog due to their own health or other reason.

row: iM3 | The Global Name in Veterinary Dentistry

iM3 is a family owned veterinary Dental Company established in Sydney Australia over 28 years ago. In that time, iM3 has grown to become a leading veterinary dental company setting the standard in product innovation, industry firsts and continuing education.

From its three locations in Sydney Australia, Vancouver WA, USA and Co Meath , Ireland (Europe), iM3 supplies veterinarians throughout the world with high quality yet affordable veterinary dental products.

iM3 continues to design, develop and manufacture the latest veterinary dental machines, instruments, X-rays and dental consumables. Our large involvement in CE throughout the world means the people responsible for the development of new products also know how to use them.

The iM3 name is your guarantee of quality veterinary specific dental products coupled with the very best after sales support and warranty in the industry. Discover the difference!

Meet April & Bryan:
When I met Bryan in 2014, he worked in insurance and had never had a pet! I owned my photography business of 20 years and lived in East Nashville. By the time we got married in 2016, we had 5 dogs and a cat and knew we were ready to get out of the city. Moving to the country and starting a nonprofit rescue farm and animal sanctuary soon became a dream for both of us. Join us on this rescue journey, and together we can make a difference!

Fabled Farm Rescue & Sanctuary is a Middle TN based 501(c)3 committed to accepting and placing unwanted equines, farm animals, and kittens in qualified, loving forever homes, while continuing care for the unadoptable animals with medical or behavioral issues through our sanctuary program. In only a few short years Fabled Farm has helped over 500 animals and continues to expand its community outreach and programs.

Greek Animal Rescue is a UK registered charity, founded in 1989. We help abandoned, abused and neglected animals across Greece by supporting the local rescuers on the ground who step in when no one else will.

We’re entirely volunteer-run - no offices, no salaries and no overheads - so every penny you give goes directly to helping animals in need. From UK adoptions, emergency vet care and medication, to life-saving neutering campaigns and practical feed support, we focus on the unglamorous work that prevents suffering and changes lives long-term.

Please subscribe to follow rescue stories, see where your support goes and meet the dogs and cats you’re helping every day. 🐾

All enquiries and requests for assistance, please email: info@greekanimalrescue.com. For UK adoption enquiries please telephone our volunteer homing co-ordinator, Gillian, on 07795 170222.

We never meant to start Pet Angel Adoption. We didn't wake up one day and say "Let's start a cat rescue!" It started with two litter of kittens in Nancy and Jim Engel's backyard in little Frankenmuth, Michigan. When that two litter of kittens became cages of cats in the Engel Family's garage, Nancy and Jim realized what they had gotten into. They couldn't just stop saving kitties lives and finding them forever homes, so they rented out a building on List Street in Frankenmuth, moved the cats to the new location, and Pet Angel was born. 

Today, Pet Angel Adoption and Rescue is a volunteer-based, non-profit, no-kill cat shelter in that same building on List Street. We specialize in more than just the saving and rehoming of homeless, helpless and injured kitties, but we also offer awesome programs to the public in the Frankenmuth.

ASA's modest roots began in 1985 with a professor and 12 students in a small Brooklyn classroom. Known then as 'Advanced Software Analysis', the institute focused on computer programming, as New York had a dire shortage of qualified mainframe programmers at that time.

Since then, the college has grown to more than 3000 students, 20 programs of study, and 2 large, centrally-located campuses in midtown Manhattan and downtown Brooklyn. Today, in addition to computers, our programs focus on the rapidly-growing industries of healthcare, business and criminal justice.

Over the years, as technology revolutionized how every major industry operates, ASA created and updated programs of study to meet new market needs. Consistent with the demands and capabilities of our stu­dent body, which includes highly motivated and mature immigrants, ASA programs have always featured a "hands-on" training component.

B&W Equine Vets are leading the field in equine care across the South West. We have a large team of highly qualified vets that are on hand to offer the best possible care to your horse, pony or donkey. From each of our 3 branches, Breadstone, Failand and Willesley, we provide a full first opinion service covering all aspects of veterinary care from routine vaccinations, dental care and health checks to lameness examinations and reproductive work. 

Should you ever need it, our state of the art hospital is staffed by a team of RCVS, European & American Recognised specialists in surgery, orthopaedics, diagnostic imaging, internal medicine, sports medicine and rehabilitation. With a full range of surgical, diagnostic and intensive care facilities we can offer the highest level of specialist care.

My practice combines the application of joint mobilization/manipulation, soft tissue release, acupuncture and therapeutic progressive exercise to help my patients get out of pain and back to being active.   Though I do treat a lot of backs, necks and headaches I also treat a variety of problems to the shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, etc. 

My channel is about educating people on how to take care of themselves.

My name is  Dr. John Owings (Kilted Chiropractor) the executive director of Advanced Family Chiropractic Center. I'm very  passionate about the benefits of chiropractic and have cared for West Michigan families since 1997. We are now on YouTube and showing the world how we help improve people's health. 

Your health and well-being are our top priority! Advanced Family Chiropractic Center offers therapies to help reduce and eliminate pain. Same-day appointments are frequently available.

We focus on working with the muscles and the joints together, to help restore normal pain-free function as soon as possible.

Your personalized care plan addresses your problem areas specifically and combines chiropractic adjusting, nutrition counseling, massage therapy, exercise, and stress management to maximize your results.

We also will work closely with your family physician so that all of your health care needs are addressed.

KB Media Equine is an equestrian YouTube channel dedicated to authentic horse-world storytelling, behind-the-scenes barn life, and real conversations from every level of the sport.

We create cinematic equestrian documentaries, educational features, and long-form interviews with riders, trainers, owners, breeders, and adult amateurs. From hunter/jumper, dressage, and eventing to everyday barn life, our content highlights the passion, challenges, mental health, training journeys, and business of the equestrian industry.

Whether you’re an adult amateur rider, competitive equestrian, or lifelong horse lover, KB Media Equine brings you inside the ingate to experience the sport beyond the show ring — the preparation, pressure, wins, losses, and the community that makes it all worth it.

Subscribe for weekly equestrian content, horse industry insights, and stories that connect the equestrian community — because horses are more than a sport, they’re a way of life.

This is the Official Channel of OC Animal Care

OC Animal Care promotes responsible pet ownership, the health and safety of people and animals and spay/neuter programs. Through public education, community outreach programs and shelter events, OC Animal Care encourages shelter adoption, animal rescue and community involvement through volunteerism. 

The Animal Care Center provides temporary shelter and medical care for "lost" owned or stray animals and opportunities for adoption of these animals. OC Animal Care also provides pet licensing and patrol services to 18 contract cities and all the unincorporated areas of Orange County. OC Animal Care houses and provides medical care for impounded dogs, cats and exotic animals. 

See www.ocpetinfo.com for more information and cities served.

Paul Gough has helped 700+ Physical Therapists escape a life of 9-5 stuck inside the treatment room. He is a multi best selling author and when you subscribe to the channel - you can request your 100% free copy The New Patient Accelerator Method marketing book for Physical Therapists. 

As well as a six time best selling author, he is also a former professional soccer physical therapist turned successful clinic owner from the UK (a country where healthcare is free).

He is the founder of the Paul Gough Physio Rooms – a successful cash pay clinic he started from a spare room in his home with no money down and with no business or marketing skills.

He has since scaled his clinic from one to four locations, and zero to $1 million in cash pay revenue, and now helps clinic owners all across America and around the world to get more cash pay patients using his proven systems.

Your pet’s health is our priority. At Maricamp Animal Hospital, we provide veterinary care for each stage of life.

The College of Veterinary Medicine was established in 1905. (Centennial Celebration) Since then more than 5,000 men and women have been granted the Doctor of Veterinary Medicine degree. Departments within the College of Veterinary Medicine are anatomy and physiology, clinical sciences, diagnostic medicine/pathobiology.

The college's nationally recognized instructional and research programs provide the highest standards of professional education. A rich, varied, and extensive agricultural program in the area surrounding the college, a city with many pets and a zoo, and referrals from surrounding states provide a wealth of clinical material for professional education in veterinary medicine.

Welcome to Animal Rescue Center – a documentary channel focused on emotional animal rescue stories, brought to life through AI-assisted visual storytelling.
We produce realistic rescue-style films using artificial intelligence, capturing powerful moments of survival. Our stories span all conditions—from animals trapped in harsh winter blizzards to wildlife facing dangers in the blooming spring. We cover every environment where a life needs saving.
Realistic reconstructions of critical rescue missions.
Heartfelt stories of kindness and resilience in all seasons.
Our mission is to raise awareness and inspire compassion. We show how fragile wildlife truly is, teaching responsibility and respect for nature through every second chance we portray.
Our team transforms real, meaningful stories into emotionally powerful visual experiences. Join us where empathy becomes action, and every small life matters.

It is UK based, but welcome any veterinary professional from around the world. Formed in 2014, it represents another step in the evolution of the recognition of feeding pet animals food they would, logically, have adapted to over millennia in the wild. We are committed to professional, responsible communication, education and research on all areas of nutrition in dogs and cats.

row: V S Physiotherapy Osteopathy Chiropractic Lucknow

VS Physiotherapy Osteopath and Chiropractic Clinic Lucknow, founded by Dr. Venkatesh Mishra is a Physiotherapist Chiropractor and Osteopath. He did his BPT studies from Agra University and Post graduation in Musculoskeletal Disorder from HNB Gharwal University (Dehradun). Although done the Diplomate in osteopathic manipulative theory & practice from Osteopathic college of Ontario, Canada and Master in Osteopathy From JNU and Master of Chiropractic From Stockholm Sweden He is a Certified Manual Therapist, holds certificates in Taping, Pilates, Core Stability, Mulligan, MFR, Maitland, Osteopathy, PNF.
At V S Physiotherapy Osteopathy & Chiropractic Clinic, we specialize in non-invasive musculoskeletal treatments to provide safe and effective relief. Located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, we follow international standards in clinical physiotherapy with advanced assessment, diagnosis, and treatment techniques.
For more details or appointment call 7007932170

This channel is designed for:
• Veterinary students (DVM / BVSc)
• Veterinary teachers and educators
• Practicing veterinarians
• Candidates preparing for veterinary competitive and licensing examinations worldwide

📚 Subjects Covered:
• Veterinary Anatomy
• Veterinary Physiology
• Veterinary Pathology
• Veterinary Pharmacology
• Veterinary Microbiology
• Veterinary Parasitology
• Animal Husbandry
• Clinical Veterinary Sciences
Animal Reproduction

🎯 Our goal is to help learners strengthen concepts, revise efficiently, and assess exam readiness through well-structured MCQs aligned with international veterinary curricula.


📌 New videos are uploaded regularly.
🔔 Subscribe to stay updated with daily Veterinary MCQs.

We commonly see patients with symptoms like:
- Neck Pain
- Headaches
- Carpal Tunnel
- Low Back Pain
- Sciatica

Purpose  – to provide quality information on common back and neck issues of horses and dogs. 
Intro - In an era where misinformation and traditional misunderstanding is rife amongst our printed and online sources this channel is aimed at providing a more balanced, much more scientific view on back and neck pain in dogs and horses. The information is built on 40 odd years of ongoing study and practical experience as a veterinarian working with horses and dogs, with the last 25 years being dedicated to problems related to upper body (especially back and neck) pain and dysfunction.
Topics to be pursued - In horses: Sacroiliac joint pain, Girthy horses, Saddle Fitting problems, Horses not forward, Irregularity of gait, poll shyness, Head tossing, Shoulder and hip strain.  In Dogs:  Paralyzed dogs, Disc disease, Yelping in pain, Stiff back, Loss of ability to Jump, Cruciate ligament strain, Hip dysplasia. Elbow dysplasia.   Equine and Canine Acupuncture, Equine and Canine Chiropractic.

On this channel I will be inviting you into my life as a Licensed Massage Therapist. I also will include information and tutorials on What is Massage Therapy, How to perform a Massage, Pros and Cons of a Massage Therapy Career, Benefits of Massage Therapy, and How to become a Massage Therapist.


A native of Nashville, TN, Patrick has found a second home in Birmingham, AL for the past 10 years. Graduating from the Birmingham School of Massage in 2009, Patrick has provided sports massage to UAB’s Track Team, Women's Softball Team and Football Team along with Samford University's Football Team. Patrick holds the belief that one should consistently take care of the mind and body. He is passionate about massage and believes that massage creates a balance of the mind and body. He consistently works to perfect his craft with certification in Connective Tissue and Neuromuscular therapy as well as Yoga and Physical fitness.

Hi I'm Leila the Pet Vet, 
Welcome or welcome back to my channel!  

This channel started as a way for me to share animal facts and my animal encounters. As I've gotten older, I also want to share my overall TWEEN experience since there isn't a lot of that happening on YouTube right now. So stick around as I share parts of my life, discuss tween topics,  share some tween fashion, while still sharing my love for animals. 

I will upload new videos every Friday at 3PM CST!

Please remember  to SUBSCRIBE and Click the Notification bell so that you know whenever a new video is uploaded. 

For business inquiries you can send an email to leilathepetvet@gmail.com

This channel is managed by my mom Dionne :)

Thanks for coming on this journey with me and I hope you love it!

BYEEEEE

Leila the Pet Vet

We have purpose built premises at Lanark Market, a site that we have extended and developed three times since. Our Lanark branch also includes our equine referral hospital, while we added our Stirling Market branch for our farm and equine teams in 2014. 

Welcome to our YouTube channel! Keep a look out for new videos from all 3 of our departments soon! Don't forget to subscribe so when we upload a new video, you'll be the first to find out!

Welcome to Ask A Pet Vet, your trusted source for all things pet care! This channel is dedicated to providing pet owners with essential information to keep their furry companions healthy and happy. Here, you'll find expert advice from a licensed veterinarian, covering a variety of topics including nutrition, common health concerns, behavioral tips, and preventative care. Whether you have a dog, cat, or other small animals, our goal is to help you navigate the world of animal care with confidence. 

Join us as we share practical tips and answer your most pressing questions about pet health. We believe that informed pet owners make for happier pets, and we’re here to support you on that journey. 

Please note, while we strive to provide accurate and helpful information, our content is for informational purposes only and should not be considered professional veterinary advice. Always consult with a qualified veterinarian for specific concerns regarding your pet's health.

Hello beautiful dog people! 👋🐾

I'm Stephanie, a dog trainer specialising in rescue dogs, dogs adopted from abroad and bully breeds — and guardian to four rescue dogs of my own.

This channel is about understanding the dog in front of you: their behaviour, individual needs, experiences and the context around what they're doing.

You'll find practical videos about rescue dog life, behaviour and training, decompression, enrichment, confidence, living with dogs and all the messy bits that don't always fit neatly into a training tutorial.

I don't believe every dog needs the same recipe. I want to help you understand your dog, make informed decisions and build a life that works for both of you.

You'll also meet my own rescue dogs along the way — usually demonstrating that real life with dogs doesn't happen in a perfectly controlled training setup. 😅

New videos about rescue dogs, behaviour, training, enrichment and the humans living alongside them.

Welcome — I'm glad you're here. ❤️

Ventura County Animal Services (VCAS) offers a wide array of programs and services to the residents and animals of Ventura County. These services include animal sheltering, pet adoptions, lost & found, field services, cruelty investigations, pet licensing, TNR surgical services, low-cost vaccination clinics, volunteer/foster opportunities and emergency disaster response.

VCAS operates two open admission, life-saving, municipal animal shelters in the County of Ventura. The Camarillo Animal Shelter and the Simi Valley Animal Shelter.  VCAS provides contract services to the residents of Camarillo, Fillmore, Moorpark, Ojai, Oxnard, Port Hueneme, Simi Valley, Ventura, and all unincorporated areas of Ventura County. VCAS is dedicated to improving the lives of the animals in their care, and to safeguard the community through rabies suppression and the sheltering of stray animals.

Locations include the main campus in Blacksburg, Virginia; the Animal Cancer Care and Research Center in Roanoke, Virginia; the Marion duPont Scott Equine Medical Center in Leesburg, Virginia; and the Gudelsky Veterinary Center in College Park, Maryland.

row: Paul Owens, the Original Dog Whisperer

This is the official YouTube channel for Paul Owens, the Original Dog Whisperer, the non-violent and compassionate puppy and dog training expert for over 40 years and best-selling author of the Original Dog Whisperer & Puppy Whisperer books and DVDs.

Owens teaches only positive, non-force training methods and is nationally recognized as a leading proponent of nonviolent training. Coupling scientifically-proven methods with kindness, respect and compassion, this state-of-the-art training proves that there is no need for jerking, hitting, pinning, shocking or shaking to get reliable behavior.

row: National Volunteer and Philanthropy Centre - NVPC

NVPC is the national agency dedicated to growing a culture of volunteerism and philanthropy in Singapore. By engaging individuals, organisations, communities and leaders across the people, private and public sectors, we seek to create a more caring, inclusive, and compassionate society. Together, we envision Singapore as a City of Good, where everyone is able to give every day and everywhere (3Es), contributing their time, talent, treasure, ties, and testimony (5Ts).

The Lockwood Animal Rescue Center (LARC) is a unique animal welfare and veterans’ rehabilitation center. We rescue and provide sanctuary for wolves, wolfdogs and other animals who have been bred to live in a domestic environment and protect wolves in the wild. We also offer a therapeutic environment for combat veterans suffering from trauma through employment, job skill development, sobriety maintenance, and coordination of care. Most of LARC’s facility caregivers are former military personnel.

LARC’s main program is Wolves and Warriors. In this program, veterans suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and other traumas care for the wolves and wolfdogs at LARC. Our Wolves and Warriors veterans participate in rescue missions across the country, saving wolves and wolfdogs from pelting operations, roadside zoos, and cases of abuse and neglect.

The College of Massage Therapists of Ontario is the not-for-profit organization established by the provincial government to regulate the conduct of Registered Massage Therapists (RMTs) in the province of Ontario through the provisions of the Regulated Health Professions Act, 1991 (RHPA).

The mandate of the College is to ensure the public interest is placed at the centre of all College activities. This means that the focus is maintained on consumer needs, including the right to the provision of high quality, safe and ethical health care and that Massage Therapists are held accountable for the care they provide to the public of Ontario.

We’re the place for people who want to make a difference to the lives of foals, horses and ponies.

The Mare and Foal Sanctuary rescues horses and ponies that have been abandoned, neglected or abused.  We also ensure that horses and ponies have a sanctuary for life. Most horses and ponies are given care for life through our network of knowledgeable carers. Those horses and ponies with more complex needs are cared for in our peaceful sanctuaries.  

Our charity was founded on the principles that horses and ponies, as sentient beings and close companions of humans over the centuries, have a value and a purpose. They deserve our kindness and care. Our equine centred approach to equine assisted learning enables us to create a sense of sanctuary for people within our sanctuary for horses and ponies. 

We’re also here to offer no shame advice and support.

Registered charity number 1141831

Films made by and featuring South West Yorkshire Partnership NHS Foundation Trust.

We are a specialist NHS Foundation Trust that provides community, mental health and learning disability services to the people of Barnsley, Calderdale, Kirklees and Wakefield. The Trust also provides some medium secure (forensic) services to the whole of Yorkshire and the Humber.

Over 1 million people live in Barnsley, Calderdale, Kirklees and Wakefield across urban and rural communities from a range of diverse backgrounds. We aim to match the community's needs with locally sensitive and efficient services.

We work with other local NHS organisations to provide comprehensive health care to people in our area. We also work closely with local authorities (social care) and with other government departments and voluntary organisations. Working in partnership is very important to us and is vital if we are to continue delivering high quality services for local people.

row: Doctor Light: Curtis Turchin, DC, MA

Curtis Turchin, M.A., D.C. has been considered one of the experts in the field of light and laser therapy for over 40 years. He has published 4 books, more than 20 journal articles, and has been extensively interviewed on radio and television. Dr. Turchin’s has a YouTube channel and a teaching website at: https://www.doctorlight.org/

Dr. Turchin is the author of the text, Light and Light Therapy: Clinical Procedures, described as the authoritative text on clinical light treatment as well as LED and Light Therapy, Veterinary Laser Therapy, and Treating Addictions with Light Therapy, the only book published on this unique subject.  Dr. Turchin has taught therapists and doctors all over the world. He has a bachelor’s degree in pre-medical studies from the University of Southern California, a master’s degree in education from San Francisco State University, and a doctor of chiropractic from Palmer College. He is in private practice in the Sonoma wine country.

row: University of Wisconsin School of Veterinary Medicine

The University of Wisconsin-Madison School of Veterinary Medicine advances animal and human health through its exceptional work and leadership in teaching, research, and clinical service. The school prepares future veterinarians, provides research training for graduate students in the comparative biomedical sciences, makes discoveries that benefit global health, and delivers high-quality care for patients and clients. It is ranked by US News & World Report as one of the top schools of veterinary medicine in the United States. 

In addition our animal hospital, UW Veterinary Care, has more specialty services and specialists than any other clinic in Wisconsin. Our faculty and staff are dedicated to providing the very best care for your companion or farm animal. Diverse specialty services include 24/7 Emergency Care, Anesthesiology, Wildlife and Zoo Animal Medicine, and our world-renowned Food Animal and Production Medicine Service.

row: In-Sync Exotics Wildlife Rescue and Educational Center

Our Mission:  We provide a caring safe haven to some of God's most beautiful creatures. We put their needs before all else; the old, the maimed, and the unwanted find sanctuary here. In-Sync Exotics is unique because the facility provides a loving home for animals that most other sanctuaries are unable or unwilling to accept due to health or age-related problems.

In-Sync Exotics believes that all God's creatures should be protected and not destroyed due to problems with the animals' ownership circumstances (albeit with private owners, zoos, or other animal zoos or sanctuaries).  We strive in educating the young and the young at heart on the realities of irresponsible captive ownership practices and the need for conservation. Learn, volunteer or donate, please visit our website: http://www.insyncexotics.org

The Gazette in Janesville, Wisconsin, is an award-winning newspaper covering Rock and Walworth counties. The Gazette was named Wisconsin’s Newspaper of the Year four years in a row and GazetteXtra.com the state’s best newspaper website six out of the last eight years.

The Gazette and GazetteXtra.com feature news, sports, opinion, features and blogs under one unifying idea: Local matters.

The Gazette is the oldest business in Janesville.

Levi Alden and Z.A. Stoddard launched The Janesville Gazette in 1845 as a weekly newspaper with 300 subscribers. Howard F. Bliss acquired the company in 1883 and passed it to his son Harry H. Bliss in 1919. Harry's sons Sidney H. and Robert W. succeeded their father in 1937. Skip Bliss acquired the company as publisher and president in 1992. Adams Publishing Group acquired the newspaper in 2019.

GazetteXtra.com launched in 1997.

The i-Care team prides itself on the compassionate and friendly atmosphere that we have created within our clinic. We know that visits to the veterinary hospital can be stressful, especially when your animal is sick, and we try to minimize this stress as much as possible. We are a locally owned clinic that strives to deliver a caring and personalized experience for both our clients and patients.

Proudly serving Central Vancouver Island

Providing primary care veterinary services for the Coombs, Errington, Qualicum Beach, Parksville, Nanaimo, and Port Alberni regions.

Our YouTube channel is a way for us to pull back the curtain and let clients and potential team members see the dedication, passion and love our team has for the care of your animal family members. We also hope to educate clients about pet health care so that you can provide the care your animal friends and family need.

In collaboration with Mission Rabies India, we also work to create safer communities through free anti-rabies vaccination programs, rabies response, and public awareness initiatives.
On this channel, you’ll find:
• Animal rescue stories
• Medical treatments and rehabilitation
• Happy adoption journeys
• Community animal welfare initiatives
• Rabies awareness and prevention
• Sterilisation & Responsible ownership

Every rescue is made possible by the kindness and support of people like you. Subscribe to follow our journey, share our mission, and help us give vulnerable animals a second chance at life.Together, we can build a kinder world for animals.

Ranked among the top 10 veterinary schools worldwide, the University of Pennsylvania School of Veterinary Medicine (Penn Vet) is a global leader in veterinary education, research, and clinical care. Founded in 1884, Penn Vet is the first veterinary school developed in association with a medical school. 

Penn Vet serves a diverse population of animals through its two teaching hospitals, which both feature diagnostic and research laboratories. Ryan Hospital in Philadelphia provides care for dogs, cats, and other companion animals. Penn Vet New Bolton Center in Kennett Square, PA, offers on-site veterinary services for horses and farm animals and farm visits through its Field Service unit.

row: At the Michigan State University College of Veterinary Medicine and Veterinary Medical Center, our mission is to Learn. Discover. Heal. and Protect. We are a trusted leader in animal health and we deliver unparalleled solutions to serve an ever-evolving world. The abundance and variety of animal agriculture and companion animals in Michigan provides the College with one of the largest clinical and diagnostic caseloads in the country. Educational and research opportunities are considerably enhanced by this large caseload. The College also takes seriously its obligation to meet the needs of society in addition to clinical services and education. We have expertise in public health, biomedical and comparative medical research, ecosystem and environmental management, and the multiple facets that compose our complex global food system. The College also supports key animal health programs conducted by both the Michigan Department of Agriculture and the US Department of Agriculture.

row: NLSSM The School of Sports Massage

Established in 2004 in London by Susan Findlay, NLSSM is the training ground for professionals wanting to develop and strengthen their soft tissue skills. We offer a Level 5 Qualification in Sports Massage and Remedial Soft Tissue Therapy as well as CPD short courses.

Our Level 5 Diploma is designed for anyone with a serious interest in pursuing corrective soft tissue therapy as a career.
We will take you from start to finish without having to do multiple massage courses at various levels, no prior Level 3 or 4 training necessary. It will give you the skills needed to practice as an independent professional therapist, work with elite sports athletes, or work within a medical hands-on health care team.

We’re proud of the reputation that NLSSM The School of Sports Massage holds within the industry and and that our graduates are highly sought after within both the sport and health industries. 

Find out more: https://www.nlssm.com/diploma/

London College of Animal Osteopathy (LCAO) offers world-class online training in animal osteopathy, designed for veterinarians, equine professionals, canine therapists, osteopaths, and animal care practitioners looking to advance their clinical skills and career.

Our International Diploma in Animal Osteopathy provides comprehensive training in both equine osteopathy and canine osteopathy, combining evidence-based theory with practical application for real-world clinical outcomes.

Delivered through a flexible, self-paced online format, our programs allow you to study from anywhere in the world, with optional hands-on clinical training (MasterClass) available in select global locations.

Students learn under the guidance of Prof. Stuart McGregor, Director of Clinical Studies, alongside an expert international faculty.

 Start your journey in animal osteopathy today: www.animalosteopathycollege.com

row: The Ohio State University College of Veterinary Medicine has an ambition to Be The Model™ comprehensive college of veterinary medicine in the world, our program is focused on innovation, collaboration and excellence in education, research, patient care, outreach and service.  Since 1885, the college has graduated almost 10,000 DVM, MS and PhD students. Our alumni practice in all 50 states and 40 countries. Within Ohio, our graduates make up more than 80 percent of the practicing veterinarians in the state. Encompassing four hospitals and a large animal practice, the Veterinary Health System provides care for more than 72,000 canine, feline, equine and farm animal patients each year. Researchers in the signature program areas of comparative and translational oncology, infectious disease and neuromusculoskeletal science are impacting not only veterinary medicine but human health care as well.

Equine Sports Medicine Veterinarian Audrey DeClue and Podcaster of "The Horse First Podcast" uncovers the science of undiagnosed conditions such as Equine Shivers and Stringhalt (Shivers-Stringhalt Syndrome), Equine Headshaking Syndrome, Idiopathic Hopping in Ridden horses, Girthy horses, Sleep Deprivation in horses and many other lameness issues in sport horses.  A simple six step approach is used to solve conditions affecting horses and equid species for centuries: 
1. History of the condition
2. KISS Theory (Keep It Simple Stupid)
3. Anatomy and "Ologies"
4. Form=Function
5. The Curiosity of Why?
6.Thinking for Yourself!

Come join her for the ride of undiagnosed horses in the field of equine sports medicine!

If you want to support us, you can buy us a tea/coffee 😁

For over 3 decades, GerVetUSA Inc. has been a trusted name in veterinary surgical instruments, combining precision, innovation, and reliability. From selecting the raw material to forging it into a final product, we have strict quality checks on every step.

With cutting-edge, German-forged instruments for all specialties, from general surgery to orthopedics and dentistry, we strive to make veterinary practice easier and more effective.

If we don’t have an instrument you’re looking for, we will manufacture it for you. Just let us know your requirements!

Connect with us to explore how we can support your practice.

Let’s grow together.

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue (Dedication and Everlasting Love to Animals) is the largest "No Kill, Care-for-Life," Sanctuary of its kind in the world.

The D.E.L.T.A. Rescue Super Sanctuary is home to more than 1500 animals that have all been abandoned in the wilderness. The animals at the sanctuary will never have to worry about being lost and alone again.

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue receives no help from the government and relies solely on donor contributions and is tax -exempt 501 [c] 3 organization dedicated to rescuing animals abandoned in the wilderness and stopping the cruel practice of animal abandonment.

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue was awarded BEST IN AMERICA status by Independent Charities of America! In a letter congratulating D.E.L.T.A. Rescue, ICA said to be proud -- only about 3% of the charities they deal with earn this recognition. They study charities, analyze their expenses and their mission, and make a determination.

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue also received a 4 STAR Rating on Charity Navigator.

row: Restore Therapy Scar Training and Scar Clinic

Emma Holly at Restore Therapy is the leading educator in Britain on the subject of scars for manual therapists and over 2,000 therapists have enrolled onto the Restore Therapy courses. She teaches scar therapy courses online and in-person and lectures internationally. Therapist training courses are available around the UK, Australia and New Zealand and online.  Private clinic appointments with Emma in London’s most prestigious medical address, Harley Street.

Scar therapy is used to improve feeling and functionality in the scar and surrounding tissues, creating better movement between the layers of the skin, fascia (connective tissue) and muscle. Using non-invasive methods to help mature or new scars and complications associated with surgery and trauma such as fibrosis and adhesions.  See www.restoretherapy.co.uk for training details and www.restoretherapyclinic.co.uk to book a private scar therapy treatment with Emma in Harley Street.

Our team provides ABA therapy, physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy to help children reach their full potential. Through a play-based approach, we support skill development in communication, motor abilities, sensory processing, and everyday routines.
You’ll find videos that give families a closer look at what happens inside our therapy sessions, tips from our licensed therapists, and stories of growth from our amazing Compleat Kidz community.
Whether you’re a parent, educator, or healthcare professional, our channel is your resource for understanding and supporting child development through collaborative, compassionate care.

📍 Serving families across North Carolina
🌐 Learn more at compleatkidz.com

row: The Veterinary Life Coach, Dr. Julie Cappel

Hi, Everyone, Welcome to my channel!   I am veterinarian Dr. Julie Cappel. I am a small animal and exotic pet veterinarian, author, speaker, podcaster and most importantly a life coach for those that work in the veterinary industry.

Veterinary Medicine is my passion and life's work.  I love what I do.  I am a certified life coach and compassion fatigue professional.  I am passionate about people and animals, so I developed my podcast and coaching to support veterinarians, practice managers, and veterinary technicians - anyone that works with vetmed. 

My podcast includes guests from veterinary medicine, coaching, self-development, and business.

If you like my videos, please subscribe and leave a comment. 

My music is written by my amazing son, Tristan.  tristancappel.com

My daughter, Bridget, does my photography, website, and editing.  Watch her videos at @bridgetcappel

Thank you for subscribing and watching!  I love hearing from my viewers and podcast listeners. Julie

To all the vets and future vets of the country, thank you for all your hard work and never give up. What you do for both people and animals is incredible. You are really making this world a better place. I hope you enjoy my channel and that it can help you on your journey.

We receive no government funding and rely heavily on the support of the public to carry out our work.

University of Western States offers a world-class, integrated health care education and provides an evidence-informed approach to health and wellness. Our graduates deliver high-quality health care based on science, the professional’s skill and knowledge, and the preferences and experiences of the patient or client.

The university is in the forefront of an emerging, whole-person philosophy of health care by offering a variety of health and wellness educational programs. As a leader in health sciences education since 1904, University of Western States provides integrated, evidence-informed curricula grounded in our dedication to current research and practices. The commitment spans all of our graduate and professional programs: chiropractic health care, naturopathic medicine, human nutrition and functional medicine, sport and performance psychology, clinical mental health counseling and sports medicine.

row: Angels Among Us Pet Rescue, Inc. is a 501(c)(3), non-profit, volunteer-based organization dedicated to rescuing dogs and cats from high-kill shelters in North Georgia. It was created in February 2009 by a group of people in the Atlanta area who wanted to do more to save the many adoptable dogs and cats who found themselves on death row in Georgia animal control facilities. Our motto is “Rescue One Until There are None.” As of May 12, 2021 we have rescued more than 18,000 dogs and cats. Most of these animals came into our program from high-kill animal control facilities throughout Georgia.  If you want to make a difference and help animal rescue in Georgia, you can donate, adopt a pet, foster a pet, or volunteer your time to advocate for animal welfare policies in Georgia, like low cost spay neuter, anti-tethering and protections for K9 officers and dogs in hot cars.

Connecticut’s Kid Governor® empowers 5th graders to change the world. This ground-breaking approach to civics education immerses students in a real election for their state’s Kid Governor, a fellow 5th grader who will represent them during a one-year term of active leadership. More than a contest and not just about the position of governor, the program teaches important lessons about state government, voting, elections, and civic participation.

Subscribe to the Connecticut's Kid Governor® YouTube channel or follow the program on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter (@CTKidGovernor) for the latest updates. Learn more at CT.KidGovernor.org.

Connecticut's Kid Governor® is an award-winning civics program for 5th graders created by The Connecticut Democracy Center at Connecticut's Old State House.

Thousands of homeless dogs roam the streets in this community.  Many are injured or caring for young litters of puppies.  
We open our doors to dogs in need and provide them with food, shelter, veterinary care, and a place to call home, for however long they need. 
 
We give them hope. Please join us.

Established in 1910 and located in scenic Central New York. We are proud to celebrate over 100 years and three generations of service. Our family-run practice has nine doctors, including a full-time board-certified surgeon, a part-time board-certified radiologist, and a part-time board-certified cardiologist. We also offer canine & feline rehabilitation, laser therapy, grooming, as well as hospice and palliative care. Paw Talk is Stack Veterinary Hospital's weekly radio show. Two of our doctors answer listener questions on pet health every Sunday between 10-11AM on Newsradio 570 WSYR (106.9 FM)

We are proud to have been AAHA-accredited since 1957, and Cat Friendly Certified. Our state-of-the-art facility offers:
•	Digital radiography
•	Ultrasound
•	Cardiology
•	A cat-only waiting area
•	Eight exam rooms
•	A fully-equipped dental suite
•	A spacious surgery suite

Western Canada's busiest wildlife rehabilitation centre, caring for nearly 5,000 animals every year. #WildlifeRescueBC

The Wildlife Rescue Association of BC was established in 1979 to rehabilitate wildlife affected by human activity and provide education to the public on co-existing with urban wildlife.

With a team of professional wildlife rehabilitators and an army of volunteers, we are able to provide temporary refuge to a diverse range of animals. We are not a wildlife sanctuary and once the animals in our care are healthy and ready to live in the wild, we release them back to their natural habitat.

Your donation supports our efforts to care for and rehabilitate an annual average of 5,000 wild animals representing 150 species. Together, we are giving injured, orphaned and pollution damaged wildlife a second chance at life. 

https://www.wildliferescue.ca/give/

All of the animals at Kindness Ranch Animal Sanctuary have previously been used in laboratory research. We have a small but hardworking staff, all of who live on site to provide the animals with the best possible hands-on care.

Some of our experienced staff members live with the dogs and work daily on socialization, crate-training, housebreaking, leash-walking, and basic commands. The cats receive an abundance of play time, trees for climbing, an outdoor space for exploring, and socialization with other cats and visitors.

Our horses and other farm animals also receive daily care and socialization. The horses and cows are free to roam most of our 1,000 acres, and the sheep and pigs have access to open grazing land, as well. These animals are visitor favorites and will likely live out their lives at Kindness Ranch.

There may be new and better treatments available through your Vet, Oncologist, and Veterinary Universities with clinical trials and research.  As time goes on, our posted videos are unchanging, So I encourage you to also check out disease specific forums, for many times there will be recommendations on new treatments you can discuss with your Vet, that may benefit your pet.

Alberta Animal Rescue Crew Society - AARCS

MISSION: Changing Lives Through Kindness
VISION: A Compassionate World For All Animals

In Alberta, thousands of cats and dogs are homeless, abandoned, abused or living in horrendous conditions. We work closely with rural and First Nations communities where there is limited to no animal services. In 2015, AARCS took in over 2,000 cats and dogs. We cared for them by providing medical care, spaying/neutering, vaccinating and then found their forever families. AARCS also has assistance programs such as Spay/Neuter, TNR (Trap-Neuter-Return) for Cats and Emergency Medical Assistance.

About Virbac

Founded in 1968 by a French veterinarian, Virbac is an independent pharmaceutical laboratory dedicated to animal health, since the beginning. Currently ranked 8th worldwide, the company is present in more than 100 countries, offering a comprehensive and practical range of products and services covering the majority of species and pathologies. Virbac innovation, based on both technological advances and listening to the customers, relies on reactive production facilities which meet the highest international quality standards. For nearly fifty years, these specific features have allowed the company to build a personalized relationship with veterinarians and farmers in every country. Through this privileged partnership, in which social, health and environmental issues come together, Virbac contributes, day after day, to shape the future of animal health.

Kansas State University is a three-campus system, and K-State Olathe, which officially opened on April 26, 2011, is the newest member of the family. Complementing the main campus in Manhattan and the College of Technology and Aviation in Salina, the Olathe campus is the academic research presence within the Kansas Bioscience Park, leveraging K-State's broad capabilities and its many resources on the Manhattan campus.
Mission
K-State Olathe advances the mission of Kansas State University by integrating education, research and entrepreneurship focused on animal health, food safety and security to address the needs of a rapidly changing world.
Description
The goal of this campus is to teach students but also be a place where professionals come to continue their learning. It is home to graduate level students as they prepare for careers in the biosciences and biotechnology, and provides opportunities to work with faculty from Kansas State as well as industry scientists.

I hope you enjoy.

row: Hope In The Valley Equine Rescue

Horses from all walks of life, can find a safe and welcoming place at Hope In The Valley Equine Rescue and Sanctuary in Valley Center, KS.  Since 2005, the rescue has helped over 500 horses, donkeys, and mules find a better life.

Horses can be offered hope in emergency situations where their owners have passed or can no longer provide for them, in the event of neglect or abandonment cases under investigation by law enforcement, or on the occasion when the Hope Team finds an equine in need of rescue at auction.

Hope exists to rescue, rehabilitate, reconnect, and rehome –

“To Give Them A Better Life”.

row: Hi I'm Danielle and I am an equine physical therapist based in the UK.  I have been living my best life as an equine therapist since 2009 and I LOVE my work.  I use a range of different modalities including sports massage, trigger point therapy, Masterson Method and myofascial release for injury prevention, injury rehabilitation and to work towards optimum performance.  I am lucky enough to work on a wide range of horses from adored leisure horses and treasured golden oldies to performance horses working at the highest levels and I learn from each and every one of them - every day's a school day!  I hope you enjoy browsing my videos and I would love to hear from you either here or at my FB page - just search danielle equine sports massage.  Enjoy! X.

The physiotherapy service serves the population in the areas surrounding Ashford and St Peters Foundation NHS trust, for both in patient and out patient care.
The aim of physiotherapy is to assist patients of all ages in identifying and maximising their movement potential and improving their quality of life.

We have a variety of in patient teams including respiratory/medical, surgical, orthopaedic, neurological and paediatric teams, who cover all acute admissions at the St Peters site, and offer quality post-operative and rehabilitation services at the Ashford hospital site.


These videos were developed for patients attending ASPH Physiotherapy.  You can follow the advice provided within these videos at your own risk and seek professional physiotherapy advice to help further if required.

We specialise in the hardest cases.

Certified Animal Chiropractor/Rehab Practitioner in San Diego. Specializing in cats, dogs, & geriatrics. Pet loss grief supporter💔🐾❤️‍🩹

www.MarChiropractic.com
MAR - Mar Animal Rehab🐾👩🏻‍⚕️

Animal Chiro/Rehab therapy focuses on the health & recovery of the neuro-musculoskeletal system, offering a hands-on, non-surgical treatment option. Animal Chiro/Rehab does not replace veterinary medicine nor assume responsibility of primary health care. Chiro/Rehab for animals is meant to enhance comprehensive healthcare through integrative approach

Benefits of Chiro/Rehab for Animals:
•Decreases Pain by Reducing Joint Misalignment
•Slows Progression of Degenerative Conditions
•Stimulates Circulation, Increases Lymph Drainage & Flexibility 
•Increases Nervous System Function
•Wonderful Pain Management for Cats
•Can Help Animals Wean Off Certain Medications (Under DVM Supervision)
•Allows for Symmetrical, Balanced Growth & Development
•Increases Quality (& often Quantity) of Life During Final Days

row: Bhatt Integrative Vet Specialty – Dr. Priya Bhatt

Specialist integrative and specialty veterinary care for dogs and cats in Glenview, IL and across the U.S. Dr. Bhatt combines the best of modern medicine with proven traditions like Chinese Veterinary Medicine (TCVM), Ayurvedic practices, and more.

With our 360° care philosophy, we deliver complete, concierge-level veterinary care by:
    - Integrating Eastern and Western medical knowledge
    - Empowering you as a key partner in your pet’s care
    - Maintaining exceptional communication for every case

About Dr. Priya Bhatt
Dr. Priya Bhatt, DVM, MS, CVA, CVFT, CVMMPa, is an integrative veterinarian with a Doctorate of Veterinary Medicine from the University of Illinois College of Veterinary Medicine. She is certified in Veterinary Acupuncture, Food Therapy, and Veterinary Medical Manipulation, trained in Level II Reiki, and serves on the Board of Directors for the Illinois State Veterinary Medical Association.

Subscribe to engage in expert integrative veterinary care and knowledge!

Wildlife Images has since expanded to provide educational programs on wildlife, conservation, and the environment to schools, organizations and the general public. The center currently operates under the direction of David Siddon Jr., who continues on with his father’s mission.

Greyhound Rescue ethically rescues, lovingly rehabilitates, and safely rehomes greyhounds; giving them a voice through advocacy and education.

Greyhound Rescue focuses on adopting out greyhounds as family pets and also has a thriving foster care program. Our kennel facility in Sydney offers a home to dozens of greyhounds, giving them a chance to decompress from their time as a racing greyhound and expose them to new experiences in preparation for the transition from racing dog to pet greyhound. 

Adoptions are carefully matched on a case-by-case basis with our experienced staff and volunteers evaluating the temperament of the greyhounds and the needs of the adopters. Once hounds are adopted we provide support to adoptive families to ensure that our greyhounds are living their happily ever after.

Greyhound Rescue believes that all greyhounds deserve a chance at pet life and we follow positive and force-free training practices.

http://www.greyhoundrescue.com.au

row: Sherman College of Chiropractic offers a first professional degree program leading to the doctor of chiropractic degree. Renowned globally for its unique approach to health care, the college is committed to producing doctors who are highly skilled in detecting and correcting vertebral subluxations and are compassionate, ethical, and successful. Sherman College emphasizes a comprehensive chiropractic education by diligently teaching the philosophy and principles that distinguish chiropractic as a separate and distinct profession. Through innovative teaching methods, students become well-versed in the philosophy, science, art, and business of chiropractic, ensuring professional fulfillment and practice success as they serve communities worldwide. Students receive hands-on experience in the college's on-campus Chiropractic Center, with senior students gaining hands-on experience under the careful supervision of licensed doctors of chiropractic. Visit www.sherman.edu for more information.

We also offer specialist training in yoga therapy as well as a range of other courses, workshops and events for all levels of students. Many of our courses are taught by some of the most respected teachers in the world and all are run by a friendly and supportive team of yogis.

Big Little Life Animal Rescue is a volunteer-run 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to giving abandoned, injured, and forgotten dogs a second chance.

Every video on this channel is part of a real rescue story.
Some of these dogs arrive starving, sick, or badly injured. Some have spent years on chains. Some have never known kindness at all. 
We share their journeys exactly as they happen, from emergency rescues and veterinary care to recovery, adoption, and the quiet moments that remind us why we keep going.
Not every story has a happy ending. But every dog deserves someone to fight for them.
If you've ever wondered whether one person can make a difference, you're in the right place.

Thank you for being here, for watching, for sharing these stories, and for helping us change lives, one dog at a time. ❤️

We provide a wide range of cryo devices from desk-top cryo units to ultra-portable pen-like devices, and we serve customers in over 40 countries. CryoConcepts is dedicated to being "All Things Cryo" and is committed to innovation and bringing technologies to the market that are environmentally sustainable.

I volunteer at animal shelters in Cyprus and share the sad and happy stories of these poor animals. Join me at the shelter as I give some love to the animals in need. There is a huge problem here in Cyprus with abandoned, abused, and neglected animals. These shelters work to save these animals and to find them their forever homes in nearby countries. I hope to spread the word that adoption is a rewarding choice. 

Some rescue groups I love:

TAKIS SHELTER - A wonderful man in Crete, dedicates his life to rescuing and running a large non-profit shelter. He offers short stay live-in volunteer opportunities if you want to combine a vacation with giving.

ARC - Animal Rescue Corps in Tennessee, called in situations such as puppy mill raids, hoarding, and police involved cruelty cases. Volunteer opportunities.

HOPE FOR PAWS - An angel in California who dedicates his life to rescuing.

I’m Irene Diamond. In 1995, I opened San Francisco’s very first wellness center, Diamond Pain Relief & Wellness. Today, as Clinical Director, I work with just a handful of clients each month, specializing in migraine, fibromyalgia, and orthopedic rehab.

I created Active Modulation Therapy® and Diamond Active Massage™️—The Diamond Method®, unique “inside-out” approaches where clients actively move during treatment with therapeutic exercises for superior progress. These methods deliver faster pain and stress relief, easier movement, and lasting guaranteed results.

I’m also a best-selling author and consultant. Health and wellness practitioners worldwide—massage therapists, physical therapists, chiropractors, acupuncturists, and luxury spas—turn to me to maximize revenue, delight clients, and prevent burnout. I also provide corporate wellness training for companies ready to elevate employees' health.

👉 Subscribe, comment, and click links: 
Together, we’re even more brilliant.
~ Irene

Learn essential techniques, assessments, and injury prevention strategies to advance your skills as a sports massage therapist. I’m a qualified sports massage tutor with over 10 years of experience teaching learners how to build confidence, pass assessments, and deliver effective treatments.

Whether you’re a practising therapist or just looking to level up, this channel offers expert guidance and practical tips to help you succeed. This content is for therapists who want to improve their practice — it’s not a substitute for formal training. Use what you learn at your own risk (but don’t worry, we’ve got your back)!

🎯 Subscribe and start mastering sports massage today!

The Southampton Animal Shelter Foundation (SASF) is a 501(c)3 non-profit, open-admission, no-kill- shelter that relies on the generosity of our donors and volunteers to care for the homeless animals in our community and place them in loving forever homes.

Our mission is to nurture the bond between humans and companion animals through education, advocacy, and adoption. We enrich the lives of the animals in our care through training, affection, and veterinary services, ultimately placing them in a loving forever home!

row: Cardiff University School of Healthcare Sciences

We are dynamic, innovative and forward looking. We are recognised for our excellence in learning, teaching and research.

We are committed to the development of impactful healthcare knowledge that directly improves health outcomes and healthcare for patients and families. Our activities encompass a broad range of healthcare sciences including: Midwifery, Nursing (Adult, Child and Mental Health), Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy, and Radiography (diagnostic and therapeutic).

We pride ourselves on pursuing research and scholarship of the highest quality, and we are one of the leading healthcare research departments in the UK. Our unique, multidisciplinary nature provides a rounded experience for our students, ensuring they become skilled, knowledgeable and compassionate healthcare professionals committed to an ethos of evidence-based care.

Graduated from the Anglo European College of Chiropractic in Bournemouth, England, where he specialized in neurology, kinesiology,
pediatrics, and sports medicine.

After graduating, he became curious about functional neurology and worked at Newland Chiropractic Clinic, in Lincoln. There, in addition to being a chiropractor, he was the director of neurological rehabilitation.

From August 2018 to July 2022 ran his own clinic in Lucca, Italy, and worked along side Erik Bergstrom, one of the best chiropractors in Italy.

During this time he was secretary of the International College of Applied Kinesiology Italy and member of the chiropractic research commette of the Chiropractic Italian Association (AIC).

• Injury prevention and long-term function

Hundreds of thousands of healthy and treatable cats and dogs are being abandoned and killed in pounds, shelters and vet clinics each year in Australia.
 
This is preventable.
 
Getting to Zero (G2Z) aims to increase responsibility for companion animals so that every community and municipality can achieve zero euthanasia of all healthy and treatable cats and dogs.
 
G2Z is relevant to state governments, local government, pounds, shelters, rescue groups, breed organisations, breeders, pet shops, animal trainers, groomers, wildlife organisations, veterinarians, and all community members who are concerned about better management and welfare of cats and dogs.
The Getting to Zero Model details the principles, structures and strategies for achieving zero killing of healthy and treatable cats and dogs (more than 90% of all incoming stray and surrendered cats and dogs) in whole communities.

Go to www.g2z.org.au to find out more.

Welcome to the Chiropractic Health Channel, where our goal is to empower you to achieve vibrant health through informed decisions and practices.  We do this by bringing to you important information and health best practices that enable you to make meaningful, wise decisions when it comes to managing what is probably your most important asset: your good health!     
Our fundamental premise is that the most important player on your health care and maintenance team is you.  If your wish is to enjoy good health and the vibrant quality of life that accompanies it, the decisions that you make about your health are very, very important.  And you cannot make wise decisions, the kind that will have a major impact upon your quality of life, without good information.

We have compiled the wisdom, tools and advice from hundreds of experts on the subject of chiropractic from all over the world and offer them here in a series of what we call "Patient Enlightenment Moments". Enjoy!

row: In The Vet's Office with Dr. Josie Horchak

iHeartMedia and The Nashville Podcast Network presents "In The Vet's Office" with Dr. Josie Horchak. Each episode, veterinarian Dr. Josie Horchak, sits down with her co-host Shannon Ella to answer questions she's constantly hearing at the office -- What should I feed my dog? How do I potty train my puppy? Do I really need to brush my pet's teeth? Dr. Josie helps listeners navigate pet ownership through sharing cases she's seen in her 18+ year career as a veterinarian, answering listener calls, and giving her weekly "Paw & Order" list of things she would never do with her own pets. Dr. Josie has treated pets from the high rises of downtown Chicago to the pets of country stars in Nashville. Her ability to relate with owners has made her one of the most sought-after veterinarians in the country.

Brazil has one of the most largest stray population in the world and weakest legislation in animal sector. We rescue injured, abused, sick animals from street and giving them a chance to start a better life 2.0. We create castrations and vaccinations campaign among poor communities by offering free castration and vaccines for stray animals only and low income families. You can participate by donating to our organization or buy sharing our videos that others can get more familiar with lives of stray animals in Brazil. We believe that world can help Brazil by providing a financial assistance in castration and vaccinations of stray animals. There are 30+ million strays here. Please help these forgotten animals to have a better life. Vaccinations and castrations limit animals struggles. You can donate directly to United Animal rescue through PayPal: donations@unitedanimalrescue.com

Welcome to Horse Rescue Alliance 🐎
Where every hoofprint matters.

At Horse Rescue Alliance, we rescue, rehabilitate, and rehome horses in need—giving neglected, abandoned, and slaughter-bound equines a second chance at life. Based in Davie Fl, our mission is to provide safe haven, medical care, training, and love to horses who have suffered abuse, starvation, or abandonment.

We believe every horse deserves a life of dignity, and through our work, we strive to raise awareness about horse slaughter, neglect, and the importance of responsible ownership. On this channel, you’ll find:

✨ Heartwarming rescue stories
🐴 Before-and-after transformations
🏡 Adoption success videos
📚 Horse care tips & educational content
📸 Behind-the-scenes of our daily rescue life

Subscribe to join our herd and help us spread hope, healing, and compassion—one horse at a time.

🌟 Let’s change lives together.
#HorseRescue #AdoptDontShop #EquineWelfare #HorseRehab #HorseRescueAlliance

We are a group of lectures at the University of South Wales teaching Physiotherapy and Chiropractic. Pain education is a big part of our work and alongside play our view of health and musculoskeletal rehabilitation is holistic yet underpinned by the latest scientific literature. If people enjoy rehab they are more likely to adhere to it. We have taught our approach to personal trainers, coaches, osteopaths, occupational therapy amongst other allied professions and are BJSM certified. Skelian Chiropractic Clinic is a multi-award wining chiropractic clinic based in Cheltenham, UK. The chiropractors at the clinic have been helping the local community with musculoskeletal problems for over 20 years. Over these years we have provided the highest standards of care to our patients. 

Chiropractic is a healthcare profession that specialises in the diagnosis and treatment of conditions involving the muscles, bones, joints and nerves of the body. Although chiropractors are best known for treating back and neck pain, they also treat a wide range of other musculoskeletal conditions, for which the evidence base is fairly broad across a range of musculoskeletal complaints, for example:

+ Acute and Chronic Back Pain
+ Sciatica
+ Mechanical Neck Pain
+ Cervicogenic Headache
+ Prevention of Migraine
+ Minor Sports Injuries
+ Joint Pain
+ Shoulder Complaints
+ Elbow Pain
+ Ankle Sprains

row: Active Animal Physiotherapy Dr Lesley Goff

Dr. Lesley Goff is one of the world’s leading Animal Physiotherapists, currently balancing her animal physiotherapy practice with presenting at vet/physio conferences and lecturing/teaching to physiotherapists and equine science students. Lesley’s career as a physiotherapist spans over 20 years in which time, following her initial physiotherapy degree, she has completed master’s level degrees in Manipulative Physiotherapy, Exercise and Sports Science and Animal Physiotherapy. More recently Lesley completed her doctorate at the University of Queensland, paving the way for further research into the equine sacroiliac joint.Dr. Lesley Goff is often consulted by, and provides training for other practitioners in the area of sacroiliac joint injury. She has been involved in teaching on the Animal Physiotherapy masters degree at University of Queensland and has lectured to both veterinarians and physiotherapists, and presented courses in Australia, Scandinavia, USA, South Africa and the UK.

Here At Hopefield our mission is to provide a safe and loving home for abused, abandoned and neglected animals. 

We aim to promote humane behaviour towards animals around the world starting right here in Essex by providing appropriate care, protection, treatment, dietary needs and security for animals which are in need of care and attention because of sickness, mistreatment, abuse, poor circumstances or ill usage and to educate the public in matters of animal welfare and the prevention of cruelty and suffering among animals.

We are open to the public which is a vital part of our fundraising to enable the sanctuary to care for our resident animals and allows us to educate and encourage visitors to think about their own animals at home and in the wild.  

Our hope is that Hopefield inspires others to become advocates themselves for better animal welfare so we can continue our work.........Saving Animals Together

For 35 years, we've been rescuing and rehoming cats across Shropshire. We're a volunteer-run shelter caring for cats and kittens who need somewhere safe to recover, receive care and, where possible, find a suitable forever home.

Here you'll find the cats behind the rescue: their stories, personalities, progress and journeys to new homes, alongside behind-the-scenes content from life at the shelter.

We'll also share practical cat advice, educational content, fundraising appeals and a look at the people and work that keep the rescue running.

Follow the cats, meet the people behind their care and discover more about the work that happens every day at Shropshire Cat Rescue.

My name is Mina and I rescue animals in Japan. I have been diagnosed with terminal cancer and I'm using the time I have left to finish building my dream sanctuary so we can keep saving animals long after I'm gone. My sanctuary, AnimO ("Animal Oasis") is located near Tokyo. It is Japan's first true land-based exotic animal sanctuary. Together with volunteers we usually care for up to 100 unwanted & special needs animals, which otherwise would have stayed in cages or even worse... 

We try to give them the best possible life at the sanctuary, so they can recover from their past and live happily in the present. 

In the future, I hope that I can build an education centre spreading awareness about animal welfare.
