Farm Animal Rescue is a not for profit refuge for animals that have been freed from abusive situations and factory farms.  Once at sanctuary they live blissfully, free roaming in their forever home, receiving the best care to live out their natural lives in safety and harmony.  As well as rescue farmed animals, our mission is to speak up for animals farmed in the agriculture and food industry, exposing institutional cruelty and enabling people to emotionally connect with animals normally consumed for food.  

The farm is open to visitors on a regular basis, so that people can come to meet our residents. Each visitor has the opportunity to rub a pigs belly, pat a sheep, tumble around with a goat, and feed a rooster. During these animal contact sessions, we will tell visitors what the animals endured before they were rescued, and what life is really like for the millions of others on factory farms that we cannot save.

HOW IT ALL BEGAN

Save the Wild Ones began, when a passion for helping the planet and a dream of saving wildlife intertwined. Here we do not just believe everything we hear, but we are open to change, and acknowledge that evolution in all aspects help make ourselves and the world a better place. We believe in looking at every side to a problem, and taking what you can from everyone including our WILD FRIENDS; even if that means you don’t agree with them 100%. Everyone and everything has something positive to offer this world, you just have to be willing to search for the answers. 

STAY WILD MY FRIENDS 🐺🦅🐋

MISSION STATEMENT
We believe that every wild one needs to be saved. A focus on education, research, and conservation, Save the Wild Ones aims to help every human or animal that needs saving. The goal is to leave the world in better condition than when we found it, and by helping ourselves, we help the ones around us.

Welcome to our channel. The Tai Wai Small Animal & Exotic Veterinary Hospital is based in Hong Kong and our veterinary doctors will show you how to care and look after your pets. The vet doctors in our hospital will show you best practice techniques as well as providing tips. Our videos cover cats, dogs, turtles, tortoises, terrapins and chinchillas for now with more videos to follow so please subscribe to our channel.

The Tai Wai Small Animal & Exotic Veterinary Hospital was established in Hong Kong in 1997 by Dr Tiger and Dr Gail. The veterinary hospital was set up to not only cater for standard pets but also for small & exotic animals. Over the years the animal hospital has grown from only Dr Tiger & one vet assistant to 7 full-time veterinarian doctors & 30+ support staff. Our animal hospital is second to none & we have specialised facilities to care for exotic animals. 

We hope you find our videos useful and we welcome any questions and feedback!

Dr Gail & Dr Tiger

Subscribe to explore course previews, student stories, tips from industry, and advice on careers.

Our educators are active members of either the veterinary profession or are involved in the animal care industry. They have extensive experience teaching in University and TAFE programs. We work closely with industry partners such as the RSPCA, Dogs' Refuge Home, Cat Haven,  Vetpartners, Greencross and many more well-respected workplaces.

REAL HORSE RESCUES is an original series created and hosted by award-winning producer Susan Kayne on ABC-WTEN Every Saturday at 6:00AM. Its mission is to raise public awareness of equine welfare concerns, and bring visibility to the compassionate work of equine sanctuaries, rescues, and adoption organizations. Guests range from boots-on-the-ground rescuers, to legislators, to celebrities, to young advocates, and of course many four-legged stars.

RHR focuses on rescue success stories to encourage viewers to participate directly with equine organizations in their communities to give horses a second chance. Real Horse Rescues is a program of the Unbridled Thoroughbred Foundation, a 501 c (3) not-for-profit educational organization guided by the belief that every equine life deserves humane treatment, compassion, respect, and protection from harm.

Our experienced team of chiropractors and sports massage therapists work to ensure the highest level of non-surgical care.

A comprehensive assessment combined with excellent diagnostic skills allows our dedicated practitioners to provide an individually tailored treatment plan, ranging from hands-on treatment and providing pain relief to exercise plans and advice to reduce recurrence.

We have provided relief for a range of patients from sedentary, city-based office workers to international performance artists, dancers and professional sportspeople.

My name is Minnie and I am a veterinarian from the UK!

I'm passionate about my profession and sharing it with the world! I will be making videos about all sorts of topics that will be accessible to everyone, whether you're a vet or not! 

I am also soon-to-be working with Sea Turtles in the Maldives and I'll be wanting to share everything I know and love about these incredible reptiles and I give you an idea of what it is like to live and work in a beautiful yet remote slice of paradise. 

I hope you enjoy and engage, and maybe even come away having learned a little something!

(p.s. I am also a massive dork so I can't promise 100% educational content all the time....)

Welcome to Vet and Tech Official YouTube Channel, an open source for veterinary education. We are dedicated to providing multiple educational resources, such as CE courses, educational programs, webinars, and news for veterinarians, veterinary technicians, students and nurses.

At Vet and Tech, we understand the importance of staying up-to-date with the latest developments in the veterinary field. We bring you the most relevant and accurate information on various topics, from animal health and nutrition to diagnostic techniques and treatment options.

In addition to our informative articles and news updates, we also offer a variety of helpful resources for veterinary professionals, including continuing education courses, job listings, and networking opportunities. We strive to be a one-stop shop for veterinarians to stay informed and connected within the industry.

Thank you for visiting our channel.
To learn more about us visit: www.vetandtech.com

row: This is a must-hear podcast for pet owners wanting access to the latest in pet quality of life and longevity. Whether your pet has fur, feathers, scales or shells, Cathy and Chris believe in treating your pet as a whole, both mind and body. Continuing a collaboration that began in 2003, Cathy and Chris share the gift of gab as well as their network in the pet rehab community. Using their vast expertise as Certified Canine Rehabilitation Practitioners (CCRPs), Cathy Symons CVT, CCRP, and Chris Cranston MPT, CCRP, offer relevant information and provocative interviews on their podcast, PetAbility. With an emphasis on mobility and independence, their show is about improving function, restoring confidence, alleviating fear, providing mental stimulation, and easing pain to help your pets live their best lives.

Veterinary Continuing Education is an organisation focused on online veterinary courses, all of which are RACE approved CE. 

The online veterinary courses described in this channel also include veterinary technician continuing education, as vet tech CE makes up a large portion of the free veterinary CE which we show. There´s often a misconception that finding free veterinary continuing education online means it´s not of the highest standards, simply because it´s offered at no cost. What we aim to show veterinary professionals through our channel, is the wealth of high quality free veterinary CE from top universities and institutions that´s available to veterinarians and vet techs.

https://hanoipetadoption.com
Established in 2015, we have rescued over 2,000 cases and re-homed hundreds of dogs and cats.

     Hanoi Pet Adoption is a group of Vietnamese volunteers with the support of some international volunteers. Our mission is to provide a no-kill shelter with adequate care and treatment for lost, stray, and abandoned animals that we rescue. 
     Also, we make efforts to increase their adoption opportunities, as well as find permanent, and loving homes for them. 
     Last but not least, we promote responsible pet ownership through education, community outreach, and collaboration while maintaining respect and compassion for animals.

🙏If You Can't Adopt - Get Temporary Care
🙏If you can't provide temporary care - Please sponsor
🙏If you can't sponsor - Volunteer
🙏If you can't volunteer - Please donate
🙏If you can't donate - Please spread the word

💛 Please Like, Share and Subscribe the channel to help us! 💛

Just a licensed massage therapist who loves her job and made a youtube channel about it!

My goal with this channel is to teach and show massage techniques that are both effective and easy to do at home for various ailments and pains. Feel free to follow these techniques in addition to any therapy you may be receiving, or in a pinch if your scheduled massage isn't for a few more days or weeks---and you need help NOW!!
(We've all had those days)

Feel free to explore my channel, but don't get discouraged if you can't find what you're looking for yet; I'm always making more videos!

All my love,
Katrina

Foothills Animal Shelter is an open admissions facility, which means we never turn away an animal. We care for more than 8  ,000 orphaned cats, kittens, dogs, puppies and critters every year with a compassionate team of staff and volunteers. We are a true community resource and offer a variety of services including pet adoption, Jefferson County pet licensing, affordable spaying and neutering, vaccinations, microchipping and lost and found pets. Foothills Animal Shelter is dedicated to providing the best care possible for every animal that enters our doors. We are committed to our important mission and the life-saving work that we do every day of the year.

We encourage candid discussions on our Facebook page, but please be respectful! Any comments that are offensive, obscene, inappropriate or contain spam will be deleted. All service-related questions or comments that require an immediate response should be directed to us at (303) 278-7575.

row: Lost Dog and Cat Rescue Foundation

LDCRF is a Virginia based rescue organization that helps homeless and abandoned animals find permanent, loving homes. We reduce pet overpopulation by spaying or neutering every pet in our care before we put him or her up for adoption. The animals at our rescue are pulled from crowded rural shelters, where their chances of being adopted are very slim. 

Please watch our videos for more information about Lost Dog and Cat Rescue, and check out our website at www.lostdogrescue.org for even more information!

Helping Dogs and Cats Fight Cancer | Expert Advice
HVOS provides personalized, integrative veterinary cancer care for dogs and cats. Learn how to manage lymphoma, mast cell tumor, osteosarcoma and other cancer, improve your pet’s quality of life, support their immune system, and explore treatment options even if you don’t live near a veterinary oncologist.

We provide expert guidance and support for pet owners and veterinarians worldwide.

What We Offer:
Educational Videos
Pain & Symptom Management
Cancer Care Plans for veterinarians and their clients worldwide
Mobile & Virtual Support
Personalized guidance

We understand this is a difficult journey. Each patient, family, and referring veterinarian matters deeply to us. Our goal is to provide knowledge, hope, and practical support for every dog fighting cancer.

Subscribe for expert advice on canine cancer care and updates from HVOS!
Website: hopevetoncology.com

Welcome to the official channel for Heartspring! 

You’ll find videos and information regarding our Pediatric Outpatient Clinic, Therapeutic School, and Community Engagement program efforts that feature our experts on pediatric neurodevelopment.  

We provide comprehensive support for children with neurodevelopmental delays and disorders — including speech, hearing or motor development issues, general developmental delays, intellectual and learning challenges, autism spectrum disorder, ADHD, and more. 

Children who receive therapies at Heartspring can build mobility and strength, develop daily living skills, language and communication , improve behaviors and social interactions, and gain greater independence. 

Our interdisciplinary therapies include audiology, applied behavior analysis (ABA), behavioral health, feeding therapy, occupational therapy, physical therapy, and speech-language therapy.

While most medical topics are explored in the BackStage Vet studio, others take viewers on adventures around the world. Whether you're a new or experienced pet parent facing a medical challenge or simply curious about general pet topics, BackStage Vet is your go-to channel for expert advice, fascinating insights, and a deeper understanding of pets.

Welcome to Da Vinci's Dream, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit animal rescue based in Kentucky dedicated to saving dogs and cats through foster care, responsible adoption, transport coordination, and community outreach.

Our animals come from high-risk shelters, neglect cases, and urgent rescue situations. Each animal is placed in foster care, where we learn about personality, routine, and ideal home placement before adoption.

Through adoption, transport, and community support, our volunteers work to give vulnerable animals a second chance and connect them with loving forever homes.

If you are interested in adopting, fostering, or supporting our mission, visit davincisdream.org to learn more about our adoption process, available animals, and transport options.

Subscribe to follow rescue stories, available animals, and the daily work behind foster-based rescue in Kentucky.

Lancaster Farm Sanctuary is a 501(c)(3) non-profit farmed animal sanctuary.

LFS is an LGBTQ-founded and led organization. It is the mission of LFS to rescue farmed animals and provide them with sanctuary and inspire humans to live with compassion and respect. The purpose of LFS is to reduce animal suffering and lead humanity to a kinder and more sustainable future by connecting the seemingly disparate, but deeply connected issues of animal exploitation, social injustice, failing human healthcare, and environmental degradation. By connecting with individuals, educating the general public, and collaborating with local organizations, LFS models the change necessary to improve the lives of community members, human and nonhuman alike. 

Our core values: Justice, Integrity, Compassion, Responsibility, and Courage

Houghton Physical Therapy offers customized, one-on-one treatment and rehabilitation of orthopedic, neurological, work-related, and motor vehicle injuries. We offer a modern 3200sq. ft. facility, private treatment rooms, state-of-the-art equipment, and a passion for healing.
Many people are unaware that they do not have to live with chronic pain, such as headaches, back, and neck pain, and foot pain. Physical therapy can successfully treat these common daily ailments along with many other types of injuries, like sprains, strains, fractures, pre/post-surgical conditions, and sports injuries. Houghton Physical Therapy works with your body to increase strength, flexibility, and tolerance of everyday activities. This channel is a visual platform designed to educate people on how to take preventative measures to avoid injury through an active lifestyle and develop healthy daily habits to have more energy and longevity in life!

Welcome to our Italian Farm!🐴🐔🐶 We are an animal rescue, sanctuary, and horse farm here in the countryside of Italy. We started out as two cousins traveling around Europe in a caravan saving all the animals we could safely fit in our van. We’ve re-homed over 200 rescue dogs and now that we have our land to call home, we are a forever home to many of our horses, dogs, cats, goats, donkeys, birds and whatever other wonderful creatures join us along the way. We also open our doors to many van-lifers as a place for them to come spend some time with the animals whether it’s just a stop over on their travels or a place they’d like to spend some time volunteering with the animals and our team. 😅🚐🐶🐱🐰🐴✨

Soul Dog is a 501 (c)(3) nonprofit animal rescue organization founded with the mission to spay/neuter and protect animals. Soul Dog is proactive in animal welfare, advancing the need for spaying and neutering our pets to reduce overpopulation. We travel to rural communities on Native American reservations, where spaying and neutering will only happen if it is nearly free or very convenient. Soul Dog works with volunteer veterinarians to provide the spaying and neutering service at no cost to the public. Donations are used to defray the costs associated with medications, supplies, and the operating cost for clinics.

Our Mission:
Soul Dog Rescue performs collaborative, targeted work, primarily through spay/neuter, in underserved regions in order to create sustainable change and promote cultural shifts regarding the treatment of companion animals.

www.souldog.org
LOCATION & HOURS
1245 Factory Circle, Fort Lupton, CO, 80621
Clinic Hours
Mon - Sat9:00 am - 5:00 pm
Sunday Closed

Welcome to my channel! My name is Christina, and I’m here to help you break free from chronic pain and rediscover a life of strength, mobility, and wellness. As a licensed massage therapist with over two decades of experience, I’ve dedicated my career to empowering people to transition from pain to thriving health through natural, holistic methods. Whether you’re dealing with ongoing discomfort or looking for ways to improve mobility,  you’re in the right place.

Learn more about:
Self-Massage Techniques: Easy tutorials to target problem areas and release tension.
Stretching and Mobility Routines: Simple routines to improve flexibility and reduce stiffness.
Chronic Pain Management Tips: Strategies that make a real difference, from tracking tools to identifying pain triggers.
Holistic Wellness Advice: Natural ways to support your health, from better sleep to stress reduction.
Expert Insights: Easy-to-understand explanations of complex topics like inflammation, nerve pain, and posture.

row: Love Steeds - LS Equine Therapy & Education

LS Equine Therapy has a big dream to educate & share great therapy techniques & ideas that improve the well being & health of horses all over the world. 

The mission is to help horses feel and move their best & to educate by empowering equestrians with knowledge & skills to improve the mental & physical well being of their equines themselves, rather than always relying on "the equine professionals". Disclaimer: this does not replace veterinary care or the skilled work of professional equine therapists.

Ilse Kemp is the founder of LS Equine Therapy. Her ex race horse Dushybeag was her muse at the beginning. She now has a broad client base ranging from shetland ponies to racehorses. 

A life-long student of the horse and advocate for horse, Ilse wholeheartedly wants to inspire other equestrians to be more mindful and help their wonderful steeds. WE MUST REMEMBER horses want to please & innocently give their best, tolerating discomfort until it cannot be tolerated anymore.

row: Whispering Hearts Horse Rescue, Hagersville Ontario

Whispering Hearts Horse Rescue Center is a federally registered non-profit organization with charitable status.

Our mandate is 
To provide care and rehabilitation 
to abused and neglected horses. 
To assist members of the community 
that can no longer care for their horses 
in an attempt to prevent innocent animals 
being subjected to cruelty and neglect.

Our Goals and Objectives are:

Create a volunteer-based, equine welfare organization to ensure quality care and treatment of horses through intervention, education and outreach. 

Create a partnership to provide a reputable facility for the care and rehabilitation of horses under investigation.

Educate the public on equine welfare issues

Establish a program to assist other rescue organizations in Ontario as more facilities are needed to take in the increasing number of abused and neglected horses across the Province.

Just Paws Animal Rescue is a not for profit animal rescue and rehoming organization, established in 2014. We are a foster based rescue based in the Greater Toronto Area of Ontario, Canada. 


Mission
Our mission is to rescue and rehome unwanted, abandoned, abused and unloved pets that find themselves alone and frightened in shelters. These animals give unconditional love and should receive the same love back. Unfortunately there is a need and while ever there is a need we will be there to help. Our long term goal is to build towards the opening of our own shelter and be able to help with behavioral issues, special needs, and to offer a haven to less adoptable pets.

Maria Ines Gay da Fonseca Allgayer is a Brazilian DVM and Equine Therapist with larger experience as an equine practitioner for more the 20 years. She has worked as a veterinarian in equine clinic and surgery in several equine practices and Stud Books in Brazil from 2000 to 2004. In 2005, Dr. Allgayer opened her own practice “Equivet” and in 2007 she opened her first Equine Rehabilitation Center. 
In 2011, she moved to the U.S. and opened her first Equine Rehabilitation Center, Therapy4Horses, Oklahoma. 
In 2016, Dr. Allgayer was invited to be member of the Veterinary Equine Therapist Team for the Olympic International Committee of the 2016 Olympic Games in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
 In 2018, she was a member of the Uruguayan and Argentinian Veterinary Team for the World Equestrian Games held in Mill Spring, North Carolina, U.S. 
Since 2014, she has been offering courses in Equine Rehabilitation in her own facilities.

Fear Free Pet Cat Care For You, Your Family, Your Vet and Your Feline Friend
Your pet cat's health problems can become your problems very quickly.   Feline Friendly is a considered approach that takes your cat's medical and emotional wellbeing into account from kitten to elderly cat status!  

Follow Dr. Kim Kendall, BVSc at www.felinefriendlycare.com as she outlines the long term changes you as an owner, or veterinarian can make to a cat's health just by the basic measures you take as an owner.  

And there is plenty for the veterinary professionals too, who often aren't aware of the basic fundamental and 'minimal intrusion' techniques they can apply to enhance the cat's wellbeing at the clinic and at home.

A happy cat is a happy veterinary practice too :)

This channel isn't just for owners looking for the best way to care for their 'Fluffy' .  It also provides important videos on topics such as cat acupuncture, feline diabetes, and cat dental health.

This channel was designed as an educational tool for Massage Therapy Students by Rev. William Fulp, a Licensed Massage and Bodywork Therapist. So, please hit "Like" and "Subscribe." Feel free to leave comments or ask questions!
This channel is not monetized!

Dr Neil J. Davies D.C, is a reputed chiropractic author and educator. As the author of Clinical Paediatrics A Clinical Handbook, Churchill Livingstone (2000 & 2010), he became well known for post-graduate chiropractic education in teaching the prudent examination and care of children. From 2000, he traveled widely and presented seminars in many countries helping chiropractors better understand excellence in clinical care for children of all ages.

Dr Davies developed a system or technique of subluxation assessment and treatment initially taught as Adjusting the Child and later evolving to the NeuroImpulse Protocol, also known as NIP. This is still taught widely in many countries and has a popular folowing.

Dr Davies developed a range of clinical educational teaching products and his latest online learning resource is called NIP Academy which is free for chiropractors to join at the Bronze level and allows upgrades inside for more materials. It includes seminars in streaming video.

A 2018 OTTB, Champtown Hope aka "Ranger",  Dark Bay Gelding with Chrome, 16.2 Hands who has been diagnosed with Moderate Kissing Spine, 4 spots across his whole back, and is still undergoing extensive life long non-surgical rehab. 

All rehab is being done under a rotating schedule of veterinary work: acupuncture & chiropractor, certified/licensed equine body workers, and trainer guidance for long & low and core exercises. With the help of some targeted supplements and a growth based feeding program. 

The ultimate goal is to keep Ranger pain-free, comfortable, healthy, and happy. 

Welcome to Ranger's Journey! 

Mixed in are cats, kittens, dog, and nail content.

Spice is the variety of life!

Holistic Equine Saddlery & Tack (HEST) was originally established in 2004 as Holistic Equine Sport Therapy, by me: Dianne Pascoe. I qualified in 2004 as an Equine Sports Massage Therapist from the Australian College of Animal Tactile Therapy (ACATT).

After a few years of treating sore backed horses, I concluded that 99% of the horses I was treating had saddle fit problems and were being made sore by their saddles. I decided to find a solution to this problem rather than constantly treating the symptoms caused by ill-fitting saddles.

The Solution - offer saddles that are either adjustable or flexible or both, and educate riders on how to fit these saddles to their horses themselves!

Mr T and I test all new brands for you before we agree to represent them. We have 3 websites: https://www.hest.com.au/ https://ghostsaddles.com.au and https://www.dpsaddlery.com.au 

Any questions please feel free to drop me a line dianne@hest.com.au Thanks for reading xx

Washington German Shepherd Rescue (WGSR) finds loving homes for surrendered, abandoned and neglected German Shepherd dogs in Washington state and the greater Pacific Northwest region.

We hope to ease the problem of population overflow occurring in many of our shelters today. WGSR educates the individual on the importance of sterilizing the pet and providing superior care.

WGSR is composed of a network of foster families and volunteers.  We are always in need of more foster care providers with the time and commitment necessary to care for these animals in transition. We are also in need of volunteers who can shuttle dogs from shelters and other sites to our foster homes.

If you would like to adopt a German Shepherd dog or volunteer for our rescue, please visit our website today: http://www.washingtongsd.org/

The Open College of Equine Studies (TOCES) specialises in equine management, equine science and equine veterinary nursing distance and blended learning courses. TOCES learners are based all over the world and their ages range from 16 to 69!

Based in England, TOCES is an independent international distance learning college specialising in equine study programmes. Learners all over the world are able to study and learn via printed and online course materials. Some programmes include study weeks during which course notes are supplemented with lectures from subject experts. Practical skills are taught and assessed.

General Equine Programmes: www.equinestudies.co.uk

Fur Warriors is a charity organization that helps to rescue, rehabilitate, and find forever homes for survivors of the dog meat trade, high kill shelters, and animal abuse cases world wide.   

We work hard to rescue local stray cats, rehabilitate, and specialize in socializing feral cats to be loving house pets to keep them safe off the streets forever.   

All our animals are rescued, sterilized, vaccinated and rehabilitated to be loving family pets.  We also do feeding, sterilization & vaccination programs to stray animals outside of our rescue.  

Our rescue is as strong as our community support behind us. We rely on donations and community fundraisers to help hundreds of animals in need. 

Our rescue is 100% volunteered based with dedicated individuals who have an extreme love and passion for animals. We are not paid,  but passionate about being a voice for the voiceless. 

. 

To contribute towards our mission, donations can be made via 
WWW.FURWARRIORS.COM/DONATE

Welcome to Revive Injury and Wellness in West Linn, OR. and Clackamas County Oregon in SE Portland.  We specialize in chiropractic care, massage therapy and back pain and neck pain relief,   Our chiropractors treat auto accident and work related injuries. If you are struggling with neck or back pain, headaches or migraines, sciatica, or any other muscle or joint pain, please call us today or visit our website and take advantage of our new patient special. 
We utilize gentle chiropractic techniques, massage therapy, rehabilitative exercises, supplementation and cold laser therapy to help you recover from back and neck injury and lead a healthier, pain free life without the need for drugs and surgery.
Our chiropractic and massage therapy office is located in West Linn Oregon in SE Portland in Clackamas County. We serve clients from Oregon City, Gladstone, Tualatin, Milwaukie, Wilsonville, Beavercreek, Canby, Molalla, Mulino, Clackamas, Willamette, Lake Oswego and Happy Valley Oregon.

If you’re a woman who’s juggling it all and still trying to find your rhythm, you belong here.

New videos every week—Subscribe and let’s grow together!

The Animal Medical Center of Mid-America (AMCMA) is devoted to the health and well-being of our animal clients, as well as providing the best possible experience for our patients through stress reduction, pain relief, and individualized treatment plans. Over 30 veterinarians and veterinary professionals provide a wealth of knowledge and personal service.

We are accredited by the American Animal Hospital Association (AAHA), the measure of excellence in veterinary care. Out of 35,000 veterinary hospitals in North America, just 3500 are AAHA-Accredited. AMCMA operates two of the only 16 non-profit AAHA-Accredited facilities. This distinction shows our commitment and desire to provide care above licensing standards and to meet the standards set forth by industry leaders, all while benefiting animals in need at the Humane Society of Missouri.

row: It Takes A Village Dog Rescue

It Takes a Village is a Canadian Registered Charity, non-profit organization that focuses on finding homes for Canada's dogs in need. Our organization is foster based and is made up entirely of dedicated volunteers and experienced rescuers who have united to improve the lives of dogs who find themselves without a home. We believe in giving dogs in need a fresh start at a new life.

Our mission is to rescue, rehabilitate, and rehome dogs in need. The happiness and success of the dogs in our rescue community is our priority and the reason we do what we do.

If you share our passion then get involved! We are always looking for committed volunteers to join our team. We welcome new fosters, events volunteers, transportation volunteers, administrative volunteers, and short term dog sitters. We operate out of EASTERN ONTARIO, CANADA and are always eager to welcome new volunteers from the area.

HALO is a No-kill, 501c3 non-profit organization dedicated to Helping Animals Live On through increased adoption, sterilization and pet care education.

HALO was founded in 1994 by two women, Michel and Heather, out of their home in Phoenix, Arizona. Michel and Heather started HALO because they love animals and couldn't just stand by and watch millions of cats and dogs being killed needlessly.

HALO provides temporary shelter to abandoned cats and dogs until they can be adopted into a permanent home.

Each year, HALO places over 3,000 abandoned animals in loving, forever homes.

About DCH

DCH Animal Adoptions, which stands for "dogs, cats and horses", is a NSW-based non-profit animal rescue charity (CFN 18284) committed to the rescue and rehoming of unwanted and neglected domestic animals - mainly dogs, cats and horses - but occasionally other animals such as rabbits and guinea pigs.
Our volunteers rescue animals from certain death in Sydney's pounds and shelters, and horses from the knackery and ensure they are provided with veterinary attention and foster care until a permanent and loving home can be found.
The foster care system benefits you and the foster pet. By providing you with valuable information about the animal gained through the carer's experiences in a home environment, we can help match you up with the right pet for your home. The animals also benefit from being in a loving home environment until their permanent homes are found.

Joy Backstrum and Katie Piraino began the practice with the vision to provide the highest quality physical therapy in a caring, patient-focused environment. VIP Petcare works with a variety of community partners, primarily pet and feed retail stores, to bring veterinary preventive care clinics to communities across the country. Over the past nineteen years, VIP Petcare has grown from humble beginnings to become the premier provider of wellness and preventive veterinary care across the country.

VIP Petcare offers comprehensive vaccines for dogs and cats, vaccine packages, pet microchipping, standard blood and fecal testing, prescription flea and tick control, de-worming, and heartworm prevention at every walk-in Community Clinic.

Many products are also available online or by phone for our existing clients. There is a state-licensed veterinarian supervising every Community Veterinary Clinic, and there is a board of full-time veterinarians that oversee all policies, protocols, and pricing for VIP Petcare services and products.

The goal of VIP Petcare is to improve the lives of pets and the people who love them.

PACC911 is a nonprofit 501(c)3  animal welfare coalition of over 140 animal rescue groups in the greater Phoenix area. 

We fulfill four vital community functions. Large-scale pet adoption events (Adoptathons); Education about Animal Welfare (particularly the need to spay and neuter); A Pet Food Pantry, Chuck Waggin'  supporting families in need to feed pets during financial difficulties; And most of all, we fundraise to provide much-needed Medical Assistance funds for our coalition partners. 

Veterinary expenses can be daunting and the biggest challenge to rescuers. Our coalition groups depend on our raised funds to help them save neglected, abused and abandoned animals and ultimately place them in loving homes.  We have fundraised over 8 million dollars since we've started, and in 2023 alone PACC911 partners have saved 36,000 animals in Arizona. 

Please visit PACC911.org to learn more about us.

At Trillium Spinal Care in Altoona, Wisconsin and Plainview, Minnesota we use extremely precise advanced Upper Cervical Chiropractic techniques to improve the health and life of our patients. 

The Upper Cervical Chiropractic care technique we use is called NUCCA and it is a very gentle technique that does not utilize twisting, popping or cracking. Our safe approach has proved extremely effective for those suffering from a variety of chronic conditions including migraines, vertigo, sciatica, fibromyalgia, back pain, neck pain, TMJ dysfunction and more. 

To schedule a consultation with Dr. Kalan Stittleburg please call 715-895-8048 for our Altoona office or 507-322-0133 for our Plainview Office. To learn more about our practice visit our website at www.trilliumspinalcare.com

We would love to see if our unique form of care can help you find the relief you have been looking for.

If would like to learn even more about Upper Cervical Care please visit https://uppercervicalawareness.com/

Hey, we are David (scientist) and Anastasia (physical therapist). We run our own physical therapy clinic in Durham, NC. This channel is for the business and our hobbies that directly relate to physical therapy - Latin dancing, power lifting, and sometimes other sports such as ice skating. We also enjoy food and traveling to different places for dance events, so you’ll see videos of the great food and classes we’ve explored. 

MVMT Physical Therapy is our private practice specializing in restoring function through a blend of patient-tailored movements and supplemental education using the McKenzie Method. Our core belief follows the thought behind the name of the business – movement is the best healer.

MVMT exists because our passion to not only help people to heal their present injuries, but to teach them how to prevent further injuries and safely reach their goals.

Action Chiropractic and Sports Injury Center provides sports chiropractic care in Naperville, IL, helping athletes and active adults get out of pain, move better, and Get Back to Action.

• Chiropractic care
• Active Release Techniques (ART)
• Shockwave Therapy (ESWT)
• Dry needling
• Instrument-Assisted Soft Tissue Mobilization (IASTM)
• Cupping therapy
• Cold laser therapy
• Corrective exercise & rehabilitation

Pasha Adoption and Rehabilitation Center is a non-profit animal rescue established in February 2022. Our Center was founded by members of Vucjak Shelter’s Adoption Team as a pilot project to facilitate the rehabilitation and adoption of special-need animals and provide palliative care for the critically ill ones that would otherwise struggle in a shelter environment.

We offer a spay/neuter program, comprehensive vet care, and adoption services in Serbia and abroad. Thanks to our staff’s skilled handling and training, all our adoptable animals are well socialized and friendly with other dogs, cats, and humans!

As a foster-based rescue, we focus on placing our animals in secure, caring foster homes once they are rehabilitated and ready for adoption. We are dedicated to building a coalition of rescue-minded individuals and organizations across Europe, the U.K., Canada, and the United States so that together, we can save more at-risk stray animals in Serbia.

https://www.PashaARC.co.uk

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue (Dedication and Everlasting Love to Animals) is the largest "No Kill, Care-for-Life," Sanctuary of its kind in the world.

The D.E.L.T.A. Rescue Super Sanctuary is home to more than 1500 animals that have all been abandoned in the wilderness. The animals at the sanctuary will never have to worry about being lost and alone again.

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue receives no help from the government and relies solely on donor contributions and is tax -exempt 501 [c] 3 organization dedicated to rescuing animals abandoned in the wilderness and stopping the cruel practice of animal abandonment.

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue was awarded BEST IN AMERICA status by Independent Charities of America! In a letter congratulating D.E.L.T.A. Rescue, ICA said to be proud -- only about 3% of the charities they deal with earn this recognition. They study charities, analyze their expenses and their mission, and make a determination.

D.E.L.T.A. Rescue also received a 4 STAR Rating on Charity Navigator.

Welcome to the official Ekico YouTube channel.

Ekico develops innovative technologies to help veterinary professionals objectively assess animal locomotion and monitor treatment outcomes.

On this channel, you’ll discover:

* 🐶 Tendiboots™ Canine Gait Analysis demonstrations and tutorials
* 📊 Objective gait analysis in everyday veterinary practice
* 🩺 Clinical cases in orthopedics, neurology, rehabilitation, and sports medicine
* 🎓 Educational videos, webinars, and expert insights
* 🚀 Product updates and new features

Our mission is to make objective gait analysis simple and practical for every veterinary clinic.

Whether you are a veterinarian, rehabilitation therapist, physiotherapist, researcher, or veterinary student, our videos will help you better understand canine locomotion and improve patient follow-up through objective measurements.

Learn more about Tendiboots™:
🌐 https://ekico.fr

We are a nonprofit (501c3) rescue and sanctuary for small farm animals. Located in Southern California.

We help animals and people, as well. The unwanted and the broken need someone to love them. Repurposing gives purpose to something that was seemingly “useless.” I wanted to feel that I still had purpose, so I give that feeling to others whenever I can. 

Become one of Freyja’s Friends at freyjasfriends.org and inquire how donate time, money, supplies, or advice. Find us on Facebook and Instagram. https://www.facebook.com/jennifer.rescuer?mibextid=wwXIfr is monetized, so like, comment, and share to help for free!

It’s okay to not be okay sometimes. You and other animals don’t have to be thrown away, you still have purpose.

Friends of Lackota Animal Sanctuary | Northern Colorado

Named after a rescued horse saved nearly 30 years ago, Friends of Lackota Animal Sanctuary was founded to give animals a second chance at life. The sanctuary began when a young boy refused to let Lackota go to slaughter—working hard to save him and, in the process, finding a lifelong purpose.

Located in Northern Colorado, we specialize in rescuing horses and donkeys from the slaughter pipeline, but no animal is turned away if we can provide proper care. Many arrive from kill pens or auctions, often neglected, afraid, and broken. Here, they receive love, rehabilitation, and safety—whether they find a forever home or remain at the sanctuary.

Our mission is simple: help animals beat the odds and live the life they deserve.

The Texas Chiropractic Association (TCA) is the essential voice for chiropractic in Texas. It provides protection and state-wide advocacy for chiropractors. Your ability to legally practice is at the forefront of the association’s goals and is one of the huge benefits provided to TCA members. The Texas Chiropractic Association works hard to advocate the position that the citizens of Texas should have adequate access to the health care of their choice and to insure that Doctors of Chiropractic have suitable representation in the decision-making agencies of the government.

TCA is more than 1,600 members across the Lone Star State from Abbot to Zephyr. While practicing chiropractors make up most of the membership base, other stakeholders such as Affiliate Members, Associate Educators and even chiropractic spouses & family members are represented too! We invite you to have a voice in the chiropractic profession of Texas. There is a place for all.

Since 2008, we have been dedicated to helping neglected, abandoned, and mistreated dogs and cats in need of loving homes. We started as a small group of animal lovers working out of a garage until Nathan “Nate” Benderson, a local developer with an affinity for animals, caught wind of the group and joined. Nate provided the necessary vision and leadership to establish what is now known as Nate’s Honor Animal Rescue.

Today, together with a staff of caring volunteers and an incredibly supportive community, we save thousands of homeless and at-risk animals each year at our eight-acre, no-kill shelter and adoption facility on Lorraine Road.

As a 501(c)(3) non-profit animal rescue organization, we are proud to provide a place where homeless cats and dogs can receive the love and care they deserve while they wait to be welcomed into their forever homes.

Retirees often don't know what to do with their new-found time. Life can become mundane unless the retiree takes action to avoid it.
Men can have more problems than women in retirement, in part because their identity is more closely tied to their careers. While employed, they develop a strong routine that brings self-esteem and a sense of purpose.
These can be maintained after retirement if the retiree is open to new ideas. There are lots of activities beyond lawn bowls and cards to occupy and challenge a person. Whether they be volunteering, exploring new or old environments, or learning new skills, challenges for everyone are out there and easy to access.
This video project shows how people can become involved in various activities across Australia.

Life: get amongst it would like to thank  Peggy Cameron  for her generous support

AAR’s mission is to work towards ending pet overpopulation that results in the euthanasia of unwanted cats and dogs. We do this by providing a rescue and adoption center, by emphasizing the importance of spaying and neutering and by educating on humane animal ownership. AAR is committed to the emotional, physical, and behavioral well being of each animal in our care. In addition to providing a shelter for abandoned animals, AAR has foster families for special needs animals, litters, and rehabilitation.

AAR is a Cat & Dog Center that includes a limited intake adoption facility, community education outreach, and an affordable wellness and spay/neuter clinic through our partners at Texas Litter Control. Founded in 2002 by dedicated animal lovers Angie Fenton, Barbara Schulz, and James Gordon, AAR is entirely managed and maintained by volunteers.

Follow us here and on our other media for more information about our cause, updates and information on our adoptable animals.
info@aartexas.org; cats@aartexas.org; dogs@aartexas.org; events@aartexas.org; lostandfoundpets@aartexas.org; volunteer@aartexas.org

BALANCED RIDERS. BALANCED HORSES.

#BDiamondPhysio #EquestrianPhysiotherapy #HorseAndRiderBalance #RiderBiomechanics #RideRight

This is the official youtube channel of Veterinary Students For Animal Welfare(VET-SAW).

Veterinary Students for Animal Welfare (Vet-SAW) is a student-led non-profit organization that works
to inform, educate, and aware the community about the basic welfare needs of animals by building and improving the bridge between veterinary professionals and the public.
It aims to uplift animal welfare by organizing, educating, and involving emerging veterinarians in the veterinary profession.
Established in 2018, Vet-SAW has been continuously working to build a community of a youth-led and motivated group of veterinary students who constantly advocate and promote the importance of animal welfare to ensure healthier and longer life of animals. Vet-SAW strongly believes in building a society where both human and the animal can co-exist and thrive in
their best way.

row: Swedish Massage Techniques for Students Only

Hello, my name is Ximena Baca, LMT, MAED, MSAHPI. I am a professor of Massage Therapy as well as Anatomy & Physiology courses at Miami Dade, Florida. I have been a licensed Massage Therapist in the State of Florida since 2003. I hold a Master's degree in Adult Education and Training, along with a Master's degree in Instructional Anatomy & Physiology. I am also on my second year of my Doctoral Degree in Adult education and Leadership with a minor in Technology. I project to graduate December 2025. 

The purpose of this channel is to inspire students to develop a foundational understanding of Swedish Massage techniques. The term "SAALBIS" reflects my passion for education and draws from my personal academic journey to motivate students toward success in their professional studies.
(SAALBIS stands for: Start, Achieve, Attain, Live, Believe, Inspire, and Succeed).
Let's do this!!

Reach out to us: +971 58 593 1952

I created this channel to be the veterinarian your pet will thank you for™, sharing honest, practical insights on dog food, pet nutrition, gut health, longevity, and integrative veterinary care.

If you're tired of one-size-fits-all recommendations, overwhelmed by conflicting advice, or wondering if there's more to your pet's health than another prescription, you're in the right place!

Here you'll find:
• Pet nutrition and dog food guidance
• Integrative veterinary insights
• Wellness strategies for longevity
• Conversations about allergies, inflammation, and the microbiome
• A fresh perspective on pet health

My mission is simple: to help pet parents think differently, ask better questions, and become confident advocates for their pets.

Let's rethink pet care, together.

• Tips on back, neck, hip and shoulder pain

Subscribe today and discover how good your body can feel!

row:
Hi, I’m Veera — and welcome to a good Pack.

I’ve been working professionally with dogs since 2006, first as a dog trainer, then from 2008 as a behavior consultant and a veterinary technician. In 2015, I graduated as an animal trainer and a dog massage therapist.

I created this space to help you build a connected relationship with your dog — one rooted in praise, 
understanding, communication, humor and emotional awareness.

Here, we don’t just talk about leash handling or training techniques. We will also talk about us - and how our part plays it's own role in the relationship that we have with our dogs.

This is a safe place where you’re supported, seen, and never judged. Welcome to a Good pack.

With love,
Veera

Extra info:
- born in Finland, living now in Italy
- mom of two amazing kids 
- always thinking maybe one more dog?
- still technically absolutely horrible
- new material every 14 days
- This content is for educational purposes only. Every dog and situation is different.

row: Hi! Welcome all pet lovers, parents, guardians, and caretakers!  Please join me, Dr. Erica Dickie, Certified Hospice and Palliative Care Veterinarian, as I speak on all topics related to caring for your pets nearing the end of their lives.  After experiencing the devastating loss of my heart pet, Smokey in January 2019, and the feelings of grief and loss that followed, I shifted my career focus from general practice to Animal Hospice & Palliative Care. I starting my own mobile end of life veterinary care practice, Black Creek Mobile Veterinary Services, in Stratford, Ontario, Canada.  We are exclusively devoted to end of life care for pets, including quality of life assessments and consultations; peaceful in-home pet euthanasia and aftercare & memorialization.  Our mission is to honour the bond, the life, and the love shared with your beloved companion animals.

Friends of Rescue Animals (FRAs) is an all-volunteer 501(c)(3) non-profit organization founded in 2004. Our organization has grown to over 300 volunteers, and with this growth, we now support two municipal shelters -- Rowlett, TX and Garland, TX – and operate our own cat rescue program.  FRAs has helped countless pets avoid euthanasia, find their forever homes and live longer, healthier lives.

Our mission is to provide resources, programs and education to promote adoption and care of homeless pets in our community. FRAs’ vision is a world where every companion animal has a safe and loving forever home.

The A Home for Every Horse program helps connect rescue horses in need of homes, in over 600 rescues across the United States, with people looking for horses. To make the connection between rescue horses and homes, rescue organizations can list their horses for free on Equine.com, the world’s largest horse marketplace, where they can be seen by 300,000 visitors each month.

Central Virginia Horse Rescue, Inc (CVHR) is a  501(c)3 non-profit organization dedicated to the compassionate care of equines.  Our mission is to save, protect, and rehabilitate equines in need.  We rescue unwanted, abused, neglected, or abandoned equines; provide them with care and rehabilitation; and finally find them a compatible, loving home.  We believe that education is the long-term solution to improving the lives of equines.

Our goal is to aid abused, neglected, starving, and unwanted horses from surrenders, animal control, or auctions. We provide food, training, and veterinary care for their recovery. Post-recovery, they're evaluated and put up for adoption to approved homes. Economic challenges have led to increased horse sales but fewer buyers, resulting in more horses in danger. Many are abandoned or auctioned. We offer these horses a temporary haven until a permanent, loving home is found.

CAWS is a no-kill, volunteer and foster-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization whose mission is working with the community to help animals. As Utah’s oldest animal rescue group, our ongoing rescue, foster, education and adoption programs help animals whose time is up at shelters, those who are abandoned, and as our resources allow, those whom their owners can no longer keep.

We are committed to saving the animals that are often overlooked and under-appreciated at local shelters; this includes, the sick, injured, senior and neonatal kittens and their mothers. We are dedicated to helping those special needs animals find their forever homes.

Our rescue and adoption process is sustainable, innovative and effective. In 2015, we rescued and adopted out over one thousand dogs and cats from shelters throughout the state of Utah.

This channel is for an animal rescue network. The animals seen in our videos are looking for forever homes. Check us out at www.reddogfarm.com.

row: Founded in 2004 by Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Emmylou Harris, Bonaparte’s Retreat is named in memory of one of Emmylou’s own beloved dogs. For 10 year, Bonaparte traveled "on the road" with her as she performed around the world. When he died suddenly in 2002, Emmylou was heartbroken. But her personal loss became the genesis of something remarkable. Emmylou established Bonaparte’s Retreat, a 501(c)3 nonprofit dog rescue organization in Nashville and dedicated to providing nurturing care for adoptable dogs when their allotted time at a shelter has elapsed. Our mission is to prevent these wonderful animals from being euthanized and to adopt them into permanent, loving homes.

Crystal is an Accredited Massage Therapist having received her massage therapy license from South Bay Massage College in Manhattan Beach, CA, in 2012. After studying massage for 2 years, she graduated with over 1,000 hours of hands-on training and massage experience specializing in Sports Injury, Pre and Post Sports Training, and more.

Crystal has chosen Massage Therapy as her profession because she finds working one-on-one with each client very fulfilling and rewarding. In fact, she says that if you love what you do, you'll never work a day in your life! With a tremendous kindhearted nature she is passionate about helping her clients heal and always be able to perform at their peak level.

Crystal is herself an athlete, competing in martial arts and swimming on an Olympic national level. She has participated in many of Southern California's local 5-10 K races and is training for an upcoming women's fitness competition.

row: Doc Clemens FeLife® - Reduces FeLV Virus in Cats

FeLife® is proven to reduce the FeLV viral load in cats, helping support better health, stronger appetite, improved energy, and better days for FeLV+ cats.

On this channel, Dr. Paul Clemens, DVM, founder of Doc Clemens Remedies, shares compassionate, plain-English education about FeLV, FIV, FIP, feline immunity, testing, early support, and quality of life for cats facing serious viral illness.

FeLife is our natural, homeopathic feline immunity support remedy developed specifically for FeLV+ cats. In an independent 2024 rescue study using IDEXX ELISA + FeLV RealPCR testing, cats taking FeLife showed an average 61% FeLV viral load reduction within 30 days and an 87% average reduction within 60 days, with some cats testing negative or undetectable.

Dr. Clemens created FeLife to give caregivers a results-driven, gentle daily option for cats who deserve more hope, more comfort, and better days.

Hi, I’m Monica Mozingo — a Licensed Massage Therapist, yoga guide, and wellness creator sharing a slower approach to everyday life 🌿

This channel is where wellness meets real life — from yoga and movement to massage therapy, motherhood, natural living, nature, and the little rituals that help us feel more at home in our bodies.

As I step into motherhood, this space will naturally grow with me. You’ll find:

• Yoga & mindful movement
• Motherhood + family-centered wellness
• Massage therapy & self-care
• Natural hair & simple beauty routines
• Nature, outdoor wellness & slow living
• Day-in-the-life as a massage therapist & yoga guide

Wellness doesn't have to be perfect — it can simply be a way of coming back to yourself, one season at a time.

Come stretch, breathe, move, mother, rest, and grow with me. 🌿🤎


➡️ @wellnesswithmonicasheri (Instagram)
📍 Based in North Carolina

Horses With Hope is a privately funded equine rescue located in Hope, Maine dedicated to rehabilitating and retraining neglected, starved, abused and at-risk equines, and change the stigma surrounding the rescue horse.
HWH Rescue is dedicated to the compassionate care of equines of all shapes, sizes and backgrounds. Our mission is to rescue and rehabilitate abused, neglected, and abandoned equines and match them with compatible and loving homes based on the individual horse's needs. We believe in using true horsemanship to develop a relationship with each horse, and to help each horse reach its full potential. 
Please feel free to contact us if you would like to hear about other horses we may have available for adoption, or if you are interested in learning more about us.

Our Mission is to investigate, help prosecute and prevent cruelty to animals while also promote adoption awareness and humane education plus responsible pet ownership. We promote this all while we care for the animals surrendered to our shelter to the best of our ability every day until we find them new loving homes. 

Griffin Pond Animal Shelter was established as the Humane Society of Lackawanna County in 1938 to provide shelter for homeless, unwanted and abused animals. The shelter cares for over 200 animals on a daily basis, which is a considerable cost when you consider how much staff, food, medicine and supplies the shelter requires to operate. We also provide for animals that are sick, elderly and injured that are in our custody due to various reasons such as owner surrender and cruelty case investigations.

row: Welcome to my channel. It has educational videos but also information about our indie project and game modes for DGGFV which will launch in July 2026. DGGFV is a single and multiplayer, veterinary-themed 3D board game that turns studying clinical medicine into an engaging adventure. Featuring a charming voxel-art style packed with adorable dogs and customizable vet characters, the game challenges players' medical knowledge using dynamic, generated clinical cases and questions. Players navigate the board to tackle medical scenarios, track their progress, and unlock new skins, seamlessly blending competitive gaming with real-world veterinary science. Game will continue to update and hopefully have more game modes (aside from the board game), in addition to raffles and other exciting things!

Friends of the Manchester Animal Shelter (FMAS) is a non-profit, NO KILL shelter and pet resource center. We believe that all animals are deserving of life, respect and care. We provide medical care, spay/neuter, vaccinations, and daily care to over 1,500 abused, abandoned and homeless Manchester animals each year, and also aid thousands of pets and their families each year through our free and low-cost spay/neuter programs, community resources, and pet food pantry. 

Over the past 20 years FMAS has provided care and found loving homes for over 20,000 animals. 

Visit us at 490 Dunbarton Rd in Manchester, NH or on the web at www.manchesteranimalshelter.org.

row: Paralyzed Pup Go- How I cared for my dog Jasper

Paralyzed Pup Go- Remembering Jasper.

This channel shares Jasper’s journey. After becoming paralyzed when he was eight, for nine years he used his wheelchair and our specially designed Changing Station and Tub-Sling to live his best life. Jasper inspired us every day with his determination and joyful spirit.

The Changing Station is a supportive, multi-use devise used daily to change diapers, express the bladder and keep Jasper upright and comfortable—not to mention less stressful on my back!

It serves as a standing support for physical therapy, healthcare and grooming, It can be converted into a Tub-Sling support for bathing.

We hope Jasper’s story inspires others caring for paralyzed pets.

*PATENT PENDING

Disclaimer:
Always consult with a qualified professional to determine what is best for your pet. Professional guidance is recommended to ensure their safety and well-being.

Facebook Page: Paralyzed Pup Go
Instagram: @ParalyzedPupGo

At My Best Friend Veterinary Center, we believe better pet care starts with understanding. That’s why we created Corndog University—to make veterinary medicine easier to understand and help you feel confident caring for your best friend.

We’ll cover common illnesses, preventive care, medications, treatments, and practical ways to care for your pet at home. Our goal is to help you understand what’s happening, what you can do, what to watch for, and when it’s time to call your veterinarian.

Most importantly, we believe great veterinary care is built on trust. The closeness that makes your dog or cat part of your family should carry through to their veterinary care. We want your best friend to feel comfortable with us—and maybe even look forward to coming to see us.

Welcome to Corndog University. 🎓🐾

This channel is created primarily for Alyse's clients as a reference for programming but is hopefully a great resource to others that may find it helpful!

She has trained a wide variety of people, including general population, high school/collage athletes, models, race car drivers, equestrians, endurance athletes, cross fitters, veterans and also does work with the horse and rider pair, helping them move better as a team.
Thanks for watching!
Subscribe to my channel for more videos!

Together, SOUND and ASOC are your local experts in rehabilitation, sports medicine, regenerative medicine, pain management, and surgery. From the initial diagnosis to long term management of mobility in geriatric patients, SOUND and ASOC offer individualized, comprehensive treatment plans.

Join the team changing the future of vet med!

We are committed to helping you overcome your pain so you can stop feeling limited–both physically and mentally.

You deserve relief. We’re here to help you get back to your life of mobility, productivity, and creativity.

On this channel, you’ll find walkthroughs of our clinic, introductions to our doctors and staff, patient education, and explanations of how we approach care. Chiropractors are primary care professionals and play a vital, life-changing role. Chiropractic relieves pain, increases mobility and optimizes performance through safe and effective spinal adjustments and manipulation. Doctors of Chiropractic work one-on-one with patients, helping them improve their overall health and find relief from headaches, back, neck and joint pain, without reliance on drugs or surgery.

Chiropractors often care for entire families and develop close relationships over time, which makes chiropractic a deeply fulfilling profession. Whether in business for themselves or working in a group practice or hospital setting, chiropractors enjoy high esteem in the communities they serve, as well as satisfying and financially secure lifestyles. To be a chiropractor is to make a true difference every day, helping patients improve their health and quality of life naturally.

row:
The International Chiropractors Association (ICA) has stood the test of time. We are the world’s oldest international chiropractic professional organization. We represent chiropractors, students, chiropractic assistants, educators, and laypersons world-wide.

The ICA is dedicated to the growth and development of the chiropractic profession based on Dr. Palmer’s fundamental belief in the principle and philosophy of chiropractic as a unique, separate, distinct, and drug-less health care profession. We believe in ‘staying in the lane of chiropractic’.

ICA’s distinguishing feature today is the same as it was in 1926 – advocating for chiropractic. For over 94 years, the ICA has advocated and, when necessary, litigated to support the chiropractic profession and quality patient care. With the support of ICA’s dedicated members and leaders globally, chiropractic is a formally recognized and respected health care choice.

row:
At Charming Pet Rescue, we focus on rescuing family-friendly dogs and cats—pets that are good with people and other animals. Many of our dogs play together in outdoor yards, where visitors can meet them in a relaxed, social environment.
 
Founded in 2015, we’ve grown into a lifesaving team of staff, fosters, and volunteers who help rehome over 1,200 animals every year. About a third of our pets stay at the rescue, while the rest are in loving foster homes. Our facility is equipped with heating, A/C, and high-powered fans to keep animals comfortable during their stay.
 
Thanks to our dedicated team and community support, we’re giving more pets a second chance—and helping families find their perfect match.

We’re located in Boerne, TX and adopt out locally in Bexar county and the surrounding area. Check us out: charmingpetrescue.org

Welcome to my channel!

My name is Dr. Ali Raza, and I am a veterinary doctor (DVM). I belong to a village, Bilot Sharif, in District Dera Ismail Khan KPK.

On this channel, I will share simple and useful information about animal health, treatment, and care. My goal is to help farmers and animal lovers understand their animals better and keep them healthy.

I will upload videos about common animal diseases, basic treatments, vaccination, feeding tips, and daily care of livestock like cows, buffaloes, goats, and other animals.

This channel is especially for people in rural areas, where proper veterinary guidance is not always easily available.

Stay connected and learn how to take better care of your animals.

Thank you for your support!

Hi I am Mel, an animal physiotherapist for horses and dogs, and my passion is the education of dog and horse owners, to provide your animals with the best of rehabilitation care.  For animals young to old, dogs, horses and other animals can all benefit from physiotherapy, whether they have suffered an injury or have undergone surgery, the benefits of physiotherapy are numerous.

Improve range of motion, mobility, reduce pain and the requirement for pain relief medication, improve flexibility, strength and balance, increase muscle strength + more

On my channel you can find plenty of videos and tutorials about equine back health, saddle assessment, core strength, balance, recovery and rehabilitation after surgery + more. 

And of course you will find plenty of other inspirational videos - all around the topic creating a happy pet for life.

Located in Calgary, Alberta, Canada, Moore Equine is one of the most esteemed general and referral centers in all of Canada. Our case load is primarily equine, with additional work in  bovine, camelid, and small ruminants. We provide general veterinary medical services on both an ambulatory and in-hospital basis, seeing hunters, jumpers, western performance, draft horse and all other disciplines, with over 9,350 appointments and 500 surgeries performed each year. At Moore Equine Veterinary Centre, every animal is important to us, as well as every owner, whether you have just purchased your first horse, you are a trainer, or you own a stable. The combination of medical expertise, personalized treatment and cutting edge technology combine to create an unmatched standard of care.

Make sure to check in at our YouTube channel for updates and education material.

Aiken Equine Rescue is the Largest Equine Rescue in SC
Our mission is to rescue unwanted horses who have suffered from abuse and neglect and to "repurpose" off-the-track thoroughbreds. 
The Aiken Equine Rescue has placed over 800 horses, donkeys and mules since our founding in 2006. 
By combining our efforts with community programs, donations and our ever-growing group of volunteers, we are able to provide each horse with food, medical attention and personal care until we find an appropriate and responsible placement.
Hope you enjoy our horse videos!
- See more at: http://aikenequinerescue.org

My name is Reanna Whitnall, owner of Renew Massage & Healing Arts. I am a Certified Massage Therapist with over 20 years of experience. I am also a Certified Group Fitness Instructor and Orthopedic Exercise Specialist.
I specialize in treating clients with chronic pain and injuries. Part of my job is educating my clients on how to take better care of their bodies. With massage I can provide significant relief from severe pain, but without proper self care the effects are temporary, and symptoms can return. 
My number one recommendation is to stretch daily. It is so overlooked by most people, but it is essential for releasing tight muscles, reducing pain, and preventing injury. I hope to provide you with easy to follow guides to stretching, massage, myofascial release and other self care practices to help you maintain optimal wellness. 
Please use caution when attempting any stretches or massage techniques. Consult your physician if you are recovering from an injury or post surgery.

This channel is a glimpse into my life as a veterinary student through the highs, lows, long study nights, clinical postings, exams, and everything it takes to become a veterinarian.

But it’s not just about vet school.

It’s also about the person behind the degree the travels, adventures, friendships, random life moments, and the little things that make the journey worthwhile.

If you’ve ever wondered what veterinary school is really like, love animals, or simply enjoy following someone’s journey as they navigate life and chase their dreams, you’re in the right place.

Here’s to learning, growing, making memories, and documenting the road to becoming a vet. 🤍

New videos whenever life gives me a story worth telling. ✨🐶🩺✈️📚

Sharan Physiotherapy Centre is a professional physiotherapy channel by Dr. Sharan, focused on pain relief, physiotherapy treatment, and sports injury rehabilitation.

This channel aims to educate patients, address common myths, and provide clear, reliable information about physiotherapy care. Content includes musculoskeletal conditions, sports injuries, post-operative rehabilitation, pain management, and movement-based recovery, explained in a simple and practical manner.

You will find patient education videos, condition-based explanations, exercise and rehabilitation guidance, sports injury awareness, and clinical insights.

Online consultations and guided rehabilitation programs are available for eligible musculoskeletal conditions. To begin tele-rehabilitation, please fill out the consultation form (link provided).

For regular updates and clinic-related content, follow us on Instagram: sharan.physiotherapy.centre

— Dr. Sharan
Consultant Physiotherapist

Move better. Live better.

Welcome to Noble Choice Chiropractic

At Noble Choice Chiropractic, our mission is simple: help you move better, feel better, and perform at your highest level.

We proudly serve the communities of Sun Prairie, DeForest, Waunakee, and Madison—working with individuals of all ages, with a special focus on active adults who want more out of their health and performance.

On this channel, you’ll find practical, easy-to-understand guidance on:

Neck and low back pain
Headaches and migraines
Plantar fasciitis, tennis elbow, and joint injuries
Mobility, movement, and performance optimization

But this isn’t just about treating pain—it’s about helping you understand your body so you can stay active, resilient, and in control of your health long-term.

You’ll also get a behind-the-scenes look at our clinic, our team, and how we live out what we teach—both in the office and at home.

If you’re ready to move better, perform better, and live healthier… you’re in the right place.

In a world of confusing veterinary information our job is to ensure your pet remains in, or returns to, the best of health.

The fundamental approach of our vets is “knowledge is power”. All relevant medical information is carefully discussed without technical jargon so as to help you understand our goals. The aim is to explain to you exactly what is wrong so between us we have all the information needed to decide on the best treatment option.

Our focus is on integrity, honesty and transparency as we help manage the health of your pet, thereby building long-term relationships with our clients while understanding the individual needs of every patient and supporting families through their pet-owning journey.

row: Palmetto Animal League is a private, non-profit, no kill animal rescue organization that believes every animal deserves a second chance at life. PAL’s Adoption Center, located in Okatie’s Riverwalk Business Park, serves as a temporary residence for approximately 200 dogs and cats while they wait to find a loving home. This comfortable, upbeat facility is also home to PAL's Community Clinic, which offers spay/neuter, wellness exams, vaccines and other vital services to pet owners at affordable prices. In addition, Palmetto Animal League manages a network of loving foster families to house and care for abandoned animals. Remember to shop at the PAL Thrift Store in Sheridan Park where great buys save lives.

Hallie Hill Animal Sanctuary, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit in South Carolina, provides a safe haven for animals who have nowhere else to go. We focus on preparing animals for adoption through respite, rehabilitation, and socialization. For those with reduced chances of adoption due to age, medical needs, or emotional challenges, we offer a loving Forever Home with proper shelter, nutrition, and medical care. We can’t change an animal’s past, but we can rewrite its future.

By working closely with local shelters and rescues, Hallie Hill helps Charleston maintain its status as a No-Kill Community, welcoming dogs and cats that might otherwise be overlooked. Every animal here matters, and every day is a second chance.

Good Life Dog Rescue is a small charity who care about the welfare of stray dogs in the UK. We are passionate about helping these animals who often face an uncertain future. The rescue was established by a passionate animal lover who for over 8 years has been dedicated to helping stray and abandoned dogs in Yorkshire. The charity flys a flag high for the Staffies and cross Staffies who are often the last to find a rescue place.
Good Life Dog Rescue is self funded. We receive no immediate funding and survive on few donations and fundraising. We pay no wages and have no staff. The charity exists with volunteers who are mainly walkers. The founder has a full time job to part fund huge kennelling and veterinary bills.
Good Life Dog Rescue does not have its own kennels so all the dogs in our care board at kennels in South Yorkshire. All our dogs are walked and cared for and all veterinary care is paid for by our charity.

S.A.T was founded in 1992 by a group of people of all nationalities who saw the need for a sanctuary for the abandoned dogs that roamed the streets of Torrevieja, Spain.

Sociedad Protectora para Animales de Torrevieja’ (or S.A.T) is a registered charity whose aim is to alleviate the local stray and abandoned dog problem. It was formed in 1992 by like minded people and became registered in Valencia as Charity no: 3463. 

Today, with its kennels at San Isidro, it is still a multi-national organisation and a registered charity with the Valencian Community. Our aim is to prevent unnecessary suffering and rehome the many abandoned dogs within the Vega Baja area and now further afield.

SAT is passionately committed to the welfare of all dogs regardless of age, breed and size. 
You can find out more about SAT on our webpage www.satanimalrescue.com

row: My actual practice and development of massage techniques started long before I received formal training at MTIC through my association with a Tai Chi teacher who is trained in Asian massage arts. In 2003 he saved both of my knees from knee replacement surgeries by using Tui Na and other modalities. Since my knees grew stronger than ever, and the doctors were obviously wrong, this teacher became my mentor in Tai Chi and Qi Gong as well as my first massage therapist. I eventually learned to incorporate Tui Na and other techniques into my own massage routines, but today my most popular routines are chair massages which include PNF Tech Therapy. These routines are especially helpful to office workers who suffer from tight rhomboids, head-forward postures, and other symptoms of "office worker syndrome." PNF Tech Therapy is based on the Kaya Kalp healing system as it was practiced in Tibet many centuries ago, and I practice those techniques with an open heart and love for all life.

 We ask everyone to thoroughly investigate us as we would you.  Take a look at what we do and see for yourself who we are.  Supporting animal rescues is an important factor in the lively hood of the neglected and abused in your community. We implore people to support legitimate organizations only after you verify that they are in fact legitimate.

I decided to try the viral Chinese exercises as they are meant to help with releasing fascia, stimulating circulation and lymphatic flow, and helping with stress reduction. At ACC we are proud to provide South Australia's first and only  Bachelor of Chiropractic degree accredited by the Tertiary Education and Quality Standards Agency of Australia (TEQSA).

We offer a boutique educational experience, rich in both scientific theory and practical application, with access to some of the best educators and practitioners in the profession. Our curriculum is also unique in offering entrepreneurial business education so that you will be ready to launch your own business and establish yourself as a qualified chiropractor.

Our links with international organisations such the Rubicon Group and the New Zealand College of Chiropractic provide exciting educational exchange and research opportunities for our students and ensure that ACC is at the forefront of chiropractic education and practice.

Graduate practice-ready, and build lasting professional relationships with committed and visionary chiropractors.

I'm Antoinette, South African Veterinary Nurse & Physio.
Business owner of Healing Hands Pet Physio.

I have extensive experience as a theatre nurse & have assisted with many orthopaedic & spinal surgeries. 

My physio niche lies in recovery programs following surgery & injury, but of course my services are not limited to those patients.
I specialise in a stress-free approach of treatments & come to your home with a mobile service.

If you are interested in my services, please pop me an email at hello@healinghandspetphysio.com or a message on Whatsapp 0712269891. 

I hope you find value here, if so, please subscribe.  

~Attention is the most basic form of Love~
