The mission of One Love Animal Rescue, Inc. is to help abandoned, neglected, abused and unwanted pets by partnering with shelters, rescue groups and the community to facilitate adoption of these animals into permanent and loving homes. 

Our goal is to save one life at a time by promoting local animal shelter adoptions and raising awareness in our community about responsible pet ownership. We strive to highlight the importance of spaying or neutering pets which will aid in the reduction of overpopulation. We believe that appropriate and positive reinforcement training and socialization of these shelter animals will lead to well-adjusted family pets, thereby decreasing the number of abandoned animals in shelters. 
Our dream is that one day all the shelters will be empty because every pet will have a home.

One Love Animal Rescue, Inc. is a volunteer based organization located in Savannah, Georgia. While we await approval of 501(c)3 status, we operate as a non-profit organization.

The Scottsdale Veterinary Clinic was established over 60 years ago as the first Pet Veterinary Center in Scottsdale, Arizona. All of our Doctors and Staff are animal lovers with pets of their own, ranging from dogs and cats to parrots, rabbits, rats, guinea pigs, ferrets, reptiles, and other birds and exotic pets. Our team understands and treasures the bond between you and your pet. We share in the joy and love that animal companionship brings into our lives everyday. We offer a large range of services and therapies that make our hospital unique. We offer emergency medicine, exotic pet and avian services, bone surgery, vaccines and other preventative care, health certificates for travel, neuter, spay, declaw, dental cleaning, in home humane euthanasia, holistic vet services, acupuncture and more!

Follow us:  
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/scottsdalevet/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/tsvcpets/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/tsvc

We provide expert hands-on physical therapy and chiropractic care with an integrated approach to health and natural recovery, without the use of drugs or surgery, for all ages at affordable prices.

Conditions we treat:
    Back Pain, Slipped / Herniated Disc and Degenerative Disc
    Neck Pain and Whiplash
    Headaches and Migraines
    Spondylosis, Arthritis, Osteoarthritis
    Scoliosis
    Poor Posture
    Sciatica
    Numbness / Tingling
    Shoulder, Elbow, Wrist, Hip, Knee, Ankle and Foot Conditions
    Flat Feet / Pronation Syndrome
    Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) Disorder
    Pregnancy Aches and Pains
    Sports Injuries

Conveniently located in Raffles Place and Siglap.

Call +65 6243 2191 for an appointment

Founded in 1909 by Francis Cox, who campaigned for better working conditions for pit ponies and other working horses, the refuge has now grown to provide a home for horses, goats, sheep and cattle. It’s also a safe haven for stray, abandoned or unwanted dogs and cats who are awaiting new homes through our Adoption Programme.

The University of Washington Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, based in Seattle, Washington, USA. We provide regional and national leadership in patient care, education, research and vocational services. Our dedicated faculty members represent a broad spectrum of scientific and clinical disciplines.

The Department of Rehabilitation Medicine's mission is to improve the function, level of independence, and quality of life of people who have disabilities brought about by illness, injury, or of congenital origin.

Academics: We offer degree programs in physical therapy, occupational therapy, and prosthetics and orthotics, as well as a PhD graduate program in Rehabilitation Science.  We have residency programs in Psychology Rehabilitation and Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation.  A number of Fellowships including Brain Injury, Amputation, Multiple Sclerosis, Spinal Cord Injury, Sports Medicine, Pediatric Rehabilitation and more are available.

At ELM Cat Rescue, our rescues are our inspiration. We learn from them, admire their acceptance, and follow their lead. We don't discriminate and we don't judge. Some come to us healthy and socialized; others need urgent care. Many have no trust for humans. We spend countless hours bottle feeding, administering medications, providing fresh food and water, and clean litter boxes - all on top of the constant running of our washing machine. We open our hearts to every personality; laid back, rambunctious, skittish, cuddly, and feral. We accept every age from newborn to senior, both genders, and we will take in any breed or colour.

We do this as mothers of children, working full or part time, volunteering, and battling our own private matters. We have often been commended for our care and ongoing support to our adoptive families. With all this in mind however, we are nothing without our "village". It is because of all our supporters that we are able to continue doing all that we do

row: Stray Paws Rescue - St. Louis, Missouri

STRAY PAWS RESCUE

Protect and Improve The Lives of Rescue Dogs
Stray Paws Rescue is a 501 (c) (3)  nonprofit, foster-based rescue. Our organization believes it is our moral responsibility to protect and improve the lives of rescue dogs to place them in loving permanent homes.

Our mission is to save lives, keep our community informed on humane education, training and loving treatment of our companions, and finding the best fit for both the animals in our care and potential forever families!

We are an all-volunteer, foster-based rescue organization we do NOT have a shelter. We have a group of amazing foster parents who open up their homes to provide these babies a safe, loving, and caring environment while find them great forever homes.  Our animals stay in loving foster homes where they are socialized, loved and evaluated to determine the best type of environment for their personalities.

I am a therapist with over 30 years of clinical experience gained in Poland, the United Kingdom, Norway, and France. I combine the perspectives of physiotherapy and massage therapy, and over the years I have developed my own therapeutic approach — along with many unique techniques and practical tools — as a result of decades of experience, dozens of completed trainings, and my own developed methods, all integrated into one coherent and practical system.
I do not believe in one-size-fits-all protocols. Instead, I teach clinical reasoning and individualized treatment planning, so you can select safe, effective, and appropriate techniques for each client. My goal is not only to demonstrate techniques, but also to help you understand the underlying causes of dysfunction, recognize overload patterns and compensations, and restore functional balance in the body. If you are looking to deepen your skills and improve your clinical outcomes, you are welcome to join my training.

Regenerative Stem Cell Therapy & Pet Rehabilitation at Safari Veterinary Care Centers in League City, TX.

Stem Cells live in all tissues of the body and lay dormant until there is damage in need of repair.

The body’s natural repair process sends healing cells to the area of injury and directs these healing cells as to what needs to be done. In all cases these healing cells are stem cells. However, in many cases, the regenerative process is overwhelmed or exhausted or out of resources and healing is incomplete and that’s where regenerative medicine comes in.

Regenerative medicine strives to use the body’s own healing mechanisms, by adding Platelet Rich Plasma and/or stem cells we can restart the healing process which rejuvenates the damaged tissues and rebuilds damaged or missing tissues.

Stem Cells (don't heal, they) regenerate the original cartilage tissue just as it was when the animal was an infant.

Office: 281-332-5612
Hours: M-F: 6am-8am; Sat & Sun: 9am-6pm

Hi, I’m Dr Lew - a Chiropractor and clinic owner at Sensorium Chiropractic in the UK.

On this channel I share real chiropractic adjustments, simple explanations about pain and the nervous system, and practical advice to help people move and feel better.

You’ll see real patient cases from the clinic, satisfying spinal adjustments, and clear breakdowns of how the body works, including why pain happens, how movement affects the nervous system, and what helps people recover and build confidence in their bodies again.

My goal is to make pain and movement easier to understand so people can take control of their health and build a stronger, more resilient body.

I post new videos regularly showing chiropractic care in practice and sharing honest education about pain, movement and healing.

row: Dr. Kristen Turner is a board-certified veterinarian specializing in exotic companion mammal practice. With a focus on education and improving access to care for exotic pets, she empowers general practice veterinarians to get out of their comfort zone and start seeing exotic animal patients. Over 20 DVMs have taken her flagship CE course, Exotic Vet Med Essentials, a 12-hour interactive RACE-approved program designed to fast-track vets to seeing exotic patients in their practice. You can expect videos and shorts covering a variety of topics designed to guide veterinarians when an exotic patient walks into their practice, from triage and emergency stabilization to preventative care to surgical tips and tricks. Whether you are a recent graduate brand new to exotics, or a seasoned veterinarian, Dr. Turner offers her expertise to help you treat ALL of your exotic patients.

This channel is dedicated to veterinary dermatology, animal skin health, allergy diagnosis, and dermatological research. 
This channel is managed by Dr. Sneh Lata, M.V.Sc., Ph.D., Scientist, Skin Disease Laboratory, Veterinary Clinical Complex (VCC), COVS, LUVAS, Hisar, Haryana, India. 
It provides educational content for veterinarians, veterinary students, researchers, pet owners, and livestock owners interested in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of skin diseases in animals. The topics covered include skin scraping and trichography, fungal, bacterial, parasitic, and allergic skin diseases, canine atopic dermatitis, clinical case discussions and treatment protocols, veterinary dermatology research and laboratory techniques, and One Health aspects of zoonotic skin diseases. Our goal is to promote evidence-based veterinary dermatology through education, research, and clinical expertise. 
#VeterinaryDermatology #VetDerm #AnimalSkinDisease #CanineDermatology #LUVAS #DrSnehLata

Life is about building connections, learning lessons, sharing stories and growing. 
Few things connect you and your business to the community like your story. But who really knows it? Have you ever gained an entirely new level of appreciation OR found yourself sharing some incredible story you heard about a local business? “You won’t believe what they did to get here!” “I couldn’t believe how much training they go through!” “That is a family recipe from over 100 years ago!”  That's the power of story.

While Drop In Local is a video marketing and marketing strategy firm, our foundation is built upon building connections for ourselves and those around us (you!). This channel represents our passion not only for local video marketing and marketing & sales strategies, but also a knowledge base where we share ideas, insights, lessons and stories from our friends across the country and around the globe.

Please subscribe to our channel and connect with us. You'll be glad you did.

We are a small Australian family who doesn't allow our geographical location to define our adventures. Whether 10 mins from home or 10000 kilometres away we enjoy to travel, love, learn and to share.
Camping in tents, budget accommodation or even converting a school bus into a motorhome, we do it all and aim to share the highs, lows and any tips we pick up along the way.

We have sold our home and now  liveaboard our 42 foot Fountaine Pajot Venezia Catamaran. We will soon start sharing our sailing journey, including all the highs, the lows and the amazing adventures. 

Follow along if you would like to see our journeys.

For many years, Dr. Rick Wall has been enthusiastically involved in the practice of physical medicine, rehabilitation and pain management in both dogs and cats. These years have been the most rewarding of his veterinary career, one which spans over thirty years. Dr. Wall developed a tremendous passion for both pain management and physical rehabilitation. Out of this passion, and his deep compassion for both clients and patients, Dr. Wall created the Center for Veterinary Pain Management and Rehabilitation in 2004. Subscribe to our channel to see the success of our patients as they begin to lead a better quality of life and learn about the great work being done here at #CVPMR. Thanks for visiting our page!

Hi, welcome to the Arrive & Thrive channel 👋

Who are we: 
We are a career education social enterprise based in Australia. 

Our mission: 
To enable every individual to design and develop a meaningful career and live a fulfilling life.  

Our Podcast: 
The Arrive & Thrive Career Podcast was created initially by two mates, Daniel Lunardi & Tyson Day, who shared a love for career education and development. After the tragic and unexpected loss of Daniel Lunardi in February 2022, Tyson now continues their vision, inviting people on the show to share stories and learnings in a bid to help others develop meaningful careers and thrive in their chosen pursuits. We commemorate Dan’s soul with the honour segment, “What are you roaring about?” dedicated to the loving memory of Dan. 


Learn more about Arrive & Thrive at arrivethrive.com.au

Welcome to the Vet Nurse Plus Youtube webinar channel 

About Vet Nurse Plus
Vet Nurse Plus is a private training establishment that has one focus - training veterinary nurses. We aim to provide outstanding veterinary nurse graduates to the veterinary industry, who can hit the ground running upon employment. First launched in 2005, programmes are highly practical and graduate outcome-based, incorporating feedback and input from the industry that employs our students. This in turn leads to high demand for our graduates and excellent levels of employment. Well over 70% of our graduates are hired within six months of graduation.

Oasis Second Chance Animal Shelter Ltd (OSCAS) is a registered charity devoted to caring for over a hundred rescued stray mixed breeds. These dogs are rescued from industrial estates, parks and urbanisation of jungles to save them from being culled by the local authorities. More than a hundred 'Singapore Specials' call OSCAS their home as they wait for their right families to come along.

Stray rescue in Singapore is a long tiring journey and a never-ending issue. OSCAS was founded by two ladies who have been relying on their life savings to support the dogs. Help is needed for the shelter to continue caring for the dogs.

Stray Aid is a registered charity, Charity No. 1117372, based in Coxhoe, Durham. Our mission is to rescue, re-unite or rehome the lost, abused, abandoned or unwanted dogs found on the streets in the North East of England. Without your support, we are unable to provide this vital lifeline and we will not succeed in giving these unfortunate dogs a new start in life.  Our aim is to provide practical help and information on stray, lost or abandoned dogs and cats across County Durham, Hartlepool and Middlesbrough. 

This is a very exciting time for the charity. We are raising funds to purchase and redevelop the original boarding kennels site into the new Stray Aid Animal Rescue Shelter. This will complement our existing facilities, allowing us to expand and modernise our kennels. Please help Stray Aid raise £250,000 to purchase our site! Donate now at https://www.justgiving.com/StrayAid-Charity3

As an Esalen Massage Therapist in Atlanta GA, I offer videos educational videos about Esalen Massage therapy. I specialize in Esalen massage: a full-body contemplative massage.  The hallmarks of Esalen massage are long flowing strokes, rocking, stretches, and holds. The goal of Esalen massage is to help the client enter into a deeply relaxed, meditative state.

The Esalen practitioner responds to the unique issues presented by the individual client, instead of imposing a particular protocol, form or set way of working. Each massage is customized to meet your personal needs in the moment.

Created at the Esalen Institute in Big Sur, CA, Esalen Massage was designed to give the client a sense of deep relaxation and integration of body, mind, and spirit.

The AMI Chiropractic Clinic is a family friendly chiropractic practice near Kempston, Bedford that will take care of all of your healthcare needs. We offer a unique and a holistic approach to help treat and manage a number of conditions. 

Our treatments include chiropractic, muscle and exercise techniques, postural correction, lifestyle modification, nutritional advice, deep tissue massage, sports massage, reflexology, medical acupuncture and dry needling.

Our experienced and fully qualified chiropractors will listen to all your concerns, identify the cause of your pain and symptoms, and recommend a course of action to get you moving and feeling better as quickly as possible.

Our aim at the AMI Chiropractic Clinic is help you achieve your goals; whether that is pain relief, injury management, postural correction, stress reduction, sport performance or overall health and wellness.

It is our mission to enhance, educate and empower our local community in Kempston, Bedford.

Welcome to the School of Applied Science (ASC), where science is brought to life! 

ASC offers 5 full-time diplomas in response to the dynamic changes in the vibrant food, chemical, healthcare and life sciences industries. To ensure our students stay relevant and competitive in a rapidly global world, our ability-driven curriculum strives to develop a future-oriented creator, lifelong learner and values-centred leader. The School has identified niche areas in applied research to accelerate the professional growth of its staff and keep abreast of the latest developments. Through the strong industry affiliations and collaborations by our Centres of Excellence, they bring some of the latest research and development opportunities to our doorstep. Often undertaken with industrial involvement, these projects offer a platform for multi-disciplinary technical teams of staff and students to collaborate and innovate.

If you have a passion for science or research, come join us!

row: Rob Robertson is a Registered Massage Therapist (RMQ #M-2915) and owner of The Paw Spa Ottawa-Gatineau K9 Solutions, serving clients in Ontario and Quebec, Canada. He provides massage and teaches canine (K9/dog) and human massage internationally via Udemy, reaching 500+ students in 40+ countries, including the US, Canada, UK, and Australia. He carries full professional liability insurance, is a Blue Cross provider, and offers retail wellness products. Rob delivers customized treatments integrating Myofascial Release, Trigger Point Therapy, Deep Tissue, Ashiatsu, Chakra/Energy Work, and rehabilitative exercises to reduce pain, stress, anxiety, fatigue, migraines, and repetitive strain injuries while improving mobility, flexibility, function, and overall wellness. Contact Rob @itsHealing

Raising the standard. Sharing the journey. Caring beyond the surface.

Hi Everyone! My name is Taryn R. I’ve been a pediatric physical therapist for over 15 years. I have been working with children who need assistance in gaining strength, improving their overall balance, working on their body movements and bilateral coordination. I also work on their motor planning, reaction times, body awareness and safety awareness. I’m certifiied as a pediatric massage therapist and a certified kinesiotaping practitioner.  I incorporate different movements of yoga 🧘🏻‍♂️ to increase flexibility, strength and motor planning.  I add agility drills and body coordination movements as well. 
Each child is different. Each one has strength and the gift to reach their best self.

Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Dr. Christopher Kawa. As a passionate chiropractor and functional wellness expert, I'm dedicated to unlocking the full potential of the human body. Here, you'll discover the transformative power of precision chiropractic adjustments aimed at restoring the body's innate balance.

But my approach is holistic. Dive deep into meticulously curated content about nutrition, cutting-edge rehabilitation exercises, the secrets to optimal gut health, and the intricate dance of body chemistry. If you're on a journey towards weight loss, seeking to manage inflammation, or curious about the right supplementation for you, you've found your trusted guide.

Subscribe and join our community as we explore the world of functional wellness. Together, we can pave the path to a healthier, more vibrant life. Stay aligned and thrive! 💪🌿🔍

Remember, wellness is a journey, not a destination. Let's travel it together.

row: 13 Hands Equine Rescue is a Not for Profit 501c3 Animal Rescue.  We specialize in the rescue of unwanted, abused and slaughter bound horses.  Most of our horses are rescued from kill pens and auction houses where we are their last chance.  The slaughter of horses is a highly profitable business and most of the horses are ill-treated, underfed and scared in the hopes of making the most money for them.  All of our horses are sent to a Quarantine facility for 30 days so they can rest and regain their health and strength. Once they are approved by a licensed veterinarian they are sent to our facility and begin their journey to the horse they were meant to be.  Some of them will be trained and evaluated to be used in our program for therapy for the human-equine connection.  Others will be adopted out to other loving homes and some will stay and become 13 Hands full time residents.

row: Spinal Care Chiropractic And Joint Rehabilitation

OUR APPROACH
Our goal is to get you out of pain and keep you that way. That is our bottom line.
When our doctors do an initial evaluation, we will have a good idea if your condition is something we can fix or not. If we can fix it, we will explain to you what the problem is, how it will be fixed and about how long it will take. If it is something that we cannot fix, we will explain that too, and we will work with you to get you to someone who can help whether that is an orthopedist, pain management specialist, physical therapist or other provider. Once we get you out of pain, we will work with you to help keep you that way and prevent reinjury. Our job is to fix the injury and release you. We do not want to see you back in our office repeatedly or for a long term plan.

Hi! I'm Victoria—a pediatric physical therapist (DPT), educator, and mom of twins, a toddler, and a big kid.

This channel is your go-to resource for baby & toddler development, milestones, movement, and play through practical, evidence-based education.

You'll find:
• Tutorials on rolling, sitting, crawling, walking, torticollis, plagiocephaly, tummy time, and more
• Product reviews, unboxings, and recommendations
• Easy activities for babies and toddlers
• Answers to common parenting questions and milestone myths
• Behind-the-scenes pediatric PT insights
• Family life, travel, and everyday adventures

Whether you're looking for milestone guidance, development tips, product recommendations, or family inspiration, you're in the right place.

⬇️ Developmental guides:
https://stan.store/masteringmthrhd

Disclaimer: Content is for educational purposes only and is not medical advice. Always consult your pediatrician or pediatric physical therapist. Individual evaluation is recommended.

row: Jacki has had a passion and love for horses, and has been involved with them her whole life.   Her and her husband, Jim,  run a 60 + year Quarter horse breeding program.   Her husband is also a professional cutting horse trainer, with almost two hundred thousand dollars in earnings, and is a NCHA judge as well.   Jacki has always been an avid learner and loves to study anything and everything about horses, while basing that knowledge on real life experiences.   She has won money or earned points in all kinds of disciplines including, cutting, barrel racing, team sorting/penning, extreme trail, and ranch riding.   She is also a certified equine massage therapist.  For many years now she has taught classes on subjects such as ground work, equine psychology, color genetics, and massage.   Most of all, Jacki loves to share how God uses horses to teach us about Him, and about ourselves.

row: Family Support Services of North Florida

Family Support Services of North Florida (FSSNF) is the lead agency for foster care, adoption and family preservation in Duval, Nassau, Pasco and Pinellas counties in Florida. Through community-based care, FSS provides services and programs to help prevent child abuse and neglect, to promote a healthy family environment and prevention services, care for our community's children in foster care, and permanency through adoption. The nonprofit organization was established in 2001 to provide child protective services in Duval County, and was expanded to also serve Nassau County in 2007. In 2022, our community of care expanded to Pasco and Pinellas counties in Florida's Suncoast. Learn more about our mission and support services at familysupport.org.

K9 Gym and Rehabilitation Center is dedicated to enhance your pet's quality of life & comfort.  Our compassionate staff is comprised of veterinarians, veterinary technicians, a physical therapist, & a massage therapist who are certified in veterinary acupuncture & chiropractic, canine rehabilitation, &/or massage. After your pet is evaluated by our veterinarian & physical therapist, we will create a custom tailored treatment program to restore mobility & minimize your pet's discomfort through the various services we provide.

K9 Gym and Rehab offers veterinary acupuncture & chiropractic (musculoskeletal manipulation) services, therapeutic massage, cold laser therapy, ultrasound therapy, electrical stimulation, therapeutic exercise, and hydrotherapy using underwater treadmills and a 15,000 gallon pool.  

Whether your pet is a performance athlete or a laid-back senior, we at K9 Gym and Rehab are dedicated to improving their comfort & quality of life.

The Dawg Squad is an all-volunteer animal rescue working in the Los Angeles area. We rescue at-risk animals focusing on homeless and abandoned dogs providing medical care, rehabilitation and loving foster homes until a permanent, adoptive homes can be found. 

All animals are spayed, neutered and microchipped prior to adoption.
To date we have rescued and placed over 1100+ animals in loving homes.

The Dawg Squad is an all-volunteer organization. It has no paid employees or salaried officers.  We do not have an  expensive shelter facility; we foster every animal in volunteers' homes or approved kennels before finding homes.

Welcome to The Adjusted Perspective – a podcast by chiropractic students, for chiropractic students, future students, and anyone curious about the power of chiropractic care.

Hosted by CJ Peechatka, Carson Tuttle, Joe Crosson, Gabe Higgins, and Eddie Diaz, this podcast dives into the world of chiropractic from the lens of current students passionate about health, healing, and hands-on care. We bring you real conversations about spinal adjustments, chiropractic philosophy, research, anatomy, technique, and the evolving role of chiropractic in today’s healthcare landscape.

Whether you’re deep into your chiropractic education, considering the profession, or just want to learn more about what we do and why it matters — you’re in the right place.

Subscribe for honest insights, engaging discussions, and a student-driven perspective that keeps it real, relevant, and rooted in the purpose of chiropractic.

Minton Farm rescues koalas, kangaroos, possums, owls, hawks, eagles, lorikeets, rosellas, parrots, magpies, kookaburras, tawny frogmouths, lizards and tortoises and plays home to a euro, horses, lamb, goats, deer, emus, seagulls, peacocks and a menagerie of other animals.

Minton Farm is a non-government, not for profit, voluntarily operated organisation operating solely on donations, volunteer input and community goodwill.

One of the most of the important goals for Minton Farm is to rehabilitate the animals and return them to where they were originally collected from, so all patients are documented and records kept, ensuring the animals can be released back into their environment.

You can find out more about Minton Farm Animal Rescue Centre's work and animal care tips by visiting their website, www.mintonfarm.org

Juliet’s House Animal Rescue is a nonprofit, foster-based rescue in North Carolina dedicated to saving the most vulnerable animals — especially neonatal kittens, bottle baby kittens, orphaned puppies, and animals with complex medical needs. Many arrive weighing just a few ounces and require round-the-clock care to survive.

On this channel, you’ll see real rescue stories, neonatal care education, and the incredible transformations that happen when fragile animals receive the support they need. From bottle feeding and medical recovery to adoption day, we share the journey every step of the way.

Subscribe to follow these tiny fighters as they grow stronger each day — and see how compassion can change lives.

📍 Based in North Carolina
🐾 Foster-based rescue
💛 Saving the tiniest lives — one bottle baby at a time

row: Boutique, outpatient Physical Therapy practice in Highlands Ranch, Colorado.  Three PT’s decided to leave the traditional corporate physical therapy model that relies on insurance networks, pre-authorizations, and physicians referrals.  That is out the window.  This is one-on-one physical therapy.  No pre-authorization, no referrals, no insurance requirements, no techs, no aids, no waiting rooms.  Whether you need one treatment, 4 treatments, or on-going treatments will be determined by you, not an insurance company.  We rely on word of mouth referrals and results from satisfied patients.  If you’ve tried physical therapy in the past and have been less than 100% satisfied, try Trifecta Physical Therapy and try physical therapy the way it should be.

Complete Physical Rehabilitation provides Physical Therapy, Acupuncture, and Wellness services in Elizabeth and Jersey City.  In addition to general Physical Therapy, we focus on:

Vestibular (Dizziness) Physical Therapy
McKenzie Spine Physical Therapy
Joint Physical Therapy
Runners Training & Physical Therapy

Since 2004, our physical therapists have excelled at offering the most comprehensive PT programs available, centered on our one-on-one Physical Therapy & Acupuncture services.

We are the FIRST clinic to offer LightForce® laser therapy treatment programs and the AlterG® Anti-Gravity Treadmill in Elizabeth & Jersey City.

In addition,  we are one of the top specialists in Jersey City and Elizabeth for vestibular (dizziness/vertigo) rehab. We also are certified specialists in back pain and sciatica using the McKenzie Method®, certified LSVT BIG specialists for Parkinson’s Disease, & specialize in treating runners.

row: The Radical Massage Therapist- Freedom, No BS

FREE Massage Practice Checklist 👇

Hi, I’m Krista — I’m here to help massage therapists recognize their career is a golden goose that gives them freedom, flexibility, financial success, and fun (even if they don’t love massage itself).

As a Registered Massage Therapist, clinic owner, podcast host, and coach, I bridge the gap between real talk confessions about this career and practical coaching that helps therapists build sustainable practices without the BS.

I run an education + coaching hub over at www.theradicalrmt.com for massage therapists who are tired of the industry lies and want to design a practice that actually works for their life — in a way that’s radical, honest, and fun.

I especially love connecting with massage therapists who feel stuck, frustrated, or guilty for not being “passionate enough,” but are ready to reclaim their freedom and build a career that supports the lifestyle they actually want.

Is that you? Let’s connect!

💌 krista@theradicalrmt.com

At Maidenhead Chiropractic Clinic, we offer a multidisciplinary approach to your health.  We offer a range of private complimentary health services to suit any needs, all under one roof. 

Our services include; Chiropractic, Massage and Myofascial Release therapy, Scar Therapy and Sports Therapy. Our highly trained team can help you decide which service may be better for you, if you are unsure to achieve the best possible results for you.

Our Clinic is situated within the beautiful Castle Royle Golf & Country Club, Knowl Hill making is easily accessible to those in Maidenhead, Burchetts Green, Littlewick Green, Henley, Marlow, Wargrave, Twyford and Sonning.

Welcome to Veterinary Medicine After Hours!

Hosted by Dr. Rene', a practicing veterinarian and practice owner, and Jenny, an experienced veterinary practice manager, Veterinary Medicine After Hours explores the real stories behind one of the most rewarding—and challenging—professions.

After the clinic closes, the filters come off. We talk about the highs, the lows, the hilarious, the heartbreaking, and everything in between. From medicine and practice management to leadership, burnout, difficult clients, unforgettable cases, and the stories every veterinary professional can relate to—nothing is off the table.

Whether you're a veterinarian, veterinary technician, assistant, receptionist, practice manager, student, or simply curious about what really happens behind the scenes, you're in the right place.

Expect honest conversations, lots of laughs, occasional soju shots, and a healthy dose of sarcasm.

Real Talk. Uncensored. Vet Stories & Soju Shots.

🐾 New episodes every week.

row: Injured in a car accident? Suffering from a sports injury? Do you have back pain, neck pain, or headaches? Owsley Chiropractic is located in Bowling Green, KY just off Scottsville Road. At Owsley Chiropractic we offer: Same Day Appointments, Walk In Appointments, Emergency Care without Waiting, Physical Therapy Treatment, we have a full time Licensed Massage Therapist, and offer a Functional Movement Rehabilitation program. Life has a way of throwing pain at us- accidents, sports injuries or everyday cubicle wear and tear. In the push and pull of todays crowded atmosphere, we often carry the world on our shoulders. Your body doesn't always tell you what it needs in a language you can understand; aches and pains can sometimes be indicative of larger issues. Or it could be that your body simply wants some much-needed stress relief. Dr. Owsley will work with you to target the root of your pain and get you back to your best. You'll feel the difference throughout your body and your day.

LOVING VETERINARY CARE FOR YOUR EXOTIC PETS
Dr Karli Du Preez of Exotic Vet Century City, Cape Town, is an exotic veterinary surgeon who is passionate to provide loving care and treatment for Exotic Pets.

Our primary patients are birds which includes parrots, parakeets, lorikeets, ducks, pigeons and chickens, rabbits, rats, mice, snakes & hamsters, reptiles, guinea pigs, primates, and wildlife.

It's important to choose an exotic veterinary hospital and surgery with experienced staff and veterinarians who are knowledgeable about the specific needs of your exotic pet.

Exotic animal patients are small and delicate and therefore require refined micro-surgical technique. Exotic Vet Century City Hospital have specialized equipment and facilities tailored to the care of exotic animals, as well as staff who are trained and experienced to handle their unique behaviors and health concerns.

My main Channel: JennaSampsonEquus

My old channel used for raws. My name is Jenna Sampson. I am a 19 year-old girl from the US with the passion of working with horses. Unlike other Equestrian YouTubers you may see, I only trained myself to ride horses without any trainers (other than my dad) due to the lack of english trainers in my state. I graduated in 2019 and I'm currently going to college to be an Equine Vet (and hopefully an Equine Chiropractor too). If you enjoy my content, leave a like and subscribe to my channel.

My horses:

Misty's Thunder: 2005 14hh black Quarter Horse/Kentucky Natural Gaited Horse mare

Shesthetownbully: 2011 16.1hh bay off the track Thoroughbred mare by Hesabull out of Harpy

Pj: 2001 15hh white few spot Appaloosa gelding

Jimmeny (my newest project horse): 2015 15hh bay dun Mustang/Quarter Horse gelding (he's currently for sale)

Horses I used to own:

Smokey (RIP), Hope (RIP), Jazmine

This station is focused on pediatric physical therapy intervention ideas for the purpose of guiding home programming as well as a resource for pediatric teletherapy services by a physical therapist.  Occupational therapist may also find these videos helpful as an adjunct to their programming. 

All pediatric physical therapy services should be overseen by a licensed physical therapist with an active doctor's prescription, depending on your state. These videos are not designed to replace direct therapy or teletherapy services, nor are they meant to substitute professional medical advice, diagnosis or intervention.  Please speak to your pediatrician or therapist before beginning any virtual programming. All activities must be adult supervised and done at your own risk.   

Hopefully these videos will be a great resource for pediatric therapists and the children and families they service.  Please enjoy! :-) Dr. C

SCAT Street Cat Rescue Program Inc. is a volunteer-driven animal welfare agency which has been saving and bettering feline lives since 1996.

This agency’s primary focus is on feral and homeless cats living on the streets of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada.  Our goal is to provide a healthier future for each cat brought into the program.

To accomplish this goal, we have built a network of hundreds of volunteers and supporters - everything from colony care givers to foster homes and acreage relocations, and from office management to fundraising event coordinators.  Street Cat promotes a high standard of animal health care thanks to our network of animal health professionals. 

The SCAT Adoption Centre helps approximately 300 cats a year and receives approximately 2000 hotline calls yearly from members of the community requesting help for cats.

row: Erica H. O'Meara - Mobile Massage Mentor

Welcome!

Whether you’re a massage therapist looking to elevate your practice or someone who simply wants to better understand your own body, you’re in the right place.

I’m Erica O’Meara - a licensed massage therapist, educator, and owner of Philly Home Massage Collective. After years of working with clients from every walk of life, I’ve learned that great bodywork isn’t just about muscles. It’s about awareness, communication, recovery, and understanding how our daily choices shape the way we feel.

On this channel you’ll find content for both massage therapists and clients.

No matter which side of the table you’re on, my goal is the same: To help people understand the body a little better than they did yesterday.

If that sounds like something you want more of, subscribe and join me!

The aim of the Jing Method™ to relieve pain and release restrictions. The method incorporates hot stones, myofascial release, trigger point therapy, acupressure, stretching and personalised self-care.

As and when I get organised, I'll post some videos of the techniques involved. I also hope to add some self-care videos to help relieve chronic pain issues such as low-back pain, frozen shoulder and plantar fasciitis.

Evidence-based holistic care for cats with kidney disease and chronic illness — from an Animal Naturopath with 14+ years of experience.

If your cat has chronic kidney disease (CKD), metabolic nausea, gut issues, or a chronic condition that your vet calls "manage but not cure" — this channel is for you.

Everyone thinks holistic care means guessing. It does not. Every protocol here is grounded in science and built for the real, day-to-day life of a sick cat.

What you'll find:
🐾 Kidney disease in cats — diet, supplements, monitoring
🐾 Metabolic nausea and appetite loss — why it happens, what helps
🐾 Gut health and chronic illness — the links most vets miss
🐾 Evidence-based natural remedies — what works, what's hype


🤖 TRANSPARENCY: This channel is presented using my digital avatar. Every script is personally researched, written, and reviewed by me.

April 2016 is Equine Flu Awareness Month. For expert advice on how you can best protect your horses and others they come into contact with, take a look at the range of Equine Flu Awareness videos from Merial Animal Health Ltd. 

These videos are packed with information and advice from leading equine veterinarians and specialists in animal diseases. They can help you to recognise the signs and symptoms of equine flu, how it spreads, and how correct vaccination and biosecurity can help manage the disease. The videos also outline the role of flu virus surveillance in the UK, which is supported by The Horserace Betting Levy Board Equine Influenza Surveillance Programme run by the Animal Health Trust, and how this influences vaccination guidance and development of vaccines.

Brought to you by Merial, the manufacturers of ProteqFlu® vaccines.

Welcome to Accell Animal Therapy where we believe good circulation is important for all creatures great and small. Accell Animal Therapy devices have been developed in Australia from the Niagara Therapy CVT class IIa medical devices that have been used by humans and animals to improve circulation, lymphatic drainage, joint mobility, relax muscles and much more since 1949.

Accell Animal Therapy provides a simple and effective, reliable and repeatable physical therapy solution that is proven to improve circulation, improve lymphatic drainage, aid in wound healing and injury management, assist with joint mobility, relieve muscle and joint pain, relax muscles and increase nerve-muscle communication. Therapy applications are not just limited to performance use; Accell Animal Therapy devices are used by domestic pet owners, animal therapists, greyhound trainers and veterinary practices all around Australia and New Zealand.

You don’t want to push through the pain.
And you shouldn’t have to.

Call us before **10 AM, Monday–Thursday**, and we’ll do our best to get you in for a same-day treatment.

Your body is talking.
Let’s listen to it.

row: Hands On Health Massage Therapy & Wellness

Hands On Health Massage Therapy and Wellness is a group therapeutic massage practice located in Cary, NC. Our highly trained team of licensed massage and bodywork therapists specialize in medical massage, sports performance and recovery, and stress management techniques. We use our advanced professional training and extensive experience to provide natural pain relief for sore muscles, injury rehab to encourage optimal range of motion in all the joints of the body, and improved flexibility throughout the body, from a soft tissue perspective. 

Many of our clients get much needed relief from chronic pain such as headaches, migraines, neck pain, back pain, low back pain, foot pain (plantar fasciitis), hip pain (sciatica), inflammation, swelling (edema), repetitive stress injury, carpal tunnel, thoracic outlet, and more. We work closely with medical doctors, chiropractors, physical therapists, osteopaths, athletic trainers and coaches- to get lasting results for your specific needs.

Farm animals have the same emotional capacity as traditional companions like dogs and cats, yet modern cruelty laws do not apply to them. Under the law, they are seen as mere objects for human use.

At Ching Farm, we fill a need in the Salt Lake area by advocating for farm animals through rescue, education, and adoption/placement services. We believe that our advocate work can help change perceptions of farm animals and create a deeper respect for the rich emotional lives of these animals.

Ching Farm Rescue and Sanctuary was founded by Faith and Mike Ching in Utah in 1998. The farm became incorporated as Ching Farm Rescue as a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, and your donations are tax-deductible.

AlphaFlo® is a canine amniotic tissue allograft that was created to supplement and protect canine tissues.  AlphaFlo® is comprised of cytokines, growth factors, and extracellular matrix proteins that are naturally found in amniotic tissues. The use of canine amniotic tissue allografts to supplement and protect tissues in canines may be minimally invasive, safe, and offer a morbidity profile comparable to or better than those of existing modalities.

Amniotic tissues possess reported anti-inflammatory, anti-microbial, anti-fibrotic, and regenerative properties that make it attractive for use in veterinary applications.

Tissues are recovered from healthy dogs during live birth by Licensed Veterinarians using safe recovery techniques and sterile equipment without harm to the animals. Allografts are subject to stringent USP testing prior to release for implantation. Ask your Vet about AlphaFlo®

row: Integrative Sports Chiropractor & BJJ Black Belt

Dr. Jorge is an integrative family & sports chiropractor, functional medicine expert, pastor/minister & a 2nd degree BJJ black belt.   

Dr. J has over 20 years of clinical experience treating sports and work-related injuries and over 15 years of experience teaching martial arts.  Dr. J is looking for like-minded individuals who love the grappling arts and are interested in holistic and conservative approaches to health and wellness.  Since suffering from severe asthma as a child which was never cured by prescription medications, Dr. J became passionate about getting people off of their prescription medications, overcoming drug dependence and addiction through martial arts, diet & herbal therapy, combined with manual chiropractic techniques. He will soon be offering conventional medical services, Acupuncture, & Traditional Chinese Medicine.  

If you are interested in health, wellness, or the combative arts & self-defense, and want to learn more follow us for more informative videos!

row:
Brinsley Animal Rescue was founded by Jon Beresford and partner Bethan Hewis, we met in 2001 and share a passion for animals. We started by volunteering for the Charities Animal Accident Rescue Unit and Prevent Unwanted Pets and soon found our house in West Bridgford full of rescued pets and wild animals. We eventually decided to move when almost every room had a rabbit, a wild bird or a hedgehog in it.
In 2007 we bought a 4 acre property in Brinsley Nottingham where we have been welcomed by the local community. We expanded to take on farm animals as well as pets and wild animals and we continue to expand as the funds allow.
Brinsley Animal Rescue is now a Registered Charity run for animals by volunteers. The Charity is run on vegan values, therefore we do not believe in exploiting animals for food, profit or entertainment.
We have no paid staff and our premises, land, buildings, utilities and fuel are donated by us to the Charity free of charge.

Royal Animal Rescue (RAR) was established with the primary objective of providing swift medical transportation for animals. Singapore lacks a specialised ambulance service exclusively dedicated to animals. Our mission is to transform this scenario, aiming to offer an improved service that caters to creatures of all sizes. Our ultimate aim is to prevent any unnecessary loss of cherished companions.

At RAR, our paramedic and rescue team is equipped with comprehensive training to administer diverse first aid procedures tailored to animals. The essence of time is paramount when dealing with injured or unwell animals, and we take this responsibility to heart. Our drivers have undergone specialised training in defensive driving, ensuring a safe and timely journey to the nearest veterinary clinics. We've further outfitted our vehicles with vital medical equipment, a pivotal measure to ensure that our patients experience no further decline in health while en route to receive care.

At Zehr Chiropractic in Norton Shores, Michigan we use extremely precise advanced Upper Cervical Chiropractic techniques to improve the health and life of our patients. 

Upper Cervical Chiropractic care is a very gentle technique that does not utilize twisting, popping or cracking. Our safe approach has proved extremely effective for those suffering from a variety of chronic conditions including migraines, vertigo, fibromyalgia, back pain, neck pain, TMJ and more. 

To schedule a consultation with Dr. Jeffrey Zehr please call 231-227-4495
To learn more about our practice visit our website at zehrchiropractic.com

We would love to see if our unique form of care can help you find the relief you have been looking for.

If would like to learn even more about Upper Cervical Care please visit https://uppercervicalawareness.com/

Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Trebaluger Equine Rescue Centre, a non-profit sanctuary in Menorca, Spain, dedicated to rescuing, rehabilitating, and providing a forever home for abandoned, abused, and neglected horses, ponies, donkeys, and mules. 

Founded in 2018 by Samantha Lake after she witnessed the heartbreaking reality of equine abandonment on this island of horse lovers, Trebaluger offers these animals a permanent, safe, and loving place to live freely. Today, we care for over 30 equines and lots of cats, chickens, ducks, a pig, and a dog. 

Every view, share, and subscription directly supports our mission: food, veterinary expenses, and maintaining our stables, water systems, and fences. We believe every equine deserves a happy, healthy life free from fear and neglect. 

📍 Located at Cami De Ses Cometes, Trebaluger, Es Castell, Menorca  
🕒 Open daily 9:30–12:00 for visits  
🔔 Subscribe and join our community of compassion, because together, we rescue and give hope

Welcome to Dee’s Daily! 

I’m Deanna, a Pilates instructor, Medical Qi Gong practitioner and Registered Canine Massage Therapist based in Toronto. My professional work centres on helping people and dogs move and feel better, but I’ve come to see that our well-being is shaped by much more than movement alone.

To me, wellness is less about perfect habits and more about wholeness - recognizing how movement, home, food, animals, relationships and enjoyment all contribute to how we live and move through the world. 

Here you’ll find Pilates and Qi Gong, canine massage and mobility tips, recipes, cleaning and lower-tox home ideas, seasonal projects and everyday life in between - without the expectation of doing any of it perfectly.

Dee’s Daily is part of Deanna Miconi Wellness. Subscribe and come along! 🔔

Wiley's Wish Animal Rescue is a female and Veteran operated 501(c)3 nonprofit organization dedicated to rescuing dogs from high-kill shelters due to the overcrowding crisis in California. From the Bay to LA, Wiley's Wish aims to rescue, rehabilitate, train and place abandoned, abused, sick and neglected souls stuck behind bars. Since mid-2021, Wiley's has saved and placed over 1,000 dogs into loving, happy homes. 

Wileys' Paws of Hope initiative is an in-house, 3-month long prison/rescue dog training program that spans three prisons, with their respective curriculum, Stripes and Paws Dog Program and Second Chance Dog Program and Unleashed Rescue Academy. Over 350 dogs have successfully graduated from these training programs, AKC and CGC certified. 

To support our rescue and training efforts, please donate! Every dollar helps: https://wileyswish.com/donation

The McTimoney Animal Association is the professional body for McTimoney Animal Practitioners. The McTimoney Animal Association exists to promote excellence in animal chiropractic for its members, and to the veterinary and animal-owning communities.

McTimoney is a form of chiropractic manipulation used to treat pain and dysfunction of the musculoskeletal system. It predominantly focuses on optimising alignment of the spine and pelvis in order to restore correct function of the skeletal system, nervous system and surrounding soft tissue. The technique is non-invasive and gentle and is readily accepted by animals. The treatment aims to resolve dysfunction and balance the animal’s musculoskeletal system, restoring health and movement, soundness and performance.

LUOSKO German Shepherd Dog Rescue is a small independent registered charity (#1188407) set up to responsibly rescue, rehabilitate and re-home German Shepherds who find themselves in difficult situations. 

Funded pretty much entirely by the public donations, we normally re-home around 100+ dogs each year. 

At any one time we have around 50 dogs in our care, in our center in Cheadle, foster homes or in holding kennels awaiting suitable foster or adoption homes. We operate on a national basis so our dogs can be homed in most areas throughout the UK.

Part of our responsible re-homing process we try to match our dogs to potential families, we normally organise several face to face meetings and home visits before our dogs go to their final adoption families, which has significantly reduced the amount of dogs coming back into rescue and increased our successful adoptions creating extremely happy families.

row: AKB Dressage and Soft Tissue Therapy

Female Equestrian with a passion for Dressage. Full time groom in Dorset and part time Sports Massage therapist for Humans (OSSM level 5)and Horses (Equissage Europe). The correlation between rider asymmetry and horses fascinates me along with the biomechanics and rehabilitation side of the horse world. Had my own horse since 11years old but sadly sold my dressage horse around 7years ago and have since trained and competed on my employers horses. Up until 2020 the horses we had on the yard were not for dressage but since then we have purchased the lovely Hanoverian Finnick SR and our training and competing has commenced and so far been pretty successful. I suppose the dream is to go the nationals, however every outing we have i see as learning and training. The scores and frills are all a bonus. I enjoy doing groundwork with all the horses and vary their work with regular hacking, polework, jumping, lunging, inhand poles and schooling. please enjoy following our adventures.

Devoted to your health & well-being, Dembski Chiropractic provides intuitive chiropractic care and mutational counseling. Dr. Christopher Dembski, Dr. Cassandra Maximenko, and Dr. Jason Stryjewski provide quality chiropractic care to thousands of patients in western Connecticut. Whether you're searching for effective pain relief or a way to boost whole body wellness, Dembski Chiropractic & Rehabilitation can help.
We treat all musculoskeletal injuries, including, but not limited to, neck, back, hip, knee, running and rotator cuff injuries; headaches; tennis elbow; effects of repetitive stress; and plantar fasciitis. There is an emphasis on myofascial therapy and techniques such as the Graston Technique and Active-Release Technique.  Using these methods, we aim to resolve injuries and improve health among our patients. Whether you're searching for effective pain relief or a way to boost whole body wellness, Dembski Chiropractic and Rehabilitation can help.

趕走［亞健康］狀態，否則，很可能會增加罹患其他慢性疾病的機會 。

Welcome to the official YouTube channel for Purr Partners Feline Rescue, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to saving the most at-risk cats and kittens in central North Carolina.

We focus our mission on those who need us most: felines in high-kill shelters, survivors of hoarding situations, the sick and injured, and fragile bottle babies requiring 24/7 care. By stepping in where the need is greatest, we give a voice to the vulnerable.

Why Foster-Based?
As an all-foster rescue, we don’t have a central building. Instead, our cats live in private homes with dedicated volunteers. This allows every kitty to socialize, rehabilitate, and thrive in a safe, loving environment before finding their forever family.

Join Our Mission:

Adopt: View our available cats at purrpartners.org.

Foster: Become the bridge between rescue and adoption.

Support: Your donations fund life-saving medical care.

Subscribe for rescue stories, recovery updates, and plenty of happy endings! 🐾

Hi I’m Chelsea DeSouza, an LMT and host of Making Selfcare — a podcast for massage therapists. 

I'm re-evaluating the profession from how I show up in my clinic, to the term masseuse, to the beef we have with PT's to how we're viewed in healthcare. 

Governing authorities are changing ordinances left and right and massage therapists should have their voice in the mix. Follow along, listen in, or share your opinion with me and hop on the show! 

You can find me below: 

Listen in: 
https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/making-self-care/id1515360857

Follow: 
Instagram.com/chelseacdesouza 
https://www.facebook.com/chelsea.desouza.nenno/

How You Can Support This Work:

At EJS, we aim to bring physiotherapy and equine behaviour together to create physical and emotional harmony for your horse.

Emma is an Intelligent Horsemanship Trainer with over 10 years of experience with horses. She has worked as a rehabilitation groom for the RSPCA and World Horse Welfare, starting Emma's journey into Veterinary Physiotherapy.

She is now a fully insured and qualified Veterinary Physiotherapist, under the AHPR and NAVP, aiming to provide evidence-backed treatments for maintaining, prevention and recovery, getting the best out of your horse. 

With the knowledge Emma has gained over the years, she has found that there is so much that could be given to owners. The goal for EJS Animal Studies is to provide courses and workshops for everyone and anyone who wants to expand their own knowledge.

Quality Home and Sports Massage Therapist is a mobile care and rehabilitation service dedicated to improving health, mobility, and overall well-being. We specialize in providing personalized, in-home care for elderly clients, as well as expert rehabilitation and sports massage therapy for athletes and active individuals.
Our services focus on injury recovery, pain management, and functional rehabilitation, including specialized support for stroke patients. With a background in nursing and hands-on experience working with athletes, we combine clinical knowledge with practical treatment techniques to deliver safe, effective, and results-driven care.
We are committed to helping each client regain strength, restore movement, and return to their daily activities with confidence all in the comfort of their own environment.

Canham Farm Horse Rescue Exists:

To retrain horses to have a useful and respected life
To ensure the horse is matched correctly with his or her new sponsor/owner.
To give ongoing support and advice on all aspects of equine care and re-settlement.
To support and commit to the welfare of all horses
To provide education and training courses for people wanting to learn about keeping, training and rehabilitating horses
Educating People to Interact Successfully With Horses

Horses can be complicated and confusing. There are so many things to learn and remember, and so much often conflicting information available, that it can be difficult to know where to turn. We are here to help and would far prefer an owner to ask if they are not sure about something. This could be anything, from knowing how to help a new horse settle in, to admitting that you’re struggling to cope.

Hi there!  We are BestPals Animal Rescue Center, a no-kill non-profit animal rescue located in Holland, Michigan.  We have been in operation for 10 years now, and are primarily volunteer-run thanks to our amazing community.

We help the animals others cannot by focusing on owner-surrenders and shelter-transfers.  Our mission is to ensure our furry-friends find their best #FureverHome, with the help and care of our patient volunteers , and our foster-to-adopt program, where potential owners are able to spend a couple weeks with the dog or cat to make sure it's a positive experience for everyone in the home.

We're slowly looking to expand our presence on social media, and wanted to say hello, and thank you for your support!

#BestPalsAnimalRescueCenter #MeetYourNewBestPal

row:
Hi I'm Petra. 
I am the founder and coach/therapist of Core Fit Canine, LLC. I am a certified Canine Strength and Conditioning Coach and a Certified Massage Therapist, and I am here to help your dog stay fit, happy and healthy with enriching, positive and fun fitness programs as well as canine massage — all tailored to the individual dog's needs and abilities.
I also specialize in truffle hunting and truffle dog training — one of the most fascinating canine activities I have been involved with. My approach combines science-based knowledge, real-world experience, and positive training methods — always with the goal of filling dogs' lives with joy and strengthening the partnership between them and their owners.   
Check out my website www.corefitcanine.com and my truffle dog YouTube channel https://www.youtube.com/@Idigtruffles for more info and videos. I also wrote a digital training guide on Truffle Dog Training called "The Art of Truffle Hunting", which is available on my website.

Pediatric Physical Therapist & Human Movement Specialist

Rebecca Hale is a Pediatric Physical Therapist and Human Movement Specialist. She currently works in the Chelsea school system with grades 1-12. She works with student’s body control, strength, and balance to decrease barriers of attention and behavior to better access the learning and the school environment.

Rebecca has worked in the industry for 22 years and has experience with clients ranging from three months to one hundred three years of age. Her passion is working with children on the autism spectrum and those disconnected by traumatic experiences. She helps children and parents access their body’s innate wisdom and find comfort in their own anatomy. She also helps people interpret children’s behaviors and how they relate to the physiological needs of each individual.

Animal Emergency Clinic of Cary was founded in 1998 as a collaborative effort between multiple practice owners in the Cary area to provide after hours emergency veterinary care for their patients. With the support of our referring veterinarians, AECC expanded to 24/7 services and hospitalization in 2016.

Veterinary Rehabilitation & Pain Management Hospital was founded by Dr. Shults after 3 years of full time emergency practice. This full-service veterinary rehabilitation hospital focuses on applying physical rehabilitation techniques and pain management to canine and feline patients who have physical limitations due to injury, neurological disease, surgery, or chronic pain.

Dr. Rod Block, author of Like Chiropractic for Elephants: How Animal Chiropractic Can Change Your (And Your Animal’s) World, has been providing holistic animal-chiropractic care for over 20 years, through his practice Southern California Equine Chiropractic. Working with veterinarians, he provides lower-cost loving care that prevents expensive future procedures and adds years of stress-free life.

Life not only happens to us, it happens to your pet or domesticated animal as well. The difference is you can complain about it and point to the source of your angst. But what about your dog, cat, horse or other domesticated animal?

Pets are family members that provide joy, love, comfort and entertainment. In some instances, a source of income for show animals. If your favorite pet were to be suffering greatly, what would you do about it? What if you could care for him or her, non-invasive, providing years of pain-free comfort and lower veterinarian bills, would you want to?

Vet Med Explained is a conversational veterinary learning channel created by a final-year vet student who needed revision that didn’t require sitting still with a textbook.

Each episode features two AI-generated hosts, who I like to call Hector and Clara, taking lively deep dives into vet med topics — from conditions and procedures to diagnostics, treatments, pathophysiology and clinical concepts.

Yes, the voices are AI. Yes, they can be a little dramatic sometimes. No, this isn’t copy-and-paste content. 

Episodes are built from carefully prepared veterinary learning notes and designed to make dense topics feel clearer, calmer and easier to revise.

Made for vet students, new grads, nurses and clinicians who want veterinary medicine explained in a way that actually sticks.

Subscribe for clear, conversational vet med deep dives.

Welcome to Montana Horse Chiropractic Co. 🐎

I’m Dr. Jon Wilhelm, a certified veterinary chiropractor (IVCA, CVC) with a background in Olympic sports medicine and over two decades of clinical experience. I help horses move better and perform their best.

Through my videos, you’ll get a behind-the-scenes look at real equine chiropractic treatments, learn about assessing joint and soft tissue function, and pick up tips to support your horse’s movement, soundness, and comfort.

✅ Curious what full-body equine chiropractic care looks like?  Watch me work on real horses across Montana.

📚 Want to understand the techniques behind the work?
Stay tuned for stretching strategies, mobility tools, and performance-based care insights grounded in years of experience with elite athletes—both human and equine.

🔔 Subscribe for: 
• Equine chiropractic demos
• Mobility and stretching techniques
• Ranch call footage
• Sport horse performance care
• Expert tips from the field

📍 Based in Manhattan, MT

Gawler Animal Hospital isn’t just a vet clinic, it’s a place where pets and people feel at home. We care for everything from the simple stuff, like vaccinations and check-ups, to the tricky things, like complex medical cases and surgery.
We’re a local team, but our patients come from near and far, because what we do is a bit different. We believe that vet visits should'nt be stressful. That’s why we’ve built a ‘fear-free’ environment where tails wag, cats feel safe, and everyone, two-legged and four, can relax.
Our promise is simple: to treat every pet as if they were our own, and every owner as we’d want to be treated. It’s not just about medicine, it’s about kindness, trust, and making sure your best friend gets the care they deserve.

I  specialize in hands-on, natural approaches that support dogs’ comfort, movement, digestion, and overall well-being.
Through guided, step-by-step techniques, my work focuses on helping caregivers better understand what their dog’s body is communicating and how to respond safely and effectively. My approach emphasizes practical education, clarity, and confidence, so hands-on care feels approachable rather than intimidating.
In addition to in-practice work, I develop pre-recorded educational resources designed for pet parents. These programs support daily comfort, stress reduction, and a stronger human–animal bond, while remaining non-invasive.

My background blends animal wellness, client education, and program development, with a strong focus on accessibility, safety, and real-world application. Every resource is created with the goal of helping companions live well, and helping the people who care for them feel empowered in the process.


🦮 Kristina Dodge Canine Wellness

This channel focuses on common accidents or injuries that can occur with sugar gliders and other exotic pets that require intervention from owners while they seek out veterinary care. 

DISCLAIMER: I am not a veterinarian or licensed veterinary technician. I have owned sugar gliders since 2019 and run into a variety of medical problems that have allowed me to learn how to temporarily treat acute situations until I can get my pet to a veterinarian. These videos are not a replacement for veterinary diagnostics and care. 

For questions about sugar glider husbandry and care, please refer to Sugar Glider Diaries here on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@sugargliderdiaries

We rescue animals from abandonment, abuse, neglect, and euthanasia by providing medical care and foster home placement until loving, permanent homes can be found.

Our mission is to not only help animals in need, but to educate people on properly taking care of their animals. To ensure that animal welfare is our number one priority. We will do everything possible to make sure animals are put in loving foster homes, get the proper vet care they need, and find forever homes to approved adopters.

row: For the love of aging dogs! We love our furry friends and watching our playful young dogs grow into older dogs and ultimately senior dogs can be difficult.  We want to help them any way possible and love them as long as we can.  Senior dogs can live happy comfortable lives if they stay healthy and mobile.  We’re obsessed with delivering insanely useful tools, training and products to our community who love their dogs. Our mission is to take the best and latest of what’s been tested and proven in helping dogs at home.  We work with the best of the best in the canine world to enable humans around the world help their loving aging dogs live longer and pain free.  One such amazing resource is Carrie Smith, a certified Canine Rehabilitation therapist with 14 years experience working with dogs on top of her 30+ years working with humans.  People travel great distances for their aging, injured or recovering dogs to see Carrie but we are bringing her into your home.

Hi, I'm Katie Mehrtens, and I am the owner of The Right Spot Pet Massage.  I am a nationally certified small animal massage therapist and offer therapeutic massage for all breeds of dogs, cats, and other small animals. 

I created this channel to share some of my knowledge about pet massage with you. My intention is to provide you with some at-home tools you can use with your pet.  

Please know that all animals are different and will react / respond differently to massage. So, what works one time or on one pet may not work the next time or on another pet. Never force the massage – if your pet does not want to be massaged, stop and try again another time.

A few notes:
• These are simply informative videos
• Massage is not a replacement for veterinary care
• See your vet if your pet seems to be in pain
• Never massage deep on your pet. The idea of “it will hurt now, but feel better later” does not apply to animals
 
Thanks so much for tuning in!
Please enjoy these videos!

At Rickards Chiropractic in Escondido, California we use extremely precise advanced Upper Cervical Chiropractic techniques to improve the health and life of our patients. 

Upper Cervical Chiropractic care is a very gentle technique that does not utilize twisting, popping or cracking. Our safe approach has proved extremely effective for those suffering from a variety of chronic conditions including migraines, vertigo, fibromyalgia, back pain, neck pain, TMJ and more. 

To schedule a consultation with Dr. Rickards please call 760-274-0564
To learn more about our practice visit our website at www.rickardschiropractic.com

We would love to see if our unique form of care can help you find the relief you have been looking for.

If would like to learn even more about Upper Cervical Care please visit https://uppercervicalawareness.com/

ASPIRE Therapy and Wellness is an independently owned, therapist-led practice based in Louisville, CO - bringing together physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, pelvic health, Parkinson's therapy, chiropractic care, massage, personal training, and wellness programming under one roof.

We also partner with senior living communities across Colorado's Front Range, delivering on-site PT, OT, and speech therapy to residents at assisted living, memory care, and independent living facilities.

On this channel, you'll find expert-led videos on recovery, rehabilitation, healthy aging, and whole-body wellness - designed to help you or someone you love move better and live fully.

📍 Louisville, CO
🌐 weaspire.net
📞 303.963.5582

Cat rescue videos

Animal rescue missions
Cat adoption journeys
Educational pet care tips

📌 New rescue videos every week!

We are volunteers and do not work at the shelter so if you would like information on any of the dogs featured on this channel, please call West LA and provide the ID number of the dog.

Our hope is that these videos will help these wonderful dogs get adopted!

Welcome to my YouTube channel!  I am a Foster Mom with StreetHearts Animal Rescue and am pleased to share one of our many adoptable animals with you.

StreetHearts Animal Rescue is 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. We strive to save and aid animals from situations of abandonment, neglect, abuse and injury. Our focus is on street intercession, medical help, rescue placement, fostering and finding forever homes.  

For more information or an adoption application on one our adoptable animals, please visit us at http://www.streetheartsanimalrescue.org or email us at streethearts.animal.rescue@gmail.com!

row: Friends of the Fairfax County Animal Shelter

More than 5,000 animals, including cats, dogs, small mammals, reptiles and livestock, come to the Fairfax County Animal Shelter each year. The shelter opens its doors — and its heart — to care for each and every animal. But, the shelter can't do it alone. Thankfully, the Friends of the Fairfax County Animal Shelter is here to help. Through donor and volunteer support, we provide medical care, food, supplies and so much more to help the shelter care for these loving animals. In doing so, we help save lives — together.

The FFCAS is an independent 501(c)(3) all-volunteer organization, and not a part of the Fairfax County government. All donations are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law and are gratefully accepted, no matter the amount.

Hello Truffle Diggers or Soon To Be! 

I'm Petra, an avid truffle hunter and truffle dog trainer in the Southeast of the United States. I'm the author of "The Art of Truffle Hunting", a comprehensive, self-guided truffle dog training e-book, available on my website www.corefitcanine.com (under construction). It's more than a traditional dog training guide. It offers step-by-step guidancе, real hunt and training videos, and scientific information that will support you to develop effective hunting techniques, better understand your dog's behavior, and build the unique partnership that lies at the heart of successful truffle hunting. It's a fun activity and brings out the best in both human and dog! Feel free to reach out for consultations or in-person lessons.  

I also teach Canine Fitness (Certified Canine Strength and Conditioning Coach) and am a Certified Canine massage therapist. 
I am a Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT), and Cardiology Vet Tech Specialist (Retired/Emeritus).

row: As an experienced, mobile Sports Massage Therapist, I visit your home, workplace or sports venue. I treat people of all ages and backgrounds (not just sports people!), whose conditions or symptoms may arise from over use, injury, surgery, degenerative conditions and neurological disorders, to name just a few. If you are experiencing pain, discomfort, reduced mobility, have an injury or want to improve personal performance, contact me to discuss your condition and see how I can help. I am  based in Rugby, Warwickshire. I use manual therapy, soft tissue techniques and movement education to aid your recovery and my goal is to empower you to control/eradicate your condition by identifying and treating the cause, not just the symptom. Self-care has never been more important.  Learn to stretch, strengthen, relax and use self massage techniques, as you begin to understand what is happening to your body.

I plan to upload weekly and here you can find documentation of our tiny home journey, trying to start a family, gardening & cooking videos, and just our everyday life! Subscribe to my channel and follow along on this journey I call life! 


Follow me on instagram @avanisavage and subscribe!

row:
Massage therapy has plenty of good, some bad, and a lot of stuff nobody tells you.
I’ve spent more than 16 years working throughout the massage industry, from spas, private practice to massage schools and the corporate side of the business. This channel is where I share the practical advice, honest conversations and blunt opinions I wish more therapists heard at the beginning of their careers.
The Blunt LMT is for future massage therapists, students, newer LMTs, experienced therapists and anyone curious about what really happens behind the treatment-room door. We’ll talk about massage school, practical interviews, draping, clients, confidence, finding a job, body mechanics, career longevity, industry myths and everything that happens after graduation. And because I’m a massage therapist who cannot draw, Nova, my AI artist, helps bring The Blunt LMT to life. The artwork may be AI-created, but the experience, education and blunt opinions come from a real person
Subscribe and come along.

The first Veterinary Rehabilitation mobile unit in UK going on line.

Valerie Teo Chiropractic Pte. Ltd. was founded by Valerie Teo in 2020, located in the central area of Singapore at The Bencoolen. A 2013 Macquarie Masters grad, she is Singapore’s only local chiropractor certified for both humans and animals.  She also extends her chiropractic care to animals through her sister company, Animal Pal Chiropractic when she became a certified animal chiropractor at Options for Animals College of Animal Chiropractic, Kansas, USA since 2017.

She is also a certified Biodynamic Craniosacral therapist since 2024. When integrated with chiropractic care, BCST can enhance the effectiveness of adjustments by addressing subtle imbalances in the craniosacral system, resulting in improved overall well-being. Her primary aim is to foster positive change in every patient she treats. She recognizes that each individual’s path to recovery is unique, and hence, she is committed to staying updated with the latest advancements to better serve her patients.

I'm Caroline Williams, CRM L5 Dip, ACMT a Clinical Reflexologist & Massage Therapist, providing video tips for sports massage and clinical reflexology

I hold a Level 5 Mastership from the Reflexology Academy in London, the highest qualification in the field of reflexology. I was lucky enough to study for two years with world-leading reflexologist Hagar Basis. As a clinical reflexologist I am trained to work with clients with specific medical conditions. I’m also trained in baby reflexology and massage as well as foot reading.

I have completed training in Advanced Clinical and Sports Massage (ACMT) with Jing Advanced Clinical Massage Training, and I’m currently in the second year of a BTEC Level 6 Diploma in Advanced Clinical Massage and Sports Massage with Jing Advanced Clinical Massage Training. The highest level of massage training in the UK.

Every life matters.
At Wild Rescue Stories, we bring you powerful wildlife rescue journeys, emotional animal survival stories, and heartwarming recoveries from around the world.
