Compassionate Care in a Feline-Friendly Environment

At Albuquerque Cat Clinic, we believe that the bond between cats and their caretakers is extremely special. We also believe that protecting and preserving our feline patients’ health, both physical and mental, is essential to the continuance of this bond.

We strive to continually exceed our clients’ expectations in the care and treatment of their feline companions. We recognize that visits to the veterinarian can be stressful for both cat and owner. We work diligently to provide a quiet, relaxing environment and excellent customer service in order to create an experience that is as pleasant as possible.

To learn more about our practice visit our website at  https://truespinebend.com

We would love to see if our unique form of care can help you find the relief you have been looking for.

If would like to learn even more about Upper Cervical Care please visit https://uppercervicalawareness.com/

My name is Queenasia Moore, I am a licensed massage therapist in NYS as of Oct 2022. I graduated from one of the top schools in New York City for massage therapy, the Swedish Institute. Additionally, I am also certified in sound bowl healing. I currently work in NYC providing medical massage therapy. I’ve had a passion for the massage therapy industry for over 10 years, being a migraine sufferer and always looking for a more holistic approach to my pain lead me to massage therapy.  The power of touch from massage therapy can help in more ways than one on more levels than you can imagine, mind, body and soul! 
This channel will be all about massage therapy techniques, sound bowl healing, meditation and just catching a vibe! 
Open to video requests & suggestions. 

Subscribe to keep up with all things massage & holistic! 

Follow me on Instagram @ZuriMassage

We are proud to be an accredited member of the American Animal Hospital Association, meeting its high standards for excellence in veterinary care. Only 14% of the small animal veterinary facilities in North America can claim this distinction!

International Animal Rescue Goa was established as a charity (Registration No : 106/GOA/98) in August 1998. Our aim is to reduce the terrible suffering of animals in Goa.

Since we began this vital work, International Animal Rescue Goa, has sterilized more than 30,000 dogs, 11,000 cats, and vaccinated over 60,000 dogs against rabies. Our ambulances have collected thousands of road casualties and we have made a major impact on mange, which causes intense suffering and was endemic within the street dog community. We rescue dozens of animals from wells every year, have rescued hundreds of snakes from houses and snake charmers which would otherwise have been killed or died, and do our best to educate the public on animal welfare issues.

http://www.internationalanimalrescuegoa.org.in

row: North Shore Horse Rescue and Sanctuary

We are North Shore Horse Rescue and Sanctuary, a small horse farm on the east end of Long Island, New York.  We are a 501(c)3 organization that is also verified by the Global Federation of Animal Sanctuaries and a Guardian for Equus Foundation.  Our mission is to rescue and care for any unwanted horses including those that have been neglected, abused, abandoned or are at risk of going to slaughter.  If the horse can be rehabilitated and adopted, we will find a loving, informed home for them.  If suitable homes cannot be found, North Shore Horse Rescue has committed itself to allowing its’ permanent residents to live out their lives in a safe, stress-free environment.

We are highlighting videos of our work with horses.  We will show you how we care for our rescue horses.  The stories of the rescues will be highlighted.  Our goal is to further our mission by explaining the hardships these magnificent creatures endure  and how they lead a happy life in our care.

row: The Centre of Animal Physiotherapy AlexisMakaritis

Physiotherapy and rehabilitation for animals, dogs, cats and horses. Hydrotherapy treadmill available with heated, clean, filtered water and other latest technology machines available such as electro-muscular stimulation H-Wave, laser, pulsed electromagnetic field therapy and therapeutic exercises. Physiotherapy and rehabilitation for animals suffering from post operation, arthritis, neurological conditions such as disc prolapse, hip dysplasia, elbow dysplasia. Physiotherapy is non invasive. My name is Shannon, I am a Mobile Massage Therapist in the Bay Area, CA and own Living Lotus Massage. This channel is for me to share Self Care tips, inspire with health education backed with science AND Woo-Woo insight, give clients a peek into the craziness of my real life & business behind the scenes, and so much more!

Join me on the adventures being a Mama, Wife and Business Owner, working on myself through: anxiety, PTSD, traumas and my new ventures (like: my Mermaid Woo-Woo side @celestialmermaidmt on Instagram)

Massage isn't just bodywork to me, I honestly feel like if you aren't including your Mind and Spirit in the bodywork, you are missing a huge component, as EVERYTHING IS CONNECTED... let's chat about it!! :D

Heavenly Paws Animal Rescue, Inc. is a 501 (c) non-profit, all-volunteer, no-kill feline rescue.

Angeline Behrendt, a trained Veterinary Technician, founded Heavenly Paws Animal Shelter, Inc. in 2004 to expand her services and provide safe and secure homes for cats.

Heavenly Paws Animal Shelter is not a true brick-and-mortar shelter. We have a network of foster homes to take in and care for homeless cats until permanent, loving homes can be found. We also strive to help humans understand the importance of controlling the pet population through spaying and neutering.

Heavenly Paws Animal Shelter relies on private and corporate donations to help fund our rescue operations and accomplish our mission.

Heavenly Paws Animal Shelter has treated and saved many cats in challenging situations. All of our volunteers have pledged to rescue as many cats as possible with the space and funding we have available. We will always be committed to saving lives, one stray at a time!

Here at Widom Chiropractic, we are proud to help our patients live better lives without pain.

We truly believe that nobody deserves to live in pain, even as they age, and we will do everything we can to ensure that our patients are comfortable. We are proud to help people after accidents or injuries and when they are uncomfortable doing their day-to-day activities.

Though pain itself is uncomfortable, when you have chronic pain, life can become unbearable. You may struggle just doing your normal day-to-day tasks. You may have trouble concentrating because you are not feeling well.

After a thorough examination with X-rays, we will be able to determine where your problem lies and discuss how we can help you feel better. Even after just a few treatments, you will be amazed at how much better you feel! You will be able to move around better, have better circulation, and may even start to lose weight. Chiropractic care can really make a world of difference to you!

Park Road Veterinary Clinic is a companion animal hospital dedicated to providing veterinary care for your pets. We take great pride in our veterinary clinic and our staff, and the level of care we provide. We routinely provide care for Dog & Cats, from the first puppy or kitten visit our friendly staff will be there for you and your pet.

We know that your cat, dog, new kitten or puppy is a valued family member and that you want them to receive the very best medical care from our veterinarians. Our goal is to educate you on the needs of your pet, from routine vaccinations or difficult surgeries. Our vet team provides emotional support for our clients since we understand how much your pet means to you. We also spend a great deal of time ensuring that our staff continues to upgrade their education, so we are always on the leading edge.

Welcome to Florida Farm School & Animal Rescue, a heartwarming family farm run by Sarah, a single mom of two boys and countless beloved farm animals! After eight long years of running a construction business, Sarah decided to trade the hustle and bustle for a simpler, more fulfilling life surrounded by nature. Afterall, it was withing months of being in the country life that she realized just how much "life" she missed out on living in the American Programming. 

At our farm, we believe in the value of slowing down, connecting with animals, and embracing the peaceful rhythms of country living. Sarah's mission is to share this experience with others through hands-on education, unique opportunities, and heartfelt rescue efforts for animals in need. Whether it's through our farm school, events, camping, or animal rescue work, we invite you to discover the joy of farm life with us! Reach Out! Info@floridafarmschool.org

This channel aims to help you understand how massage and core strength exercises are so beneficial, but also provide tips and advice to help you look after your dog so that they can live happier, healthy and long lives.

Hello! Thanks for stopping by my channel! My name is Tracey and I’ve been a Certified Canine Massage Therapist for 14 years. I am also Board Certified in Animal Acupressure and received my Board Certification in 2018. Each Acupressure Massage session I do is tailored specifically to the individual animal to address any issues the animal may be experiencing. It could be anxiety, arthritis, general aging, etc. I currently have an office in Sedona, Arizona and work in veterinary offices, and canine rehab clinic. I also do in-home sessions in Prescott, Arizona. 

Last year I added vibrational sound therapy using crystal singing bowls to my available services. I am amazed at how effective vibration can be with animals. Even deaf animals benefit. I spend quite a bit of time at a senior dog sanctuary in Prescott, Arizona and they have taught me so much about the benefits of sound therapy. I will be adding many videos at the sanctuary so you can see for yourself.

With Love,
Tracey

OUR MAIN MISSION IS SIMPLE; TO FIND LOVING HOMES FOR UNWANTED, HOMELESS OR NEGLECTED ANIMALS IN RICHMOND UPON THAMES AND SURROUNDING AREAS. BUT WHAT WE DO IS SO MUCH MORE THAN THAT.

Whether it's rescuing animals from cruelty or taking in the hundreds of abandoned ones, we foster and give them the medical and specialist attention they need, including neutering. We look after them until we are able to find approved owners who adopt them into loving, happy homes. And we do this as a non-profit charity run by volunteers and we're funded purely by donations.

As part of our mission, we offer advice, information and actively raise public awareness about animal welfare. In particular, animal neutering: it's the only way to stop the cycle of unwanted animals.

Founded in July of 2016, Little Lives Small Animal Rescue is a 501c3 nonprofit organization located in Tri-Cities, Washington that primarily focuses on rescuing small animals such as rodents, reptiles, birds, rabbits and etc. 

We want to help the animals in and around our community as much as possible. Our journey started with a paralyzed bearded dragon, an abandoned pet mouse, and a chinchilla without a home. Since starting our rescue, we have saved several animal types including geckos, guinea pigs, rabbits, bearded dragons, fish, iguanas, snakes, mice, and more.

We have a large number of rescued rabbits with limited rabbit fosters. We try to help the public with rabbit care and advice since overpopulation and dumping is a huge problem in our area. Please neuter/spay your rabbit and litter box train them (using pine pellet cat litter). It will make your life easier!

Enjoy our cute critters and thank you for the support!!

Little Lives Small Animal Rescue

Welcome to The Vet Tech Collective — the #1 YouTube home for veterinary technicians, vet tech students, and anyone exploring a future in animal healthcare.

If you’re passionate about animals but overwhelmed by low pay, long hours, burnout, compassion fatigue, or the pressure of VTNE exam prep… you’re in the right place.

This channel combines:

Day-in-the-life vet tech vlogs

VTNE study tips, memory hacks & skill breakdowns

Career guidance, specialty pathways & salary growth

Mental-health support for compassion fatigue & burnout


🎓 Whether you’re preparing for the VTNE, already in the field, or just thinking about becoming a vet tech — this channel gives you the real, unfiltered, supportive insight you’ve been looking for.

💛 More than 70% of vet techs experience burnout. Nearly 90% report compassion fatigue.
This space exists to help you feel seen, supported, and empowered.

🐾 Subscribe and join a growing community redefining what it means to be a veterinary technician today.

Welcome to Northern Equine Therapy Centre

At Northern Equine Therapy Centre, we’re dedicated to providing specialised care and rehabilitation for horses. Our state-of-the-art facility combines expert knowledge with cutting-edge equipment to support recovery, performance enhancement, and overall well-being for equines.

📌 Services We Offer:
	•	Hydrotherapy in a 12ft deep circular pool
	•	Equine Physiotherapy
	•	Rehabilitation Programmes
	•	Injury Prevention & Recovery
	•	Bespoke Training Plans

🐴 Whether your horse is a competitive athlete or a beloved companion, we tailor our programmes to meet their unique needs, ensuring optimal health and performance.

📍 Located in North Yorkshire, we’re proud to serve equestrians from across the northern region.

💻 Visit our website www.northernanimaltherapycentre.co.uk to learn more.
📞 Contact us at 07745554181 to learn more. 

Don’t forget to subscribe for updates, tips, and insights into equine care and therapy!

At Restoring L.I.F.E. in Jasper, Indiana we use extremely precise advanced Upper Cervical Chiropractic techniques to improve the health and life of our patients. 

Upper Cervical Chiropractic care is a very gentle technique that does not utilize twisting, popping or cracking. Our safe approach has proved extremely effective for those suffering from a variety of chronic conditions including migraines, vertigo, fibromyalgia, back pain, neck pain, TMJ and more. 

To schedule a consultation with Dr. Alex Linne and Dr. Lindsey Linne please call 812-631-8653
To learn more about our practice visit our website at https://www.restoringlifeucc.com/

We would love to see if our unique form of care can help you find the relief you have been looking for.

If would like to learn even more about Upper Cervical Care please visit https://uppercervicalawareness.com/

Welcome to the Release and Recovery YouTube channel with Sheahan Keinick. 

'Ms. Shea' is a dance educator, international ballet examiner, speaker, and creator of Release and Recovery.

With more than three decades of experience in dance education, a Master’s degree in Dance Pedagogy, and previous experience as a massage therapist and lymph drainage therapist, Sheahan shares practical, evidence-informed education to help dancers better understand and care for their bodies.

Here you will find self-care knowledge for dancers and the families and educators who support them, including myofascial release, mobility, stretching, nerve gliding, breathing, recovery practices, and insights from Sheahan’s research and speaking.

Release and Recovery helps dancers build Awareness, Grit, and Grace through self-care skills for life, so they can remain mobile, balanced, and stage-ready.

Learn more at ReleaseandRecovery.com and SheahanKeinick.com.

Subscribe to see more videos, tips and insights into equine holistic care.

Here at Lotus London, we fully understand how busy and stressful modern day life can sometimes be. We also understand that as someone living in a large city, you often simply do not have the time to visit your massage therapist on a regular basis. It is for this reason that our team has decided to do things a little differently in that we offer our clients mobile massage treatments, thereby eliminating you having to battle the traffic and the busy streets of London to make your massage appointment because we come to wherever you are!

Whether you require a massage due to a sports injury, to combat fatigue after a stressful event, or you simply find that our deep tissue massages are a great help for relaxation, our team of highly qualified massage therapists will gladly assist you. Our massages can help to relieve pain and also assist you in rebalancing your energy and help you to sleep better.

Species we rescue include possums and gliders, koalas, kangaroos and wallabies, wombats, echidnas, turtles, snakes, lizards, all native birds (including owls and raptors).

Established in 1978, Hunter Wildlife Rescue (formerly Native Animal Trust Fund) was the first volunteer run wildlife rescue organisation in NSW.

Pamper Your Pup with a Massage

Dog massage therapist = my dream job! Being a dog massage therapist is my dream job! It is not only a profession to me, but it is also my calling. I have committed myself to a lifetime of improving the quality of life of dogs. I have mastered every manual technique for their unique anatomy so I can improve their wellbeing.
I could not imagine myself doing anything else because nothing is closer to my heart than my furry friends and working with them gives me the greatest pleasure. The moment I saw the happiness of my first canine client I knew this was my path. I believe it is important not to take dogs out of their everyday environment, so I do in-home massages. I can perform dog massage therapy anywhere requested, but the smell of home and familiar surroundings is key in helping your dog achieve relaxation. This way, there are no distractions, and we can focus on complete unwinding and healing during the session.

Welcome to Four Paws Holistic Therapy!
Have you ever wondered what your pet is truly feeling, thinking, or trying to tell you? This channel is dedicated to exploring the world of animal communication and holistic healing, to help you understand your companions and connect with them on a deeper level.
Hosted by Gillian Edwards, CCMT, RMT, CAC a Certified Animal Communicator, Reiki Master/Teacher, and Canine Massage Therapist, who bridges the gap between you and your pets through telepathic animal communication, energy healing, and hands-on bodywork.

On this channel, you'll find:
Insights into how animal communication works 
Tips for deepening the bond between you and your animal companions
Guidance on holistic pet wellness
Practical advice for your animal companion

Want to understand your animal's emotional and physical wellbeing?
🐾 Book a session/learn more at: fourpawsholistictherapy.com
Bringing wellbeing, comfort, and balance to our animal companions, one conversation at a time.

Welcome to Revive Chiropractic's YouTube channel! Located in Diamond Springs, California, we're dedicated to enhancing your health and wellness through personalized chiropractic care. Our mission is to help you live a healthier, pain-free life by focusing on the care of the human frame, proper diet, and the prevention of disease.

Our founder, Dr. Larson, a proud graduate of Palmer College of Chiropractic in Iowa, was inspired to start this practice out of a deep passion for helping others achieve optimal physical health. We create a welcoming and inclusive environment where individuals of all ages and backgrounds receive the holistic care they deserve.

Through our channel, we'll share informative and engaging content about chiropractic care, health tips, wellness strategies, and insights into our specialized techniques.  Let's embark on this path to health and wellness together!

Headway Animal Health is an Australian-owned company. We are committed to the continued development of quality products for the veterinary pharmaceutical and OTC animal health markets in Australia and overseas.

Complementing our existing products that support the practicing veterinarian in critical care areas such as sedation, recovery, pain relief, mobility, dermatology, and infection control, we are also addressing external and internal parasite control with a range of practical and affordable treatments for pet owners.

Further product registrations are underway that will continue to demonstrate our clear commitment to quality and to support the Australian veterinary profession and animal owners.

🐾 Fishy’s Friends Rescue – YouTube Channel Description
Fishy’s Friends Rescue is a foster-based, 501(c)(3) nonprofit serving Comanche County, Oklahoma, and surrounding areas. Our mission is simple but urgent: to rescue, rehabilitate, and re home homeless and abandoned dogs while addressing the root causes of pet overpopulation through education and community outreach.
We are not a shelter—we are a network of everyday people opening their homes and hearts to dogs in need. From dumped litters to overlooked strays, we focus on the dogs who have nowhere else to go.
On this channel, you’ll find:
Foster journeys and training education
Education on responsible pet ownership and prevention
Community initiatives, events, and outreach efforts
The reality of rescue—both the wins and the hard days
Join us. Adopt. Foster. Donate.Volunteer.Educate.

Not Another Vet Nurse (NAVN) seeks to bring awareness, change, and possibly end the stigma of mental health and suicide within veterinary medicine. Not only is the veterinary profession among the top for suicide concerns but the statistics regarding mental health are just as alarming. 1 in 10 Veterinarians has suffered severe psychological distress. 1 in 6 have considered suicide. 1 in 5 have been a victim or knows someone who has been a victim of cyber bullying. 

NAVN is a 501(c)(3) public charity for veterinary professionals to be able to afford mental health care. All funds donated through our organization goes directly back into the veterinary community.

Welcome to Bovine Vet Hub! 🐄🩺

Bovine Vet Hub is your trusted source for practical veterinary medicine and livestock health. Our mission is to help veterinarians, veterinary students, livestock farmers, and animal lovers improve animal health through real clinical cases and evidence-based veterinary knowledge.
On this channel, you'll find:

🐄 Real cattle & buffalo clinical cases

💉 Disease diagnosis and treatment

🩺 Veterinary surgeries and procedures

📚 Veterinary education & clinical tips

🐐 Goat & sheep health management

🚑 Emergency and field veterinary medicine

🌍 Latest livestock disease updates

Whether you're a practicing veterinarian, a veterinary student, or a livestock farmer, Bovine Vet Hub provides practical knowledge you can apply in the field.

📅 New videos every week!

👍 Subscribe and join our growing veterinary community.

Healthy Animals • Healthy Farms • Better Future

#Bovinevethub

Equine-Alignment care is a manual therapy that can restore correct biomechanical function and reduce or eliminate performance problems, acute or chronic pain, and health issues in horses.

By restoring the correct movement of the joints, particularly those of the spine, the animal becomes better able to maintain its own health and achieve its full potential within its field.

Equine-Alignment care should be used alongside traditional veterinary care to enhance the wellbeing of the horse. 

Steve Treloar's Equine Align care may help to:
Provide gentle musculoskeletal alignment for the enhancement of movement or performance, of your horse and Integrate its movement to enhance performance

Steve Treloar's qualifications include:
​
Bachelor of Applied Science (Chiropractor)
Cert BT—Certified Equine Bowen Therapist (ISBT)
Certified Equine Rehabilitation and Training (ACAAT)

WildCare Stories shares cinematic rescue stories of injured wild animals fighting for survival.
Every short captures pain, hope, and the silent struggle of wildlife.
WildCare Stories is dedicated to telling emotional rescue stories of injured wild animals through cinematic short videos.

From animals trapped in extreme weather to wildlife rescued from life-threatening situations, each story highlights survival, compassion, and hope. These videos are designed to raise awareness and connect viewers with the reality of wildlife struggles around the world.

All content is created for educational and storytelling purposes, using cinematic visuals to respectfully portray animal rescue and survival.

From barrel and infrared saunas to cold plunges, massage chairs, and salt therapy solutions, every product we carry is chosen for its superior craftsmanship and lasting durability. The result is a personal wellness retreat that fits seamlessly into your everyday life.
https://thermavibe.com here to meet your wellness needs.

I am the CEO and LPT of a vibrant, innovative approach to pediatric physical therapy. 

Free to Move and Play provides evidence-based therapeutic techniques to help children achieve their highest potential for mobility and development. We believe pediatric services that promote innovative play create life-changing outcomes for both your child and family. We currently serve kids ages 3months - 5 years old!

After thirty years of Physical Therapy experience in different settings with fourteen years in pediatrics, I’m thrilled to finally bring the vision of Free To Move and Play to life. My desire is to create a treatment environment that will capture and maintain a child’s attention by keeping the therapy process as fun as possible. I’m passionate about equipping parents to become daily “therapists” so they feel empowered to help their child achieve their highest potential at home and within the familiar fabric of their communities.

Originally from Colorado, Charles L. Starr III is a veterinarian. In his practice, Charles L. Starr III specializes in treating domestic pets, farm animals, and rescued wildlife. He staffs a full service veterinary clinic that offers grooming, boarding, and has an animal behavior specialist on call. Charles L. Starr III runs the clinic with the assistance of his daughter and office manager, Erin. 

Having grown up in rural Wisconsin, Charles L. Starr III was exposed to the unique relationships that people have with their animals at a very early age. His father owned and operated a small family farm where Charles L. Starr III and his siblings worked milking cows, brushing horses, and collecting eggs. He learned to respect the animals and value each for their role in his family's livelihood.

Equine Chiropractic will address a number of potential health and performance issues. It is not designed to be a replacement for traditional medical horse care, but is instead intended to keep your horse in peak condition.

Even in the most athletic horse there can be abnormalities in the animal's gait or simply movement habits that mean the horse does not perform up to its full potential. Chiropractic has been found to be extremely effective in dealing with such issues, as well as alleviating neck and back discomfort.

Chiropractic detects spinal, limbs, and pelvic dysfunctions. By using hand thrust manoeuvres it releases tension and realigns the horses skeleton.  Spinal alignments stop neuro connection at the vertebral level and the correction recreates normal flow between the central and peripheral nervous systems. 

If your horse undergoes a chiropractic treatment, it will benefit from improved interactions between the spine's biomechanics and neurological signals.

Whether it’s pain, fatigue, poor posture, stress or anxiety, we all have an ailment that makes day to day life that little bit more difficult. I'll be sharing videos with tips to help keep you injury and pain free. 

I’ve been a massage therapist since 2012 and I’ve learnt that people rarely suffer from one isolated problem. I treat everyone who comes to me as an individual and I find out what is happening to them and, more importantly, why. It’s only then that we’ll be able to find the best therapy to help. Massage therapy is about making you feel better as a whole, enhancing your overall health and well-being.
 
I began my BTEC Level 5 qualification with the Oxford School of Sports Massage in 2011. I have been practicing since I qualified in 2012, and now have a great deal of experience to add to that. I also have a Level 3 Personal Training and Level 3 Exercise Referral qualifications and I’m a Sivananda Yoga Teacher CYT 200.

row: Hi I'm Sara. I am a professional Equine Sports Massage Therapist working in Wiltshire, Hampshire, Somerset and Dorset. As part of my work I take videos of horses walking and trotting and slow them down using the SloMo app on my iPad. This helps me understand where the horse isn't moving correctly and where it may have aches and pains. I can then perform a full body massage on the horse and explain to the owner how the horse can be rehabilitated and restore full movement to the affected area(s). I always massage the whole of the horse as all the muscles are interlinked and compensate for the movement of each other and it is pointless working on one muscle just for another to become sore.

We also offer Pilates classes to individuals looking for a great workout regimen. If you are in need of the best massage therapist in Colorado Springs, contact us today. Athletes and customers have relied on us for neuromuscular massage, trigger point therapy, deep tissue massage and more to help them recover and prevent injuries from occurring. Welcome to Paradise Pawsome Pet Care!

I'm Dawn, and I've spent more than 30 years working with animals while helping pet parents navigate the joys and challenges of caring for their beloved companions.

Here you'll find compassionate pet wellness education, practical tips, real-life stories, and gentle guidance to help dogs and cats live healthier, happier lives. Topics include pet anxiety, senior pet care, veterinary visits, holistic wellness, pet grief, and everyday challenges many pet parents face.

Many lessons shared on this channel come from my experiences with Napayshini, Oscar, Pumpkin, Merlin, and Einstein, as well as my years in veterinary medicine and animal care.

Whether you're helping an anxious cat, supporting a senior dog, preparing for a veterinary visit, or strengthening your bond with your pet, you're in the right place.

Because every pet deserves comfort, compassion, and a life filled with love.

Our Mission:  To prevent and eliminate the suffering of domestic and wild animals by rescuing and rehabilitating them and to encourage the public to peacefully coexist with all animals.

The day-to-day operation of Ratlum Mountain Animal Rescue is handled by Christine & Ahren Paulson, a husband-and-wife team.  The Paulson's spent over a decade volunteering for other charities, rescuing, fostering & rehabilitating domestic animals (dogs and cats), in addition to serving on the Board of Directors. In 2017, Ahren & Christine decided to broaden the scope of their rescue activities by learning about wildlife rehabilitation & earning their Wildlife Custodian Appointments from the Connecticut DEEP. In early 2020, they established their own non-profit charity, Ratlum Mountain Animal Rescue Inc.

Christine & Ahren continue to work full-time day jobs, while volunteering and running the charity in the remainder of their time. They invite everyone to join them on this journey

Welcome to Virginia Farm Animal Sanctuary (VFAS)  — a place of lifelong sanctuary for farm animals in need of a forever home.

Many of the animals here were once beloved pets whose families experienced life changes such as illness, loss, relocation, downsizing, or other circumstances beyond their control. When care needed a new place to continue, VFAS became that place.

Our mission is simple: provide lifelong sanctuary, compassionate care, and peace of mind for both animals and the people who love them.

Follow along for daily life at the sanctuary, animal stories, behind-the-scenes moments, educational content, tours, special events, and the frequent funny farm moment.

Home to donkeys, goats, sheep, pigs, llamas, poultry, and more, every resident here has a story — and every story matters.

We are dedicated to offering the safest and most advanced medical care for animals in a loving and supportive environment. In addition to a veterinary clinic, we also offer rehabilitation and behavior care for our patients. 

Rehabilitation Center: 
Pets benefit from rehabilitation much as humans benefit from physical therapy.  Rehabilitation helps pets recover from injury or surgery, regain and maintain mobility and decrease pain. 

Behavior & Training Classes:
Recognizing the relationship between physical and mental health, we augment our medical, surgical and dental services with behavior and training opportunities for both cats and dogs.

row: Subjects in Spinal Cord Injury Rehabilitation

This channel serves to provide education material for patients, their families and friends and non-medical laypeople on Spinal cord injuries (SCI), how they can affect functioning in everyday lives and how the use of therapy techniques with your therapist or at home can be implemented to improve participation in everyday activities.  Subjects will range from ADLs (activities such as activities as feeding, grooming and dressing) transfers from different surfaces and upper extremity management after a SCI; which all can become more difficult after a SCI.
These videos are for educational purposes only, and one should consult their medical doctor and/or rehabilitation specialist (physical or occupational therapist prior to implementing anything seen in theses videos.
